attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R) Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Design Verification Plan and Report document that governs this test. Links test execution to the master validation plan.

tag_set.value: Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R) Reference

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Engineering change order number if this test result triggered or validated a design change. Links test evidence to change management process.

attributes.name: environmental_conditions
attributes.description: Description of environmental conditions during test execution (e.g., temperature, humidity, pressure). Captures test environment context for result interpretation.

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of any failure, defect, or non-conformance observed during the test. Captures failure mode, symptoms, and conditions. Populated only when test outcome is fail or conditional pass.

attributes.name: failure_mode_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the observed failure mode. Links test failure to DFMEA or PFMEA failure mode catalog for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Primary quantitative measurement or test result value obtained during the test. The principal measured outcome of the test activity.

attributes.name: measured_value_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measured value (e.g., volts, amps, degrees Celsius, newtons, cycles). Ensures correct interpretation of test measurements.

attributes.name: measurement_uncertainty
attributes.description: Quantified uncertainty or tolerance associated with the measured value. Expresses the confidence interval or margin of error in the measurement.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this test result record. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this test result record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: prototype_phase
attributes.description: Development phase or maturity stage of the tested unit. Indicates whether the unit is a concept prototype, alpha build, beta unit, pre-production sample, or production unit.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result is required for regulatory certification or compliance submission (e.g., UL, CE, FCC). Flags test data needed for regulatory dossiers.

attributes.name: retest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test is a retest of a previously failed or inconclusive test. Used to track test iteration history.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal root cause analysis (RCA) is required for this test result. Typically true for test failures or unexpected results.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date when the test was executed. Principal business event timestamp for the test activity.

attributes.name: test_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time for test execution measured in hours. Captures the actual test run time for endurance and long-duration tests.

attributes.name: test_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the test execution completed. Used for duration calculation and detailed test timeline tracking.

attributes.name: test_facility
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the laboratory, test center, or facility where the test was conducted. May be internal lab or external third-party testing facility.

attributes.name: test_facility_location
attributes.description: Geographic location or site code of the test facility. Supports multi-site test operations and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: test_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes, observations, or comments recorded by the test engineer during test execution. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: test_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the test execution. Externally-known unique test reference number used for traceability and reporting.

attributes.name: test_outcome
attributes.description: Overall pass/fail result of the test execution. Indicates whether the tested unit met the acceptance criteria defined in the test specification.

attributes.name: test_purpose
attributes.description: Business objective or reason for conducting the test. Describes the validation goal, such as design verification, production qualification, regulatory compliance, or failure investigation.

attributes.name: test_specification_version
attributes.description: Version or revision of the test specification document used for this test execution. Ensures traceability to the correct test procedure version.

attributes.name: test_standard_reference
attributes.description: Industry or regulatory standard governing the test procedure. References the specific standard, specification, or protocol followed during test execution (e.g., IEC 61131-2, UL 508, ISO 16750).

attributes.name: test_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the test execution began. Used for duration calculation and detailed test timeline tracking.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the test execution. Tracks the test through its workflow from scheduling to completion.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Classification of the test performed. Defines the category of validation activity conducted on the unit under test. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: functional|environmental|emc|safety|endurance|performance|reliability|thermal|vibration|shock|humidity|salt_spray|dust|ingress_protection — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tested_unit_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical unit or sample subjected to testing. May be a serial number, prototype build number, or sample lot identifier.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this test result record in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

products.name: configuration_baseline
products.description: Configuration baseline record representing a formally approved and frozen snapshot of a product's complete design configuration at a specific milestone (e.g., functional baseline, allocated baseline, product baseline per ISO 10007). Captures baseline identifier, baseline type, effective date, approval authority, linked component revisions (frozen set), linked BOM revision, linked specification revisions, linked drawing revisions, associated engineering project phase, and change lock status. Serves as the immutable reference point against which all subsequent engineering changes are measured, enabling configuration audits (functional and physical), regulatory submission packages, and customer-contractual design freeze evidence.

attributes.name: configuration_baseline_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the configuration baseline record.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Baseline creation audit needs the employee ID for configuration control and release approval records.

attributes.name: engineering_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the engineering project to which the baseline belongs.

attributes.name: engineering_revision_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific product revision captured in the baseline.

attributes.name: previous_configuration_baseline_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on configuration_baseline (previous_configuration_baseline_id)

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Configuration baselines are established to lock in compliance‑required product states.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the baseline was formally approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the authority who approved the baseline.

attributes.name: associated_ecn_number
attributes.description: ECN number linked to this baseline, if any.

attributes.name: associated_eco_number
attributes.description: ECO number linked to this baseline, if any.

attributes.name: baseline_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code used externally to reference the baseline.

attributes.name: baseline_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name describing the baseline (e.g., "Functional Baseline – Rev A").

attributes.name: baseline_scope
attributes.description: Scope of the baseline (e.g., entire product, subsystem only).

attributes.name: baseline_type
attributes.description: Classification of the baseline according to ISO 10007 (functional, allocated, product, etc.).

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Category of change (e.g., design, material, process).

attributes.name: change_lock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether further changes to the baseline are locked (true) or allowed (false).

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Narrative reason for creating or updating the baseline.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance status of the baseline.

attributes.name: configuration_baseline_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the baseline.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for the cost impact estimate.

attributes.name: cost_impact_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the baseline change.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the baseline record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: configuration_baseline_description
attributes.description: Free‑form description of the baseline purpose and scope.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the baseline becomes effective.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the baseline expires or is superseded (nullable).

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification applicable to the baseline.

attributes.name: is_functional_baseline
attributes.description: True if the baseline represents a functional configuration.

attributes.name: is_physical_baseline
attributes.description: True if the baseline represents a physical configuration (as opposed to functional).

attributes.name: linked_bom_revision
attributes.description: Identifier of the BOM revision frozen in this baseline.

attributes.name: linked_component_set
attributes.description: Reference to the frozen set of component revisions included in the baseline.

attributes.name: linked_drawing_revision
attributes.description: Identifier of the drawing revision captured in the baseline.

attributes.name: linked_spec_revision
attributes.description: Identifier of the specification revision associated with the baseline.

attributes.name: lock_reason
attributes.description: Explanation why the baseline was locked from further changes.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User name or identifier of the person who last modified the baseline record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the baseline record.

attributes.name: project_phase
attributes.description: Phase of the engineering project at the time of baseline creation.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: True if the baseline triggers regulatory reporting or filing requirements.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated change in project schedule (in days) caused by the baseline.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the baseline.

products.name: component_installation
products.description: Represents the installation of a component onto a piece of equipment. Each record captures the date of installation, the physical position on the equipment, and the status of the installation. The association links one component to one equipment register.. Existence Justification: Components are physically installed onto equipment; each installation is recorded with an install date, position on the equipment, and installation status. A given component type can be installed on many pieces of equipment, and a piece of equipment can contain many component types. The installation records are actively created, updated, and deleted by maintenance personnel as part of the asset management process.

attributes.name: component_installation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the component_installation association

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the component master record

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the equipment register master record

attributes.name: install_date
attributes.description: Date when the component was installed on the equipment

attributes.name: installation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the installation record

attributes.name: installed_by_user
attributes.description: installed by user

attributes.name: installed_timestamp
attributes.description: installed timestamp

attributes.name: position_on_equipment
attributes.description: Physical location or slot identifier on the equipment where the component is installed

products.name: project_material_allocation
products.description: Represents the Bill of Materials for an engineering project, capturing the quantity of each material required, the planned delivery date, and the allocation status. Each record links one engineering_project to one material_master.. Existence Justification: Engineering projects allocate many material types, and each material can be allocated to multiple projects. The allocation is actively managed with quantities, planned delivery dates, and status, forming a distinct business entity (Bill of Materials).

attributes.name: project_material_allocation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Project Material Allocation - Project Material Allocation Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the project_material_allocation association

tag_set.value: Project Material Allocation - Project Material Allocation Id

attributes.name: engineering_project_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Project Material Allocation - Engineering Project Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the engineering project

tag_set.value: Project Material Allocation - Engineering Project Id

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Project Material Allocation - Material Master Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the material master

tag_set.value: Project Material Allocation - Material Master Id

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the material allocation for the project

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: cost amount

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date the material is expected to be delivered for the project

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material needed for the project

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Quality assurance and control domain encompassing SPC, Cp/Cpk indices, inspection plans, NCRs, CAPAs, PPAP, APQP, and FMEA records. Manages in-process and final inspection results, supplier quality audits, compliance testing, and regulatory conformance data aligned with ISO 9001 and SAP QM.

products.name: inspection_plan
products.description: Master definition of inspection plans aligned with SAP QM, specifying inspection characteristics, sampling procedures, control methods, and acceptance criteria for in-process and final inspection operations. Covers PPAP, APQP, and routine production inspection plans per ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the inspection plan record. Primary key for the inspection_plan data product in the quality domain.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Inspection plan approval requires sign‑off by a quality manager; linking to employee enables audit of approvals.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Inspection plans are created for each component to define inspection characteristics; linking ensures traceability from plan to the exact component inspected.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Planning costs for inspections are budgeted to a cost center; required for inspection budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Customer‑Specific Inspection Plan process requires linking each inspection_plan to the owning customer_account for contract compliance reporting.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: APQP process requires each inspection plan to be tied to its governing project header for schedule, cost, and traceability of quality deliverables.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.recipe. Business justification: Inspection plans are defined per production recipe; linking enables recipe‑specific inspection criteria in the Inspection Plan report.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Inspection plans are created to satisfy particular regulatory requirements; the FK replaces the free‑text regulatory_standard field.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Inspection plans are defined per product SKU for quality control; linking enables plan retrieval by SKU in the Inspection Planning process.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier to whom this inspection plan applies, for incoming or supplier-specific inspection plans. Relevant for receiving inspection and supplier quality audit plans managed via SAP Ariba.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection plan was formally approved for use. Provides an audit trail for ISO 9001 document control and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: apqp_phase
attributes.description: APQP phase during which this inspection plan was developed or is applicable. Phase 1: Plan and Define; Phase 2: Product Design and Development; Phase 3: Process Design and Development; Phase 4: Product and Process Validation; Phase 5: Feedback, Assessment and Corrective Action.

attributes.name: aql_level
attributes.description: Acceptable Quality Level expressed as a percentage defective, defining the maximum tolerable defect rate for the sampling plan. Used in conjunction with ISO 2859-1 / ANSI Z1.4 sampling tables.

attributes.name: characteristic_count
attributes.description: Total number of inspection characteristics (measurement parameters) defined within this inspection plan. Provides a quick summary of plan complexity for scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: characteristic_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the inspection characteristic tolerance limits and target value (e.g., mm, µm, N, bar, °C, %). Aligns with SAP QM master inspection characteristic unit.

attributes.name: control_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the measurement or control method used during inspection (e.g., visual, dimensional, functional, chemical, SPC chart). References the SAP QM master inspection characteristic control indicator.

attributes.name: control_plan_reference
attributes.description: Document number of the associated APQP Control Plan that this inspection plan implements. The control plan defines the process controls and reaction plans linked to inspection characteristics.

attributes.name: cpk_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable Cpk (Process Capability Index) value required for this inspection characteristic. Typically 1.33 for standard processes and 1.67 for safety-critical characteristics per PPAP requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection plan record was first created in the source system. Provides audit trail for data governance and ISO 9001 document control.

attributes.name: customer_specific_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection plan was created or modified to satisfy a specific customer quality requirement (CSR) beyond standard internal or regulatory requirements. Relevant for OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) supply relationships.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference to the ECO (Engineering Change Order) or ECN (Engineering Change Notice) that triggered the creation or revision of this inspection plan. Provides traceability to the PLM change management process in Siemens Teamcenter.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this inspection plan version becomes valid and applicable for production inspection operations. Aligns with SAP QM validity start date.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this inspection plan version expires and is no longer valid for new inspection lots. Null indicates the plan is open-ended with no scheduled expiry. Aligns with SAP QM validity end date.

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: Category of measurement equipment or test instrument required to perform the inspection. Used for calibration scheduling and resource allocation in Maximo Asset Management.

attributes.name: fmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Document number or identifier of the associated PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) or DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) that informed the inspection characteristics and control methods in this plan.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference

attributes.name: inspection_method_code
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized inspection method or test procedure document used to perform the inspection. Links to the SAP QM inspection method master record.

attributes.name: inspection_scope
attributes.description: Defines the intensity of inspection applied: full (normal), reduced (lower frequency for trusted suppliers/processes), tightened (increased scrutiny after failures), or skip-lot (periodic sampling). Aligned with SPC-driven dynamic inspection level adjustments.

attributes.name: inspection_stage
attributes.description: Stage in the production or supply chain process at which the inspection is performed. Incoming covers receiving inspection; in-process covers WIP (Work In Progress) checks; final covers end-of-line; outgoing covers pre-shipment; skip indicates skip-lot logic.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection plan record was last updated in the source system. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental lakehouse ingestion.

attributes.name: long_text_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the inspection plan scope, special instructions, safety precautions, and any additional context required by the inspector. Corresponds to SAP QM long text on the task list header.

attributes.name: lower_tolerance_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit for the primary inspection characteristic. Values below this limit result in a non-conformance. Used in SPC and Cp/Cpk capability index calculations.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date by which the inspection plan must be reviewed and revalidated to ensure continued suitability and compliance with current product specifications and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Routing operation number within the inspection plan, corresponding to the SAP QM task list operation (PLPO.VORNR). Defines the sequence of inspection steps within the plan.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or short description of the inspection plan, identifying the product, process, or operation it governs.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the inspection plan, aligned with SAP QM plan group and plan group counter. Used for cross-system reference and document control.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inspection plan. Controls whether the plan is available for use in production inspection operations. Draft plans are under development; active plans are approved for use; obsolete plans are superseded.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection plan by its operational purpose. Covers in-process, final inspection, receiving inspection, supplier audit, PPAP (Production Part Approval Process), APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), and first article inspection types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_process|final_inspection|receiving|supplier_audit|ppap|apqp|first_article — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version or revision number of the inspection plan, corresponding to the SAP QM plan group counter. Tracks engineering changes and revisions aligned with ECO/ECN processes.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility or site where this inspection plan is applicable. Inspection plans are plant-specific in SAP QM.

attributes.name: ppap_level
attributes.description: PPAP submission level (1–5) required for this inspection plan, per AIAG PPAP standard. Level 1 requires only a Part Submission Warrant; Level 3 is the default full submission; Level 5 requires records reviewed at the manufacturing site.

attributes.name: product_group_code
attributes.description: SAP material group or product family code to which this inspection plan applies. Enables grouping of inspection plans by product category for reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the current plan version, such as an ECO (Engineering Change Order), CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) outcome, customer complaint, or regulatory update.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of units to be drawn from the inspection lot for evaluation. Determined by the sampling procedure and AQL level. A value of zero indicates 100% inspection.

attributes.name: sample_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the sample size quantity (e.g., EA for each/piece, KG for kilogram, M for meter). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|M|L|M2|M3 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sampling_procedure_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the statistical sampling procedure applied in this inspection plan, including sample size, acceptance number, and rejection number per AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) tables.

attributes.name: spc_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SPC (Statistical Process Control) charting and Cp/Cpk capability monitoring are activated for this inspection plan. When true, measurement results feed into control charts and process capability analysis.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Nominal or target value for the primary inspection characteristic. Represents the ideal measurement around which tolerances are defined. Used as the centerline reference in SPC control charts.

attributes.name: upper_tolerance_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit for the primary inspection characteristic. Values exceeding this limit result in a non-conformance. Used in SPC (Statistical Process Control) and Cp/Cpk capability index calculations.

attributes.name: usage_decision_code
attributes.description: SAP QM usage decision code that defines the default disposition action (accept, reject, rework) applied when inspection results meet or fail acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production cell where the inspection operation is performed. Corresponds to SAP PP/QM work center assignment on the inspection routing.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the quality engineer or planner who originally created this inspection plan record in SAP QM or the source system.

products.name: inspection_lot
products.description: Transactional inspection lot record representing a single inspection event triggered by goods receipt, production order completion, in-process milestone, periodic schedule, or customer return receipt. Captures lot origin, material/part reference, inspection quantity, inspection type (incoming, in-process, final, recurring, RMA-receipt), current status (created, released, results-recorded, usage-decided), and disposition decision (accept, reject, rework, scrap). Links to inspection plan for execution instructions and generates inspection_result child records. Triggers NCR creation upon reject disposition or non-conformance detection. Central transactional entity for quality execution aligned with SAP QM inspection lot processing.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a single inspection lot record in the quality execution system. Primary key for the inspection_lot entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost of inspection activities allocated to cost center for cost‑of‑quality reporting; finance tracks these expenses.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Customer Inspection Lot Reporting mandates associating each inspection_lot with the customer_account to deliver lot‑level quality results to the customer.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce/employee record of the quality inspector or technician responsible for executing the physical inspection activities for this lot. Supports accountability, workload tracking, and competency management.

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inspection plan (control plan) that defines the inspection operations, characteristics, sampling procedures, and acceptance criteria to be executed for this lot. Aligns with SAP QM inspection plan assignment.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Provides lot‑to‑order‑line traceability for compliance, recall management, and accurate shipping documentation.

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) record created as a result of this inspection lot's non-conformance or reject disposition. Enables traceability from inspection event to corrective action workflow.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order associated with this inspection lot, applicable for customer-specific inspection requirements, pre-shipment inspections, or RMA receipt inspections. Links quality execution to order fulfillment.

attributes.name: primary_inspection_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or part master record subject to this inspection lot. Links to the product/material master in SAP MM/PLM for BOM and specification retrieval.

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the goods receipt document (SAP material document) that triggered this incoming inspection lot. Applicable for inspection types 01 (GR from PO) and 04 (GR from Production Order). Enables traceability from inspection to inventory movement.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing/production order that triggered this inspection lot, applicable for in-process and final inspection types. Links quality execution to production scheduling in SAP PP / Siemens Opcenter MES.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order associated with this inspection lot, applicable for incoming goods receipt inspections from suppliers. Links to SAP MM purchasing documents.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote_line. Business justification: Inspection lots are created for the specific quoted product line; linking provides traceability from inspection to sales quotation.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.request. Business justification: Defect‑driven service request creation after inspection lot; required for corrective‑action workflow.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Required for inbound inspection traceability: each inspection lot must reference the shipment that delivered the material, used in the Goods Receipt Inspection Report.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Inspection lot must be linked to the physical storage location for traceability in the warehouse inspection process, required by ISO 9001 audit.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor master record from whom the material was received, applicable for incoming inspection lots. Enables supplier quality performance tracking and audit.

attributes.name: wip_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.wip_lot. Business justification: Each inspection lot validates a WIP lot; linking enables lot‑by‑lot quality traceability.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production cell where the in-process inspection is performed. Applicable for in-process and milestone inspection types. Links to SAP PP work center master.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number of the material being inspected, as recorded in SAP batch management. Enables traceability from inspection results back to the specific production batch for recall and genealogy purposes.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the quality certificate or Certificate of Conformance (CoC) issued for this inspection lot upon acceptance. Supports customer documentation requirements and regulatory compliance traceability.

attributes.name: certificate_of_conformance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Conformance (CoC) or quality certificate must be generated and issued upon acceptance of this inspection lot. Driven by customer contract requirements or regulatory mandates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this inspection lot record was first persisted in the data platform (Silver layer). Used for data lineage and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects or non-conformances detected across all inspection characteristics within this lot. Used for defect rate calculation, SPC analysis, and NCR triggering thresholds.

attributes.name: disposition_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the quality engineer or authorized personnel who recorded the usage decision and disposition for this inspection lot. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: SAP QM usage decision code (e.g., A1=Accept, R1=Reject, R2=Rework, S1=Scrap) providing a standardized coded classification of the disposition decision for system processing and reporting.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: Final disposition decision made upon completion of inspection results evaluation. Determines the fate of the inspected material: 'accept' = material released to stock/use; 'reject' = material blocked/returned; 'rework' = material sent for corrective rework; 'scrap' = material scrapped; 'conditional_release' = accepted with documented deviations/concessions.

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the usage decision (disposition) was formally recorded in the quality management system. Marks the closure of the active inspection phase and triggers downstream stock posting or NCR creation.

attributes.name: dynamic_modification_rule
attributes.description: Code or name of the dynamic modification rule applied to automatically adjust the inspection level (normal/tightened/reduced/skip) based on cumulative quality history for this material-supplier or material-plant combination. Aligns with SAP QM dynamic modification.

attributes.name: inspection_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all inspection activities and results recording were completed for this lot. Combined with inspection_start_timestamp to compute inspection cycle time (Lead Time metric).

attributes.name: inspection_level

attributes.name: sample_drawing_procedure

attributes.name: device_registry_id

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: equipment_register_id

attributes.name: inspection_characteristic_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master inspection characteristic definition (e.g., dimension, hardness, visual attribute) as configured in the inspection plan. Enables aggregation of results across lots for SPC analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id

attributes.name: line_id

attributes.name: material_master_id

attributes.name: measurement_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific gauge, instrument, or measurement device used (e.g., caliper serial number, CMM probe ID). Supports gauge R&R studies, calibration traceability, and MSA compliance.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing production order associated with the inspected batch or lot. Enables traceability from quality result back to the production execution event.

attributes.name: project_header_id

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing work center or production cell where the inspection was performed. Supports OEE and quality-by-location analysis.

attributes.name: attribute_result

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number of the material being inspected. Enables full traceability from quality result to production batch for recall management and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the measurement device used for this inspection must next be calibrated. Captured at time of measurement to flag results obtained with overdue equipment, supporting ISO/IEC 17025 traceability requirements.

attributes.name: characteristic_type

attributes.name: cp_index

attributes.name: cpk_index
attributes.description: Process capability index Cpk measuring the ratio of the nearest specification limit to the process mean, accounting for process centering. Cpk ≥ 1.33 is typically required for PPAP approval. Key metric for supplier quality and process performance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection result record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking per lakehouse governance requirements.

attributes.name: defect_code

attributes.name: defect_count

attributes.name: defect_description

attributes.name: inspection_date

attributes.name: inspection_method

attributes.name: is_out_of_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measurement triggered an SPC out-of-control signal (e.g., point beyond control limits, run rule violation per Western Electric rules). Distinct from out-of-spec: a process can be in-spec but out-of-control. Triggers SPC investigation workflow.

attributes.name: is_out_of_spec

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: The lower statistical process control limit for the characteristic, typically set at ±3 sigma from the process mean. Used in SPC X-bar and R charts to detect process shifts.

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: The lower engineering specification limit for the characteristic. Measurements below this value are out-of-specification. Used in Cp/Cpk calculation and SPC control chart setup.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual numeric measurement recorded for a variable inspection characteristic (e.g., 24.987 mm for a diameter). Null for attribute-type characteristics. Core data point for SPC charting and Cp/Cpk calculation.

attributes.name: ncr_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised as a result of this inspection finding. Populated when result_status is 'rejected' or attribute_result is 'fail'. Links the inspection result to the NCR and CAPA workflow.

attributes.name: nominal_value
attributes.description: The engineering design target or nominal value for the characteristic as specified in the drawing or specification. Used to calculate deviation from target and for SPC centering analysis.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility where the inspection was performed. Enables multi-plant quality benchmarking and regulatory reporting by site.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks or observations entered by the inspector at the time of measurement. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields, such as environmental conditions, equipment anomalies, or visual observations.

attributes.name: result_status

attributes.name: sampling_procedure

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the individual unit inspected, where serialized traceability is required (e.g., high-value assemblies, safety-critical components). Null for non-serialized bulk materials.

attributes.name: shift_code

attributes.name: spc_chart_type

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this inspection result record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: The upper statistical process control limit for the characteristic, typically set at ±3 sigma from the process mean. Triggers investigation when exceeded even if within specification. Used in SPC X-bar and R charts.

Drives inventory posting in SAP MM.

products.name: ncr
products.description: Non-Conformance Report (NCR) serving as the single, unified quality event record for ALL deviations from specifications, standards, or requirements regardless of detection source or reporting channel. Encompasses internal defects, customer complaints (including 8D problem-solving), supplier non-conformances, field returns/RMA dispositions, and audit-triggered findings. Captures non-conformance type (internal/customer/supplier/field-return/audit), affected material/product/serial number, detection source (incoming inspection, in-process, final inspection, field/customer, audit, supplier delivery), severity classification, containment actions, root cause analysis, disposition decision (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return-to-supplier, repair, replace, credit, no-fault-found), RMA tracking fields (return authorization number, customer reference, repair actions, return shipment status), SAP QM notification type mapping (Q1/Q2/Q3), and linkage to CAPA for corrective/preventive action. Supports 8D methodology for customer-facing issues. Aligned with ISO 9001 clause 8.7 (control of nonconforming outputs), clause 10.2 (corrective action), and integrates with Salesforce Service Cloud for customer-originated events.

attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the NCR record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

products.name: capa
products.description: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record managing the full lifecycle of quality improvement actions triggered by NCRs, audit findings, customer complaints, or internal quality events. Tracks root cause analysis (5-Why, Ishikawa), corrective action plan, preventive action plan, responsible owner, target dates, verification of effectiveness, and closure status per ISO 9001 clause 10.2.
products.reference: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) / ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record. Primary key for the capa data product in the quality domain.

attributes.name: automation_change_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.automation_change_request. Business justification: CAPA actions frequently result in automation change requests; linking supports the CAPA‑Change Request impact analysis.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: CAPA actions are often triggered by defects in a particular component; linking enables root‑cause tracking and corrective action reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Corrective action implementation costs are allocated to a cost center; finance tracks CAPA expenses for effectiveness evaluation.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer associated with this CAPA when triggered by a customer complaint, field failure, or warranty claim. Links to the customer account for customer-facing quality reporting and Salesforce CRM integration.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: Assigns corrective actions to the specific asset needing remediation, essential for CAPA tracking and effectiveness verification.

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) that triggered this CAPA. Establishes the traceability link between the nonconformity detection record and the corrective action response.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person accountable for driving the CAPA to closure, including root cause analysis, action planning, and effectiveness verification. Sourced from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: primary_capa_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the quality manager or authorized approver who formally approved the CAPA closure after verifying effectiveness. Required for ISO 9001 audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: Ensures CAPA actions are tied to the specific procurement contract governing the supplier, required for contract compliance audits.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: CAPA actions arising from a project’s quality issues must be tracked against the project to monitor impact on schedule and cost.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: CAPA initiatives often stem from regulatory findings; linking to the requirement clarifies the regulatory driver of the corrective action.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: CAPA actions address root causes of defects on a particular product SKU; linking provides product‑centric corrective action tracking.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier associated with this CAPA when the root cause is attributed to a supplied material, component, or service. Links to the supplier master for supplier quality performance tracking via SAP Ariba.

attributes.name: action_implementation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the corrective and/or preventive actions were fully implemented in the production process or quality system. Marks the transition from planning to execution phase.

attributes.name: actual_closure_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the CAPA was formally closed after successful verification of effectiveness. Null if the CAPA is still open. Used to calculate actual cycle time versus target.

attributes.name: affected_process_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing process, work center, or production routing step where the nonconformity was detected or originated. Sourced from SAP PP routing or Siemens Opcenter MES process definition.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CAPA was formally approved for closure by the authorized quality approver. Represents the final lifecycle milestone before the record is archived.

attributes.name: capa_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the CAPA record, typically formatted as CAPA-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in communications, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Sourced from SAP QM notification numbering.

attributes.name: capa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CAPA record. Tracks progression from initial creation through root cause analysis, action implementation, effectiveness verification, and formal closure per ISO 9001 Clause 10.2.

attributes.name: capa_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the action is corrective (addressing an existing nonconformity), preventive (eliminating a potential nonconformity), or both. Drives workflow routing and reporting in SAP QM.

attributes.name: containment_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which all immediate containment actions were completed and verified. Used to measure response speed and compliance with customer-mandated containment timelines.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the permanent corrective actions planned to eliminate the root cause of the nonconformity and prevent recurrence. Includes process changes, design modifications, procedure updates, or training interventions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was first created in the quality management system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer was formally notified of the nonconformity and the corrective action plan. Null if customer notification is not required or has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer must be formally notified of the nonconformity and the corrective action taken. Driven by customer contract requirements, product safety implications, or regulatory obligations.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department or cost center responsible for the process or area where the nonconformity originated. Used for departmental quality KPI reporting and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Order (ECO) raised in Siemens Teamcenter PLM as a result of this CAPA, when the corrective action requires a design or BOM modification.

attributes.name: effectiveness_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the effectiveness of the implemented actions was formally verified and documented. Required for CAPA closure per ISO 9001 Clause 10.2.

attributes.name: effectiveness_verification_method
attributes.description: Description of the method used to verify that the implemented corrective and preventive actions were effective in eliminating the root cause and preventing recurrence. May include SPC monitoring, re-audit, production run data review, or customer feedback analysis.

attributes.name: effectiveness_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corrective and preventive actions have been formally verified as effective. True when verification is complete and documented; False when verification is pending or failed. Required gate for CAPA closure.

attributes.name: immediate_containment_action
attributes.description: Description of the short-term containment actions taken immediately upon detection of the nonconformity to prevent further defective product from reaching the customer or next process step. Corresponds to D3 in the 8D methodology.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the CAPA was formally opened and initiated. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the CAPA lifecycle. Used to calculate cycle time and compliance with response time SLAs.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the CAPA record. Used for change detection in incremental data pipeline loads and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Summary of key lessons learned from the CAPA investigation and resolution that should be shared across the organization to prevent similar issues. Feeds into the knowledge management and APQP process for future product launches.

attributes.name: n8d_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal 8D (Eight Disciplines) problem-solving report associated with this CAPA, if applicable. Used when customer-mandated 8D reporting is required, particularly in automotive and industrial OEM supply chains.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility or site where the nonconformity occurred or where the CAPA is being executed. Enables site-level quality performance reporting.

attributes.name: ppap_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA requires a new or revised Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submission due to process or design changes resulting from the corrective action. Relevant for automotive and industrial OEM supply chains.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Impact Flag

attributes.name: preventive_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of proactive actions planned to eliminate the causes of potential nonconformities before they occur. Addresses systemic risks identified during root cause analysis that may affect similar processes or products.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the CAPA based on risk severity, customer impact, regulatory exposure, or recurrence frequency. Drives escalation timelines and resource allocation.

attributes.name: problem_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nonconformity, defect, or quality event that triggered the CAPA. Includes observed symptoms, affected product or process, and initial impact assessment. Corresponds to the problem statement in the 8D or CAPA methodology.

attributes.name: quality_standard_reference
attributes.description: The specific quality standard clause, regulatory requirement, or customer specification that was violated or is being addressed by this CAPA. Examples: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2, IATF 16949, customer-specific quality requirements.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA addresses a recurring nonconformity that has been previously reported. True if the same or similar root cause has been identified in a prior CAPA. Used for chronic problem identification and escalation.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA has regulatory reporting implications, such as mandatory notification to ISO certification bodies, OSHA, EPA, or CE/UL certification authorities. Triggers compliance escalation workflow when True.

attributes.name: related_capa_number
attributes.description: Business identifier of a previously closed or open CAPA that addresses the same or similar root cause. Supports recurrence tracking and systemic quality trend analysis.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_method
attributes.description: The structured methodology used to identify the root cause of the nonconformity. Common methods include 5-Why, Ishikawa (fishbone) diagram, 8D problem solving, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), fault tree analysis, or Pareto analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 5_why|ishikawa|8d|fmea|fault_tree|pareto|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause using the 6M Ishikawa framework: Man (human error), Machine (equipment), Material (raw material/component), Method (process/procedure), Measurement (inspection/calibration), or Environment (facility/conditions). Enables systemic trend analysis.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the identified root cause(s) of the nonconformity as determined through the root cause analysis. This is the foundational finding that drives the corrective action plan.

attributes.name: source_reference_number
attributes.description: The identifier of the originating document or record that triggered this CAPA, such as an NCR number, audit finding reference, customer complaint ticket number, or SAP QM notification number. Enables traceability back to the triggering event.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Category of the triggering event that initiated the CAPA. Indicates whether the CAPA originated from a Non-Conformance Report (NCR), customer complaint, internal or external audit finding, shop floor quality event, supplier quality issue, or regulatory inspection finding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ncr|customer_complaint|audit_finding|internal_quality_event|supplier_issue|regulatory_finding|field_failure|warranty_claim — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: The planned date by which all corrective and preventive actions must be implemented and verified as effective. Used for on-time closure KPI tracking and escalation management.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the quality problem or improvement opportunity addressed by this CAPA. Used in dashboards, reports, and management reviews.

products.name: fmea
products.description: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) master record covering both DFMEA (Design FMEA) and PFMEA (Process FMEA). Stores failure modes, effects, causes, current controls, severity/occurrence/detection ratings, Risk Priority Number (RPN), recommended actions, and revised RPN after action implementation. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and aligned with AIAG-VDA FMEA methodology.

attributes.name: fmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) ID
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the FMEA record. Primary key for the fmea data product in the quality domain.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) ID

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated CAPA record initiated as a result of this FMEA recommended action. Links the FMEA to the formal corrective action management process in SAP QM or the quality management system.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or OEM for whom this FMEA is being prepared. Customer-specific FMEA requirements (e.g., Ford, GM, Stellantis CSRs) may impose additional rating criteria or documentation standards.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: FMEA analyses are part of a product launch project; associating them with the project header ensures risk assessments are visible in project status reports.

attributes.name: quality_ppap_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PPAP submission package that includes this FMEA as a required deliverable. The FMEA is a mandatory PPAP element per AIAG PPAP 4th Edition. Links quality analysis to the formal part approval process.

attributes.name: responsible_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: FMEA requires a designated owner; linking to employee allows tracking of accountability and effectiveness verification.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing process or process step being analyzed in a PFMEA. Links to the process routing or operation master in Siemens Opcenter MES or SAP S/4HANA PP. Applicable primarily for PFMEA type records.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or component that is the subject of this FMEA analysis. Links the FMEA to the product master record managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier responsible for the component or sub-process being analyzed, when the FMEA covers a supplier-provided item. Links to the supplier master in SAP Ariba or SAP S/4HANA MM for supplier quality management purposes.

attributes.name: action_priority
attributes.description: AIAG-VDA Action Priority classification (High, Medium, Low) assigned to the failure mode based on the combination of Severity, Occurrence, and Detection ratings. Replaces the legacy RPN-only prioritization approach introduced in the 2019 AIAG-VDA FMEA Handbook. Core AIAG-VDA Step 7 field.

attributes.name: action_taken
attributes.description: Description of the actual corrective or preventive action implemented to address the failure mode. Documents what was done versus what was recommended, enabling traceability for PPAP and audit purposes. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recommended action was actually implemented and verified as complete. Compared against target_completion_date to measure action closure timeliness. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FMEA was formally reviewed and approved by the responsible engineering and quality authority. Required for PPAP submission and regulatory compliance documentation. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the FMEA record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: current_detection_controls
attributes.description: Description of existing design verification or process monitoring controls that detect the failure mode or cause before the product reaches the customer. Examples include inspection plans, SPC monitoring, functional testing, and CMM measurement. Core AIAG-VDA Step 7 field.

attributes.name: current_prevention_controls
attributes.description: Description of existing design or process controls that prevent the failure cause from occurring or reduce the occurrence rate. Examples include design standards, material specifications, process parameters, and mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) devices. Core AIAG-VDA Step 6 field.

attributes.name: detection_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating (1–10) assessing the ability of current controls to detect the failure cause or failure mode before the product reaches the customer. A rating of 10 indicates no detection capability; 1 indicates near-certain detection. Core AIAG-VDA Step 7 field.

attributes.name: failure_cause
attributes.description: Root cause or mechanism that leads to the failure mode. Describes the specific design weakness, process deficiency, or material condition that initiates the failure (e.g., 'insufficient weld penetration', 'incorrect torque specification'). Core AIAG-VDA Step 4 field.

attributes.name: failure_effect
attributes.description: Description of the consequence of the failure mode on the customer, end user, or downstream process. Defines what the customer experiences when the failure occurs (e.g., 'loss of function', 'noise', 'injury risk'). Core AIAG-VDA Step 4 field.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: The specific manner in which the item, component, or process step could potentially fail to perform its intended function. Represents the physical or chemical description of the failure (e.g., 'fracture', 'short circuit', 'dimensional out-of-tolerance'). Core AIAG-VDA Step 4 field.

attributes.name: fmea_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable document control number assigned to the FMEA record in Siemens Teamcenter PLM. Used for cross-referencing in engineering change orders (ECOs), PPAP packages, and APQP deliverables.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Number

attributes.name: fmea_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the FMEA document within the Siemens Teamcenter PLM workflow. Controls whether the FMEA is editable, under review, formally released for production use, or retired.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Status

attributes.name: fmea_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Type
attributes.description: Classification of the FMEA by analysis scope: DFMEA (Design FMEA) evaluates design-related failure modes; PFMEA (Process FMEA) evaluates manufacturing process failure modes; SFMEA (System FMEA) evaluates system-level interactions; MFMEA (Machinery FMEA) evaluates equipment failure modes. Aligned with AIAG-VDA methodology.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Type

attributes.name: function_description
attributes.description: Description of the intended function or purpose of the item, component, or process step being analyzed. Defines what the element is supposed to do under normal operating conditions. Core AIAG-VDA Step 3 field.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FMEA analysis was formally initiated or first created. Marks the start of the FMEA lifecycle and is used for APQP timing and project milestone tracking. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of the FMEA. FMEAs must be reviewed and updated when design or process changes occur, when field failures are reported, or on a scheduled basis per the quality management system. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: occurrence_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating (1–10) estimating the likelihood or frequency of the failure cause occurring. A rating of 10 indicates near-certain occurrence; 1 indicates extremely unlikely. Based on historical failure data, process capability (Cp/Cpk), or engineering judgment. Core AIAG-VDA Step 6 field.

attributes.name: part_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the part, component, or process step being analyzed. Corresponds to the item description in the Bill of Materials (BOM) or process routing.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Engineering part number or material number of the component or assembly being analyzed in the FMEA. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM or Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM. Used to cross-reference PPAP and APQP documentation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility or production site where the process or product being analyzed is produced. Used to scope the FMEA to a specific production location and align with site-specific process controls.

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: Name or description of the specific manufacturing process step or operation being analyzed in a PFMEA (e.g., 'Welding Station 3', 'CNC Milling Op 20'). Derived from the process routing in SAP S/4HANA PP or Siemens Opcenter MES.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Proposed corrective or preventive action to reduce the severity, occurrence, or detection rating of the failure mode. Drives CAPA initiation and engineering change orders (ECOs). Core AIAG-VDA Step 8 field.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the failure mode is associated with a regulatory compliance requirement (e.g., CE Marking, UL certification, EPA, OSHA). Failure modes with this flag require documented evidence of control effectiveness in regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: revised_action_priority
attributes.description: Updated AIAG-VDA Action Priority (High, Medium, Low) recalculated after implementation of the recommended action. Confirms whether the residual risk level is acceptable or requires further action.

attributes.name: revised_detection_rating
attributes.description: Updated detection rating (1–10) after implementation of the recommended action. Reflects improved detection capability resulting from new controls, inspection methods, or monitoring systems. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: revised_occurrence_rating
attributes.description: Updated occurrence rating (1–10) after implementation of the recommended action. Reflects the reduced likelihood of the failure cause occurring following corrective action. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: revised_rpn
attributes.description: Recalculated Risk Priority Number (Revised S × Revised O × Revised D) after implementation of the recommended action. Used to verify that the corrective action achieved the desired risk reduction. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: revised_severity_rating
attributes.description: Updated severity rating (1–10) after implementation of the recommended action. Severity typically does not change unless a design change eliminates the failure effect. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field for post-action re-evaluation.

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Document revision identifier (e.g., A, B, C, 01, 02) tracking the version history of the FMEA in Siemens Teamcenter PLM. Incremented upon each approved change to the FMEA content.

attributes.name: rpn
attributes.description: Risk Priority Number calculated as the product of Severity × Occurrence × Detection ratings (S × O × D). Ranges from 1 to 1000. Used to prioritize failure modes for corrective action. Higher RPN indicates greater risk requiring immediate attention. Stored as a business-critical field per AIAG-VDA methodology.

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the failure mode has a safety-critical or regulatory compliance impact (severity rating 9 or 10). Safety-critical failure modes require mandatory escalation, special controls, and PPAP documentation. Aligned with OSHA and CE Marking requirements.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Description of the boundaries and scope of the FMEA analysis, including what is included and excluded from the analysis. Defines the system boundary, interfaces, and assumptions. Required for AIAG-VDA Step 2 (Structure Analysis).

attributes.name: severity_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating (1–10) assessing the seriousness of the failure effect on the customer or downstream process. A rating of 10 indicates a safety-critical or regulatory non-compliance failure; 1 indicates no discernible effect. Defined per AIAG-VDA severity evaluation criteria. Core AIAG-VDA Step 5 field.

attributes.name: special_characteristic_code
attributes.description: Designation indicating whether the failure mode relates to a special product or process characteristic requiring enhanced control. SC = Special Characteristic; CC = Critical Characteristic; KPC = Key Product Characteristic; KCC = Key Control Characteristic. Drives control plan and inspection plan requirements.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the recommended action must be implemented and verified. Used for action tracking and escalation management in the FMEA review cycle. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of cross-functional team members who participated in the FMEA analysis session. Typically includes representatives from design engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier quality. Required for AIAG-VDA Step 1 documentation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the FMEA document identifying the product, component, or process being analyzed. Used for search, retrieval, and display in PLM and quality management systems.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the FMEA record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental load processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: control_plan
products.description: Manufacturing control plan defining the process controls, inspection frequency, measurement methods, reaction plans, and control limits for each critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristic at each process step. Links to PFMEA and inspection plans. Core APQP deliverable managed per AIAG standards and ISO 9001 clause 8.5.

attributes.name: control_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the control plan record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key.

attributes.name: control_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.control_system. Business justification: Control plans prescribe parameters for a specific control system; required for the Control Plan‑to‑System configuration audit.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Implementation and maintenance costs of control plans are charged to a cost center, supporting cost‑of‑quality accounting.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Control plans are defined per customer requirements; linking to customer_account enables traceability of customer‑driven control specifications.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: Binds control plans to the exact equipment they govern, supporting process control and audit compliance.

attributes.name: fmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) ID
attributes.description: Reference to the PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) record from which this control plan characteristic was derived. Ensures traceability between risk analysis and process controls per AIAG APQP linkage requirements.

tag_set.value: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) ID

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP QM inspection plan or characteristic catalog entry that operationalizes this control plan characteristic on the shop floor. Links the APQP control plan to the executable inspection instructions.

attributes.name: measurement_system_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific calibrated measurement instrument or gauge asset record in Maximo Asset Management used to measure this characteristic. Enables calibration status verification and MSA traceability.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Control plans are created within a product development project; linking to project header enables integrated project‑quality tracking and audit of plan status.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Control plans ensure processes meet defined regulations; linking to the requirement provides explicit compliance traceability.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Control plans are owned by a responsible engineer; the link enables responsibility reporting and compliance checks.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Control Plan records the supplier responsible for a characteristic; linking enables supplier performance tracking and compliance reporting (Control Plan – Supplier Responsibility report).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the authorized approver (typically Quality Manager or Engineering Manager) who formally approved this control plan revision. Required for ISO 9001 document control compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this control plan revision was formally approved. Provides the authoritative approval event timestamp for document control audit trails and PPAP submission packages.

attributes.name: characteristic_class
attributes.description: Classification of the quality characteristic by its impact on safety, regulatory compliance, or fit/function. Critical (safety/regulatory impact), Significant (functional impact), Major (customer-noticeable), Minor (cosmetic). Drives inspection frequency and reaction plan severity.
