attributes.name: characteristic_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the quality characteristic being controlled (e.g., 'Weld Bead Width', 'Torque Value', 'Surface Roughness Ra'). Directly corresponds to the CTQ characteristic defined in the PFMEA.

attributes.name: characteristic_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the specific quality characteristic within the process step of this control plan row. Enables precise referencing of individual CTQ (Critical-to-Quality) characteristics.

attributes.name: characteristic_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the characteristic is measured on a variable (continuous numeric) or attribute (pass/fail, go/no-go) scale. Determines the applicable SPC (Statistical Process Control) methodology and control chart type.

attributes.name: control_method
attributes.description: The process control technique applied to monitor and control this characteristic (e.g., 'SPC X-bar/R Chart', 'Pre-control Chart', 'Poka-yoke', 'Visual Standard', 'Attribute Control Chart', 'Process Parameter Monitoring'). Core APQP deliverable field.

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is a prevention control (prevents the defect from occurring) or a detection control (detects the defect after it has occurred). Aligns with PFMEA prevention/detection control columns.

attributes.name: cpk_minimum_required
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable Cpk (Process Capability Index) value required for this characteristic to be considered capable. Typically 1.33 for production and 1.67 for critical/safety characteristics per AIAG PPAP requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under ISO 9001 document control and data lineage tracking in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this revision of the control plan becomes active and must be followed on the shop floor. Aligns with the ECO/ECN implementation date in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: error_proofing_method
attributes.description: Description of the poka-yoke or error-proofing device/method applied at this process step to prevent or detect non-conformances (e.g., 'Torque monitoring with automatic shutdown', 'Vision system barcode verification', 'Fixture limit switch'). Reduces reliance on operator inspection.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this control plan revision expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended plans. Used to enforce periodic review cycles mandated by ISO 9001 and customer-specific requirements.

attributes.name: gauge_type
attributes.description: Type or category of measurement instrument or gauge used for this characteristic (e.g., 'Vernier Caliper', 'CMM', 'Go/No-Go Gauge', 'Torque Tester', 'Vision System'). Used for gauge calibration scheduling and MSA planning.

attributes.name: is_ctq
attributes.description: Indicates whether this characteristic is designated as Critical-to-Quality (CTQ), meaning it directly impacts customer satisfaction, safety, or regulatory compliance. CTQ characteristics receive enhanced monitoring and are mandatory in PPAP submissions.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this characteristic is controlled to meet a specific regulatory or certification requirement (e.g., CE Marking, UL, IEC 62443, EPA, OSHA). Drives mandatory retention of inspection records for regulatory audit purposes.

attributes.name: is_safety_characteristic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this characteristic is classified as a safety-critical characteristic (SC) per customer-specific requirements or regulatory mandates. Safety characteristics require 100% inspection or validated error-proofing (poka-yoke) and special PPAP documentation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this control plan record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance in the silver layer.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: The lower statistical process control limit (LCL) for the SPC control chart associated with this characteristic. Calculated as the process mean minus three standard deviations. Triggers reaction plan when breached.

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: The lower engineering specification limit (LSL) for the quality characteristic. Measurements below this value are considered non-conforming. Used in Cp/Cpk process capability index calculations.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Description of the measurement technique or method used to evaluate the characteristic (e.g., 'CMM dimensional measurement', 'Torque wrench with digital readout', 'Visual inspection per drawing'). Supports Measurement System Analysis (MSA) traceability.

attributes.name: nominal_value
attributes.description: The target or nominal engineering specification value for the quality characteristic (e.g., 25.00 mm, 45 Nm). Used as the center point for control limit calculations and SPC charting.

attributes.name: part_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the part, assembly, or product family covered by this control plan. Supports reporting and cross-referencing without requiring a join to the product master.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The engineering part number or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the product or component to which this control plan applies. Sourced from Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SAP MM material master.

attributes.name: part_revision
attributes.description: Engineering drawing or design revision level of the part at the time this control plan was created or last revised. Ensures traceability between the control plan and the specific design iteration it governs.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the control plan document, typically formatted as CP-<part/process code>-<sequence>. Used for cross-referencing in APQP packages, PPAP submissions, and SAP QM inspection plans.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control plan document. Drives whether the plan is actively used on the shop floor. Managed through the document control workflow in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Phase classification of the control plan per AIAG APQP methodology: prototype (early design validation), pre-launch (pilot/trial production), or production (full-rate manufacturing). Determines the rigor and scope of controls applied.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code identifying the manufacturing facility or site where this control plan is applicable. Supports multi-plant deployments where the same part may be produced at different locations with potentially different controls.

attributes.name: process_step_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the manufacturing process step or operation (e.g., 'Welding', 'CNC Machining', 'Final Assembly Inspection'). Provides human-readable context for the control being defined.

attributes.name: process_step_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for the manufacturing process step or operation within the control plan (e.g., 10, 20, 30). Aligns with the process flow diagram and PFMEA step numbering per AIAG standards.

attributes.name: reaction_plan
attributes.description: Prescribed corrective actions to be taken when the process goes out of control or a non-conformance is detected for this characteristic (e.g., 'Stop production, quarantine last 2 hours output, notify quality engineer, initiate NCR'). Mandatory APQP control plan field.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric revision level of the control plan document (e.g., A, B, 01, 02). Incremented each time the plan is formally revised via an Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN).

attributes.name: sample_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency or trigger condition for performing the inspection (e.g., 'Every 2 hours', 'Every 50 pieces', 'First-off and last-off', 'Each lot', '100% inspection'). Defines the inspection cadence on the shop floor.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of parts or units to be measured per inspection event for this characteristic. Defined per statistical sampling plan (e.g., ANSI/ASQ Z1.4, Z1.9) or engineering judgment. Drives inspection workload planning.

attributes.name: spc_chart_type
attributes.description: Type of SPC (Statistical Process Control) control chart applied to monitor this characteristic. Determines the statistical rules and control limit formulas used. Applicable only when control_method includes SPC. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: xbar_r|xbar_s|individuals_mr|p_chart|np_chart|c_chart|u_chart — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the characteristic's nominal value and specification limits (e.g., mm, Nm, MPa, °C, %). Aligns with SAP MM unit of measure codes and ISO 80000 international measurement standards.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: The upper statistical process control limit (UCL) for the SPC control chart associated with this characteristic. Calculated as the process mean plus three standard deviations. Triggers reaction plan when exceeded.

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: The upper engineering specification limit (USL) for the quality characteristic. Measurements exceeding this value are considered non-conforming. Used in Cp/Cpk process capability index calculations.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: SAP PP/MES work center or machine group code where this process step is performed. Links the control plan to the physical shop floor location and equipment for execution tracking in Siemens Opcenter MES.

products.name: ppap_submission
products.description: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submission package record tracking the 18 PPAP elements required for new or changed part approval. Captures submission level, part number, customer, design record, process flow, PFMEA, control plan, measurement system analysis (MSA), initial process capability study, sample parts, and overall submission status. Aligned with AIAG PPAP 4th Edition.
products.reference: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) AIAG 4th Edition

attributes.name: ppap_submission_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ppap_submission

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.capa. Business justification: PPAP submission can trigger a CAPA; add FK to capture this relationship.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: PPAP submission costs (testing, documentation) are allocated to a cost center for product launch cost analysis.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account requiring PPAP approval for this part. Links to the customer master in Salesforce CRM or SAP SD. Represents the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: PPAP submissions are a milestone in new‑product projects; linking to project header allows automatic inclusion in project milestone tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: psw_authorized_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Psw Authorized By Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: PSW authorization is performed by a qualified employee; the FK supports PPAP audit trails and regulatory reporting.

tag_set.value: Psw Authorized By Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: PPAP submissions must be traceable to the purchase order for the part, required for customer acceptance and audit trails.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: PPAP submissions are submitted for a particular product SKU; FK enables traceability of approval status per SKU.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or manufacturing site submitting the PPAP package. Relevant when the submission originates from a sub-tier supplier. Links to the supplier master in SAP Ariba.

attributes.name: annual_production_volume
attributes.description: Estimated annual production volume (number of parts per year) declared on the Part Submission Warrant. Used by the customer to assess production capacity and process capability requirements.

attributes.name: appearance_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the Appearance Approval Report (AAR) for parts with appearance requirements (PPAP Element 12). Indicates whether the part's color, grain, gloss, and surface finish have been approved by the customer.

attributes.name: apqp_phase
attributes.description: APQP phase during which this PPAP submission was initiated. PPAP is typically completed in APQP Phase 4 (Product and Process Validation). Provides traceability to the broader APQP program.

attributes.name: bulk_material_checklist_status
attributes.description: Completion status of the Bulk Material Requirements Checklist (PPAP Element 13), applicable for bulk/raw material submissions. Confirms all regulatory and customer-specific material requirements have been addressed.

attributes.name: checking_aids_status
attributes.description: Status of checking aids (gauges, fixtures, templates) used for part inspection (PPAP Element 14). Confirms that all required checking aids are available, calibrated, and documented.

attributes.name: control_plan_number
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Control Plan included in the PPAP package. PPAP Element 6. The control plan defines inspection and monitoring activities for production. Traceable to SAP QM inspection plan.

attributes.name: cpk_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum Cpk value recorded across all critical and significant characteristics in the initial process capability study. Used to assess whether the process meets the customer's capability requirements (typically Cpk ≥ 1.67 for new processes).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the PPAP submission record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation event. Populated automatically by the quality management system.

attributes.name: customer_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer issued the formal PPAP disposition (approved, conditionally approved, or rejected). Null if disposition has not yet been received.

attributes.name: customer_approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer's quality representative or engineer who reviewed and issued the formal PPAP disposition. Recorded for audit trail and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: The customer's own part number or drawing number for the submitted component, used for cross-reference between the manufacturer's and customer's part identification systems.

attributes.name: customer_specific_requirements_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether all customer-specific requirements (PPAP Element 15) have been addressed in the submission. Customers may have additional requirements beyond the standard AIAG PPAP elements.

attributes.name: design_record_number
attributes.description: Document number of the design record (drawing, CAD model, or specification) that defines the part requirements. PPAP Element 1. Traceable to Siemens Teamcenter PLM document management.

attributes.name: dimensional_results_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the dimensional inspection results (PPAP Element 10) indicating whether all measured dimensions conform to the design record tolerances. Pass = all characteristics within tolerance; Fail = one or more out of tolerance; Conditional = deviations accepted with customer concession.

attributes.name: imds_submission_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Material Data System (IMDS) Submission ID
attributes.description: Submission identifier in the International Material Data System (IMDS) for material composition reporting. Required for automotive and industrial parts to comply with REACH, RoHS, and ELV regulations. PPAP Element 13 supporting document.

tag_set.value: International Material Data System (IMDS) Submission ID

attributes.name: initial_process_study_number
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Initial Process Capability Study (Preliminary Process Capability) included in the PPAP package. PPAP Element 8. Contains Cp/Cpk indices for critical characteristics.

attributes.name: interim_approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of a conditional or interim PPAP approval granted by the customer. Production is authorized only until this date, after which a full approval or resubmission is required. Null if disposition is full approval or rejection.

attributes.name: is_safety_critical_part
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the submitted part is classified as safety-critical, requiring enhanced PPAP scrutiny, additional testing, and regulatory compliance documentation. Safety-critical parts may require higher PPAP submission levels.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the PPAP submission record. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and change tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: manufacturing_process_description
attributes.description: Brief description of the key manufacturing processes used to produce the part (e.g., CNC machining, injection molding, stamping, welding). Summarizes the process flow documented in the PPAP element.

attributes.name: manufacturing_site
attributes.description: Name or code of the manufacturing plant or facility where the part is produced. Used to identify the production location for the PPAP submission, as tracked in SAP MM plant master.

attributes.name: material_test_results_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material and Functional Test Results Status
attributes.description: Overall status of material and functional test results (PPAP Element 11) confirming that the part meets all material specifications and functional performance requirements defined in the design record.

tag_set.value: Material and Functional Test Results Status

attributes.name: msa_study_number
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Measurement System Analysis (MSA) study included in the PPAP package. PPAP Element 7. Validates the measurement systems used for inspection. Aligns with AIAG MSA 4th Edition.

attributes.name: part_name
attributes.description: Human-readable description or name of the part or assembly being submitted for PPAP approval, as recorded in the design record.

attributes.name: part_revision_level
attributes.description: Engineering change revision level of the part at the time of PPAP submission, as tracked in the design record and PLM system. Ensures the submission corresponds to the correct design iteration.

attributes.name: pfmea_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) Number
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) included in the PPAP package. PPAP Element 5. Identifies the PFMEA document in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

tag_set.value: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) Number

attributes.name: production_run_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of parts produced during the significant production run used to generate PPAP samples and process capability data. Typically a minimum of 300 consecutive pieces per AIAG requirements.

attributes.name: psw_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier's authorized representative signed the Part Submission Warrant (PSW), certifying the completeness and accuracy of the PPAP submission package.

attributes.name: psw_disposition
attributes.description: Customer's formal disposition recorded on the Part Submission Warrant (PSW), the cover document of the PPAP package. Approved = full production authorization; Interim Approval = conditional authorization with defined expiry; Rejected = resubmission required.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status of the part's compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., REACH, RoHS, CE Marking, UL certification) as documented in the PPAP package. Ensures the submission addresses all relevant regulatory conformance obligations.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason(s) for PPAP rejection or conditional approval issued by the customer. Populated when submission_status is 'rejected' or psw_disposition is 'rejected'. Used to drive corrective actions.

attributes.name: resubmission_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which a corrected PPAP package must be resubmitted to the customer following a rejection or conditional approval. Agreed between supplier and customer quality teams.

attributes.name: sample_quantity
attributes.description: Number of sample parts produced from the production run and submitted to the customer as part of the PPAP package. PPAP Element 9. AIAG typically requires a minimum of 300 consecutive pieces for initial process studies.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed PPAP package was formally submitted to the customer for review and approval. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: submission_level
attributes.description: AIAG-defined PPAP submission level (1 through 5) indicating the extent of documentation and samples required by the customer. Level 1 = Part Submission Warrant only; Level 5 = Full submission retained at manufacturing site.

attributes.name: submission_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special conditions associated with the PPAP submission. May include customer-specific instructions, deviations, or open action items.

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the PPAP submission package, typically assigned by the quality management system (SAP QM) or PLM system. Used for cross-system traceability and customer communication.

attributes.name: submission_reason
attributes.description: Reason triggering the PPAP submission as defined by AIAG. Indicates whether the submission is for a new part, an engineering change order (ECO), tooling change, process change, supplier change, or material change. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_part|engineering_change|tooling_change|process_change|supplier_change|material_change|correction|resubmission — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PPAP submission package. Tracks progression from draft preparation through customer review to final disposition (approved, conditionally approved, or rejected). Aligns with SAP QM inspection lot status.

attributes.name: tooling_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the production tooling (mold, die, fixture) used to manufacture the submitted parts. Relevant for tooling-related PPAP submissions and tracked in the asset management system (Maximo).

products.name: supplier_quality_audit
products.description: Supplier quality audit record documenting scheduled and unscheduled audits conducted at supplier facilities or remotely. Captures audit type (system, process, product), audit scope, checklist results, findings, major/minor non-conformances, audit score, corrective action requirements, and re-audit schedule. Supports SAP Ariba supplier qualification and ISO 9001 clause 8.4 supplier control.

attributes.name: supplier_quality_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the supplier quality audit record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: audit_checklist_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized audit checklist template used during the audit. Links to the checklist master record defining the questions and scoring criteria.

attributes.name: audit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit plan or program under which this audit was scheduled. Links to the audit planning record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Audit expenses are charged to a cost center; finance needs this link for supplier audit cost reporting.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee record of the lead auditor in Workday HCM, enabling workforce analytics and auditor qualification tracking.

attributes.name: previous_audit_supplier_quality_audit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding audit record for this supplier, enabling audit history chaining and trend analysis across audit cycles.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: Links audit findings to the relevant procurement contract, supporting contract‑based supplier performance evaluation.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier organization being audited. Links to the supplier master record in SAP Ariba.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the audit was completed. Used to calculate audit duration and measure schedule adherence.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the audit commenced. May differ from planned start date due to scheduling changes or supplier availability.

attributes.name: audit_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit was a planned/scheduled event, an unscheduled/reactive audit triggered by quality issues, a follow-up to a previous audit, or a re-audit after corrective actions.

attributes.name: audit_duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of working days spent conducting the audit, including on-site or remote sessions. Used for resource planning and audit program management.

attributes.name: audit_method
attributes.description: Delivery method of the audit: on-site visit to the supplier facility, remote/virtual audit conducted electronically, or hybrid combining both approaches.

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the audit, used in correspondence with the supplier and in regulatory documentation. Format: SQA-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: audit_objective
attributes.description: Stated purpose and objectives of the audit, such as initial supplier qualification, periodic surveillance, PPAP readiness assessment, or post-NCR verification.

attributes.name: audit_report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or URL/path to the formal audit report stored in the document management system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SharePoint).

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Overall qualification outcome of the audit. Approved indicates full conformance; conditionally approved requires corrective actions within a defined period; not approved disqualifies the supplier; suspended places the supplier on hold pending investigation.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the audit scope, including the processes, product lines, facilities, and quality management system elements covered during the audit.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Overall numerical score assigned to the supplier based on audit checklist results, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used for supplier qualification decisions and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: audit_standard
attributes.description: The quality management standard or framework against which the supplier is being audited (e.g., ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, AS9100). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISO 9001|IATF 16949|ISO 14001|ISO 45001|AS9100|VDA 6.3 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier quality audit. Tracks progression from planning through execution to closure.

attributes.name: audit_team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of names or employee IDs of additional audit team members who participated in the audit alongside the lead auditor.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit by its primary focus: system audit (management system evaluation), process audit (manufacturing process evaluation), product audit (product conformance evaluation), or combined.

attributes.name: capa_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Due Date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the supplier must submit their CAPA plan in response to audit non-conformances. Typically 30–90 days from audit report issuance.

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Due Date

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit findings require the supplier to submit a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan. True when major or critical non-conformances are identified.

attributes.name: capa_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CAPA process associated with this audit. Tracks the lifecycle from initial requirement through supplier submission, review, acceptance, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_required|pending|submitted|under_review|accepted|rejected|closed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: capa_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Submission Date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the supplier submitted their CAPA plan. Used to measure supplier responsiveness and track on-time CAPA compliance.

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Submission Date

attributes.name: confidentiality_agreement_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a non-disclosure or confidentiality agreement was signed by the audit team prior to conducting the audit at the supplier facility.

attributes.name: conforming_items_count
attributes.description: Number of checklist items where the supplier demonstrated full conformance to the requirement. Used in audit score computation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supplier quality audit record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of key audit findings, including strengths, weaknesses, and areas of concern identified during the audit. Captured in the formal audit report.

attributes.name: iso_9001_clause_coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 9001:2015 clauses evaluated during the audit (e.g., '4.1,5.1,6.1,8.4,9.1'). Enables gap analysis against the full standard.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the supplier quality audit record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead auditor responsible for planning, executing, and reporting the supplier quality audit.

attributes.name: major_ncr_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the audit. A major NCR indicates a significant failure to meet a requirement that could result in product non-conformance or system breakdown.

attributes.name: minor_ncr_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformances identified during the audit. A minor NCR indicates a partial failure or isolated lapse that does not immediately threaten product quality.

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: Number of observations or opportunities for improvement noted during the audit that do not constitute formal non-conformances but warrant supplier attention.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled end date for the audit as defined in the audit plan.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled start date for the audit as defined in the audit plan. Used for resource planning and supplier notification.

attributes.name: ppap_assessment_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Assessment Included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) readiness or compliance assessment was included as part of this audit scope.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Assessment Included

attributes.name: re_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up re-audit is required to verify the effectiveness of corrective actions taken by the supplier.

attributes.name: re_audit_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the follow-up re-audit to verify corrective action effectiveness. Populated only when re_audit_required is True.

attributes.name: report_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal audit report was issued to the supplier. Used to track reporting timeliness and trigger corrective action deadlines.

attributes.name: supplier_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary supplier representative or quality manager who participated in the audit on behalf of the supplier organization.

attributes.name: supplier_facility_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the supplier facility location where the audit was conducted.

attributes.name: supplier_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific supplier facility or plant location where the audit was conducted or to which the remote audit applies.

attributes.name: supplier_qualification_level
attributes.description: Supplier qualification tier assigned or updated as a result of this audit outcome. Drives procurement decisions in SAP Ariba and SAP MM sourcing.

attributes.name: total_checklist_items
attributes.description: Total number of checklist items or audit questions evaluated during the audit. Used as the denominator for scoring calculations.

products.name: customer_complaint
products.description: Customer complaint and field quality issue record capturing reported defects, failures, or dissatisfaction from OEM customers, distributors, or end users. Tracks complaint description, affected product/serial number, failure mode, 8D problem-solving steps, containment actions, root cause, corrective actions, and customer response. Integrates with Salesforce Service Cloud and SAP QM QN.
products.reference: 8D Problem Solving / SAP QM Quality Notification (QN)

attributes.name: customer_complaint_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the customer complaint record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record created to address the root cause of this complaint. Links complaint to the CAPA management process.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (OEM, distributor, or end user) who submitted the complaint. Links to the customer domain.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific contact person at the customer organization who reported the complaint.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Links complaints to the precise order line, enabling root‑cause analysis and targeted corrective actions.

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.ncr. Business justification: Customer Complaint may stem from an NCR; link complaint to NCR for traceability.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Customer complaints are linked to the originating purchase order to identify supplier responsibility in complaint handling process.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Regulatory‑reportable customer complaints must be tied to the specific regulation they impact for compliance tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Each customer complaint is assigned to a responsible engineer; linking enables root‑cause tracking and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: sales_order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Complaints are investigated against the exact order intake that generated the sale, supporting root‑cause analysis.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.request. Business justification: Customer complaint often leads to a service request for on‑site resolution; enables complaint‑to‑service traceability.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Customer complaint investigations require the originating shipment to assess handling, used in the Complaint Root‑Cause Analysis report.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Customer complaints reference the affected product SKU; FK enables complaint analysis and warranty reporting per SKU.

attributes.name: affected_batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number of the affected product. Critical for batch recall analysis, SPC investigation, and supplier quality correlation.

attributes.name: affected_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the specific unit reported in the complaint. Enables unit-level traceability through manufacturing, shipping, and field service records.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the complaint was formally closed following customer acceptance of the resolution and verification of corrective action effectiveness.

attributes.name: complaint_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the customer complaint including observed symptoms, conditions of failure, and customer-reported impact. Corresponds to SAP QM QN Problem Description field.

attributes.name: complaint_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable complaint reference number used in customer communications and SAP QM Quality Notification (QN). Format: CC-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: complaint_source
attributes.description: Origin channel or party type from which the complaint was received. Supports segmentation of complaint volumes by customer tier.

attributes.name: complaint_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the complaint record. Drives escalation, SLA tracking, and reporting. 'pending_customer' indicates awaiting customer feedback or approval.

attributes.name: complaint_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable summary title of the complaint as entered by the quality engineer or service representative. Used in dashboards and notification emails.

attributes.name: complaint_type
attributes.description: Categorization of the complaint by nature of the issue. Used for trend analysis, routing, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_defect|field_failure|delivery_issue|documentation_error|safety_concern|performance_deviation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: containment_action
attributes.description: Immediate containment action taken to prevent further defective product from reaching the customer, corresponding to Step D3 of the 8D problem-solving methodology. Includes field holds, sorting, or shipment stops.

attributes.name: containment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the containment action was implemented. Used to measure response speed and SLA compliance for initial containment.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the permanent corrective action was fully implemented and verified effective.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the permanent corrective action selected and implemented to eliminate the root cause, corresponding to 8D Steps D5 (select) and D6 (implement). May trigger an Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN).

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the permanent corrective action must be implemented and verified. Used for SLA tracking and escalation management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this complaint record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Status of the customer's acceptance of the proposed resolution or 8D corrective action response. Determines whether the complaint can be formally closed.

attributes.name: customer_order_number
attributes.description: SAP SD sales order number associated with the delivery of the affected product. Links complaint to order fulfillment and revenue impact analysis.

attributes.name: customer_response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal response (e.g., 8D report, corrective action plan) was communicated to the customer. Used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: defect_location
attributes.description: Physical location or component area on the product where the defect or failure was observed. Supports PFMEA and design engineering root cause analysis.

attributes.name: eight_d_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal 8D (Eight Disciplines) problem-solving report issued to the customer. Required by many OEM customers as part of complaint resolution documentation.

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code from the quality defect code catalog identifying the failure mode. Used for statistical analysis and SPC trending. Corresponds to SAP QM defect code.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Specific manner in which the product or component failed as identified during complaint investigation. Aligned with FMEA failure mode taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for standardized failure mode codes]

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this complaint must be reported to a regulatory authority (e.g., OSHA, EPA, UL, CE Marking body). Triggers compliance workflow and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complaint involves a potential safety hazard to personnel or end users. Triggers mandatory escalation to product safety and regulatory teams per OSHA and CE Marking requirements.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility where the affected product was produced. Enables complaint analysis by production site.

attributes.name: preventive_action_description
attributes.description: Description of systemic preventive actions taken to prevent recurrence of similar complaints across other products or processes, corresponding to 8D Step D7.

attributes.name: production_order_number
attributes.description: SAP production order number under which the affected product was manufactured. Enables traceability to shop floor execution records in Siemens Opcenter MES.

attributes.name: quantity_complained
attributes.description: Number of units reported as defective or non-conforming in the complaint. Used for severity assessment and potential recall scope estimation.

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: Number of units physically returned by the customer under a Return Material Authorization (RMA). May differ from quantity complained if partial returns occur.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the complaint was received and logged in the system. Used for SLA response-time measurement.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer formally reported or submitted the complaint. Used as the principal business event date for SLA and aging calculations.

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: Type of resolution provided to the customer. Drives financial impact tracking (credit notes, replacements) and customer satisfaction measurement.

attributes.name: rma_number
attributes.description: Return Material Authorization number issued to the customer for physical return of defective units. Links complaint to logistics return process.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized category of the identified root cause. Enables Pareto analysis of complaint drivers across design, process, material, and supplier dimensions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: design|process|material|supplier|handling|measurement|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the verified root cause of the complaint, corresponding to Step D4 of the 8D methodology. May reference 5-Why analysis, fishbone diagram, or PFMEA findings.

attributes.name: salesforce_case_number
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier from Salesforce Service Cloud case record linked to this complaint, enabling traceability between CRM and quality management systems.

attributes.name: sap_qn_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Quality Management (QM) Quality Notification (QN) Number
attributes.description: SAP QM Quality Notification number corresponding to this complaint, used for traceability within SAP S/4HANA QM module.

tag_set.value: SAP Quality Management (QM) Quality Notification (QN) Number

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the complaint based on customer impact, safety risk, and regulatory implications. Drives escalation rules and response SLA targets. Aligned with FMEA severity ranking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this complaint record.

products.name: spc
products.description: Statistical Process Control (SPC) chart configuration and monitoring record defining chart type (X-bar R, X-bar S, p-chart, c-chart, u-chart, CUSUM, EWMA), monitored characteristic, associated process/work center, control limits (UCL, LCL, CL), specification limits (USL, LSL), subgroup size, sampling frequency, Western Electric/Nelson rule configuration, and process capability indices (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk). Stores SPC violation events and out-of-control signals as detail records including violation type, timestamp, operator response, and corrective action taken. Drives real-time SPC monitoring on the shop floor via Siemens Opcenter MES integration.

attributes.name: spc_id
attributes.description: Primary key for spc

attributes.name: control_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.control_plan. Business justification: SPC chart is defined for a specific Control Plan; replace string reference with FK.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Statistical process control monitoring incurs expenses; linking SPC charts to cost center enables SPC cost tracking.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: SPC charts are generated from data of a specific machine; linking enables equipment‑level capability monitoring.

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP QM inspection plan or Opcenter MES inspection specification that governs the characteristic being monitored by this SPC chart.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or product being monitored by this SPC chart. Links to SAP MM material master. Enables product-specific SPC analysis and capability reporting.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific manufacturing operation or process step within the routing where this SPC chart monitors quality. Links to SAP PP routing operations and Opcenter MES operation definitions.

attributes.name: tag_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.tag_definition. Business justification: Each SPC chart monitors a specific tag/parameter defined in Tag Definition; essential for SPC‑Tag mapping in quality dashboards.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing work center or production line where this SPC chart is applied. Aligns with SAP PP work center master data and Siemens Opcenter MES resource definitions.

attributes.name: active_rule_set
attributes.description: Identifies the specific set of out-of-control detection rules configured for this chart. Determines which pattern tests are evaluated during real-time monitoring in Siemens Opcenter MES.

attributes.name: auto_recalculate_limits
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system should automatically recalculate control limits when a specified number of new subgroups have been collected. Supports dynamic SPC limit management in Siemens Opcenter MES.

attributes.name: baseline_sample_count
attributes.description: Number of subgroups used to establish the initial control limits (UCL, LCL, CL) during the chart setup phase. Typically a minimum of 25 subgroups is required per ANSI/ASQ standards to ensure statistically valid control limits.

attributes.name: capability_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk indices were last calculated and recorded. Used to determine whether capability data is current and whether recalculation is required per the control plan review cycle.

attributes.name: center_line
attributes.description: The process mean or grand average used as the center line of the SPC chart. Represents the expected process level when in statistical control. For X-bar charts this is the grand mean; for p-charts this is the average proportion nonconforming.

attributes.name: characteristic_criticality
attributes.description: Criticality classification of the monitored characteristic based on its impact on product safety, function, or regulatory compliance. Critical characteristics (safety/regulatory) require tighter capability targets (Cpk ≥ 1.67). Aligns with DFMEA/PFMEA severity ratings.

attributes.name: characteristic_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality characteristic or process parameter being monitored (e.g., 'Shaft Outer Diameter', 'Surface Roughness Ra', 'Weld Tensile Strength', 'Solder Joint Void Percentage'). Aligns with the inspection characteristic in SAP QM.

attributes.name: characteristic_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the monitored characteristic is a variable (continuous measurement, e.g., dimension, weight, temperature) or an attribute (discrete count/proportion, e.g., pass/fail, defect count). Determines applicable chart types.

attributes.name: chart_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the SPC chart, identifying the monitored characteristic and process (e.g., 'Shaft Diameter X-bar R — Line 3 CNC'). Used in operator dashboards and quality reports.

attributes.name: chart_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the SPC chart, used on shop floor documentation and in Siemens Opcenter MES. Follows the plant-defined numbering convention (e.g., SPC-WC001-00042).

attributes.name: chart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SPC chart configuration. Active charts are live on the shop floor; suspended charts are temporarily halted; archived charts are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: chart_type
attributes.description: Type of Statistical Process Control (SPC) chart used for monitoring. Determines the statistical method applied: X-bar R (variables, small subgroups), X-bar S (variables, large subgroups), p-chart (proportion nonconforming), c-chart (count of defects, constant area), u-chart (defects per unit, variable area), CUSUM (cumulative sum), EWMA (exponentially weighted moving average). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: xbar_r|xbar_s|p_chart|c_chart|u_chart|cusum|ewma — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: control_limit_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the control limits for this SPC chart. Standard is 3-sigma (99.73% confidence); 2-sigma may be used for warning limits; probability-based limits are used for non-normal distributions; custom allows manually specified limits.

attributes.name: cp_index
attributes.description: Process capability index Cp measuring the ratio of the specification tolerance width to the process spread (6-sigma). Indicates the potential capability of the process assuming it is centered. Cp ≥ 1.33 is typically required for critical characteristics per AIAG PPAP.

attributes.name: cpk_index
attributes.description: Process capability index Cpk measuring the actual process capability accounting for process centering. Represents the minimum of (USL - mean)/(3σ) and (mean - LSL)/(3σ). Cpk ≥ 1.33 is the standard acceptance threshold for critical characteristics per AIAG PPAP.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SPC chart configuration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5 for documented information control.

attributes.name: cusum_decision_interval
attributes.description: Decision interval (h) for CUSUM charts, representing the threshold at which the CUSUM statistic triggers an out-of-control signal. Typically set to 4 or 5 times the process standard deviation. Applicable only when chart_type = 'cusum'. Null for other chart types.

attributes.name: cusum_reference_value
attributes.description: Reference value (k) for Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) charts, representing the allowable slack or reference value used in the CUSUM statistic calculation. Typically set to half the shift magnitude to be detected. Applicable only when chart_type = 'cusum'. Null for other chart types.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this SPC chart configuration is valid and active on the shop floor. Supports versioning of SPC configurations following engineering changes (ECO/ECN) or process improvements.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date until which this SPC chart configuration is valid. Null for open-ended configurations. Populated when a chart is superseded by a new version following an Engineering Change Order (ECO) or process revision.

attributes.name: ewma_lambda
attributes.description: Smoothing parameter (λ) for Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) charts, ranging from 0 to 1. Lower values give more weight to historical data (better for detecting small shifts); higher values give more weight to recent data. Applicable only when chart_type = 'ewma'. Null for other chart types.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this SPC chart configuration record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Statistically derived lower control limit for the SPC chart, calculated as the process mean minus three standard deviations (3-sigma) or equivalent. Signals an out-of-control condition when breached. May be zero or null for attribute charts where negative values are not meaningful.

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: Engineering lower specification limit for the monitored characteristic as defined in the product drawing, design specification, or customer requirement. Distinct from the statistical LCL. Used to calculate process capability indices (Cp, Cpk).

attributes.name: min_cpk_required
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable Cpk value required for this characteristic as specified by the customer, engineering, or quality standard. Typically 1.33 for standard characteristics and 1.67 for critical/safety characteristics per AIAG PPAP requirements.

attributes.name: nelson_rules_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Nelson rules (8 rules for detecting non-random patterns) are active for this SPC chart in addition to or instead of Western Electric rules. Nelson rules extend WECO with additional run and trend tests.

attributes.name: out_of_control_action_plan
attributes.description: Reference to or description of the Out-of-Control Action Plan (OCAP) that operators must follow when an SPC violation is detected. Defines the escalation path, containment actions, and notification requirements.

attributes.name: pp_index
attributes.description: Process performance index Pp calculated using the overall (long-term) standard deviation rather than the within-subgroup standard deviation. Used in PPAP submissions to assess long-term process performance potential.

attributes.name: ppap_submission_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Submission Level
attributes.description: PPAP submission level associated with this SPC characteristic, indicating the depth of documentation required for customer approval. Level 3 (full submission) is the default; levels 1–5 vary by customer requirement.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Submission Level

attributes.name: ppk_index
attributes.description: Process performance index Ppk measuring actual long-term process performance accounting for both process spread and centering using overall standard deviation. Used alongside Cpk in PPAP submissions and ongoing process monitoring.

attributes.name: recalculation_trigger_count
attributes.description: Number of new subgroups that must be collected before an automatic recalculation of control limits is triggered. Applicable only when auto_recalculate_limits is true. Null otherwise.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier for the SPC chart configuration, incremented when control limits, specification limits, or chart parameters are updated following an Engineering Change Order (ECO) or process improvement event.

attributes.name: sampling_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which subgroup samples are collected for SPC monitoring, expressed as a time interval or production quantity (e.g., 'every 30 minutes', 'every 50 parts', 'every batch'). Defined in the inspection plan and control plan.

attributes.name: sampling_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the sampling interval in minutes, used for automated scheduling in Siemens Opcenter MES and for SPC monitoring dashboards. Null if sampling is quantity-based rather than time-based.

attributes.name: subgroup_size
attributes.description: Number of individual measurements collected per subgroup sample for the SPC chart. Determines the applicable control chart constants (A2, D3, D4, B3, B4) and the statistical power of the chart. Typically 2–10 for X-bar R charts.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The nominal or target value for the monitored characteristic, typically the midpoint between USL and LSL or as specified by engineering. Used in CUSUM and EWMA chart calculations and for Cpk asymmetry analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the monitored characteristic (e.g., mm, µm, kg, °C, %, N/mm²). Applies to variable characteristics. Aligns with SAP QM inspection characteristic unit of measure.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Statistically derived upper control limit for the SPC chart, calculated as the process mean plus three standard deviations (3-sigma) or equivalent for the chart type. Signals an out-of-control condition when exceeded. Stored as a computed configuration value.

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: Engineering upper specification limit for the monitored characteristic as defined in the product drawing, design specification, or customer requirement. Distinct from the statistical UCL. Used to calculate process capability indices (Cp, Cpk).

attributes.name: western_electric_rules_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Western Electric (WECO) sensitizing rules for detecting non-random patterns are active for this SPC chart. When true, the chart evaluates all four Western Electric zone tests in addition to the basic 3-sigma rule.

products.name: quality_audit
products.description: Quality audit record documenting all scheduled and unscheduled audits regardless of target — internal departments, supplier facilities, subcontractor sites, or customer-mandated assessments. Captures audit type (system audit, process audit, product audit, layered process audit), target scope (internal department/process, supplier site, subcontractor, remote), audit program/schedule reference, checklist criteria and results, findings classification (major non-conformance, minor non-conformance, observation, opportunity for improvement), audit score/rating, auditor qualification and independence verification, evidence collected, corrective action requirements with CAPA linkage, re-audit schedule, and closure status. Supports ISO 9001 clause 9.2 (internal audit), clause 8.4 (externally provided processes — supplier control), VDA 6.3 process audit methodology, and SAP Ariba supplier qualification workflows.

attributes.name: quality_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality audit record. Primary key for the audit entity.

attributes.name: audit_checklist_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit checklist or audit criteria template used to guide the audit and document conformance.

attributes.name: audit_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annual or periodic audit program under which this audit was scheduled, linking to the master audit schedule and risk-based audit planning.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the lead auditor responsible for planning, conducting, and reporting the audit.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal department being audited if the audit is an internal audit. Null for external audits.

attributes.name: previous_audit_quality_audit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous audit of the same entity, enabling audit history tracking and trend analysis.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier master record if the audit is a supplier audit. Null for internal or customer audits.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the audit was completed, including closing meeting and final observations.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the audit commenced, which may differ from the planned start date due to scheduling changes.

attributes.name: audit_category
attributes.description: Categorization of the audit by the relationship to the audited party: internal (own departments/processes), external supplier (supplier facilities), external subcontractor (subcontractor sites), external customer (customer-mandated), certification (third-party certification body), surveillance (ongoing certification monitoring), or special (triggered by incident or complaint). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal|external_supplier|external_subcontractor|external_customer|certification|surveillance|special — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: audit_method
attributes.description: The method by which the audit is conducted: on-site (physical presence at audited location), remote (virtual audit via video/document sharing), hybrid (combination of on-site and remote), or document review (desk audit of documentation only).

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the audit, externally visible and used for tracking and reference across systems and documentation.

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Overall result or conclusion of the audit: conforming (no major issues), non-conforming (major issues found), conditional pass (minor issues requiring follow-up), fail (critical issues), acceptable, or unacceptable.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the audit scope, including the processes, departments, product lines, or ISO clauses covered. Defines the boundaries and focus areas of the audit.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit: planned (in audit program), scheduled (dates confirmed), in progress (audit underway), report draft (findings being documented), report issued (formal report distributed), CAPA pending (corrective actions awaited), CAPA verification (actions being verified), closed (audit complete and verified), or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|scheduled|in_progress|report_draft|report_issued|capa_pending|capa_verification|closed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit by its focus area: system audit (QMS compliance), process audit (manufacturing process conformance per VDA 6.3), product audit (finished goods verification), layered process audit (LPA short-interval checks), supplier audit (external provider assessment), or customer audit (customer-mandated assessment).

attributes.name: audited_entity_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the audited entity location.

attributes.name: audited_entity_location
attributes.description: Physical location or address of the audited entity, including city, state/province, and country.

attributes.name: audited_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the department, supplier, facility, or site being audited.

attributes.name: audited_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of entity being audited: internal department, supplier facility, subcontractor site, customer site, manufacturing plant, warehouse, or laboratory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal_department|supplier|subcontractor|customer_site|manufacturing_plant|warehouse|laboratory — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auditee_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the auditee contact for audit coordination and communication.

attributes.name: auditee_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the audited entity responsible for coordinating the audit and providing access to information.

attributes.name: auditor_independence_verified

attributes.name: capa_due_date

attributes.description: Target date by which corrective and preventive actions must be completed and submitted for verification.

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Due Date

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether corrective and preventive actions are required based on the audit findings.

attributes.name: capa_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CAPA process: not required, pending (awaiting submission), submitted, under review, approved, rejected, verified (effectiveness confirmed), or closed. attributes.name: capa_submission_date

attributes.description: Actual date when the auditee submitted the CAPA plan or evidence of corrective actions taken.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit was formally closed after all findings were addressed, CAPAs verified, and re-audit (if required) completed.

attributes.name: conforming_items_count
attributes.description: Number of checklist items found to be in full conformance with the audit criteria.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total duration of the audit in days, calculated from actual start to actual end date.

attributes.name: evidence_collected
attributes.description: Description or reference to the objective evidence collected during the audit, such as documents reviewed, records examined, interviews conducted, and observations made.

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the audit findings, highlighting key non-conformances, observations, strengths, and areas for improvement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit record was last updated, supporting audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead auditor for quick reference and reporting.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_qualification
attributes.description: Certification or qualification held by the lead auditor, such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, VDA 6.3 Process Auditor, or internal auditor certification.

attributes.name: major_ncr_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the audit. Major NCRs represent significant deviations that affect the QMS effectiveness or product quality.

attributes.name: minor_ncr_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformances identified during the audit. Minor NCRs represent isolated or less significant deviations that do not critically impact the QMS.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Statement of the audit's purpose and intended outcomes, such as QMS conformance verification, process effectiveness assessment, supplier qualification, or compliance validation.

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: Number of observations or opportunities for improvement noted during the audit that do not constitute non-conformances but warrant attention.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled end date for the audit as defined in the audit program or audit plan.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled start date for the audit as defined in the audit program or audit plan.

attributes.name: re_audit_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a follow-up re-audit is required to verify the effectiveness of corrective actions or to address major non-conformances.

attributes.name: re_audit_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the follow-up re-audit to verify corrective action effectiveness.

attributes.name: report_document_reference
attributes.description: Document management system reference or file path to the formal audit report document.

attributes.name: report_issued_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal audit report was issued and distributed to relevant stakeholders.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numerical score or rating assigned to the audit based on conformance level, typically expressed as a percentage or on a defined scale (e.g., VDA 6.3 scoring).

attributes.name: standard
attributes.description: The quality standard or framework against which the audit is conducted, such as ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949, VDA 6.3, AS9100, ISO 13485, or customer-specific requirements.

attributes.name: team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of audit team member names or employee IDs participating in the audit alongside the lead auditor.

attributes.name: total_checklist_items
attributes.description: Total number of checklist items or audit criteria evaluated during the audit.

domains.name: asset
domains.description: Equipment and asset lifecycle management domain tracking physical assets, machinery maintenance (CMMS), preventive maintenance scheduling, TPM, work order execution, MTBF/MTTR analysis, downtime events, spare parts, condition monitoring, and CapEx asset registers via Maximo. Manages production equipment, PLCs, CNC machines, robotics, and facility infrastructure.

products.name: equipment_register
products.description: Master record of all physical assets and production equipment in the CapEx asset register, including CNC machines, PLCs, robotics, conveyors, HVAC, and facility infrastructure. Serves as the SSOT for equipment identity, classification, parent-child hierarchy (structural decomposition into sub-assemblies and components), installation details, manufacturer specifications, commissioning date, depreciation method, book value, current operational status, criticality ranking, and location assignment history (including transfer/relocation audit trail with origin, destination, reason, condition at transfer, and authorization reference). Sourced from Maximo Asset Management and SAP S/4HANA PM module.
products.reference: Maximo Asset / SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each equipment record in the CapEx asset register. Primary key for the equipment_register data product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Preferred Carrier Assignment process records the default carrier responsible for delivering each piece of equipment.

attributes.name: control_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.control_system. Business justification: Needed for Control System Allocation Dashboard that assigns each equipment asset to the control system that governs its operation.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: CAPITAL: Asset acquisition cost must be allocated to a cost center for budgeting, depreciation, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Asset Management – Ownership Report: tracks which customer owns each equipment for warranty, billing, and service contracts.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.drawing. Business justification: Regulatory audit requires each equipment to reference its engineering drawing for compliance verification.

attributes.name: engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.specification. Business justification: Quality control tracks equipment against its engineering specification to ensure performance and safety standards.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: DEPRECIATION: Each asset is tied to a GL account for posting depreciation expense in financial statements.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Capital asset procurement references a material master record; the link supports cost, valuation, and purchase‑order reporting across asset and inventory modules.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.plant. Business justification: Plant is the top‑level site entity. Adding plant_id to equipment_register provides a proper foreign key to the plant master and eliminates the free‑text plant_code column.

attributes.name: responsible_technician_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for the Maintenance Assignment Report, which tracks which technician is responsible for each equipment piece; essential for preventive maintenance planning and accountability.

attributes.name: service_engineer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.engineer. Business justification: Primary Service Engineer assignment for each equipment is required for warranty support and engineer workload balancing; used in service contract management.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Required for Asset Management reports that tie each physical equipment to its product master record for warranty, maintenance, and cost analysis.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Business process: Asset Receiving & Storage requires tracking which warehouse bin new equipment is stored in before installation, enabling inventory valuation and location reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Procurement process records primary equipment supplier for warranty and support contracts.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Broad category grouping for the asset used in CapEx asset register classification, depreciation policy assignment, and financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP fixed asset schedules.
attributes.value_regex: Production Equipment|Facility Infrastructure|Utility System|Safety System|Measurement and Test Equipment|IT and Automation

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset tag or equipment number assigned in the CapEx asset register and stamped on the physical asset. Corresponds to the Maximo Asset Number and SAP S/4HANA Equipment Number (PM module). Serves as the primary business identifier for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: asset_pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the preventive maintenance plan assigned to this equipment in SAP PM or Maximo. Links the asset to its scheduled maintenance cycles, task lists, and service intervals.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rated capacity value (e.g., 'units/hr', 'kg/hr', 'tonnes/day', 'cycles/min'). Required to correctly interpret and compare capacity figures across heterogeneous equipment types.

attributes.name: capex_asset_record_id
