Serves as the single source of truth for material identity and attributes referenced by all inventory transactions, stock balances, and planning processes across the enterprise.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material master record. Primary key for the material master data product.

attributes.name: hazardous_substance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.hazardous_substance. Business justification: Regulatory reporting of hazardous chemicals requires linking each material master to its hazardous substance record for REACH/OSHA compliance.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Linking materials to profit centers enables product‑level profitability reporting and budget planning.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Required for production planning and cost roll‑up reports that map inventory material to the SKU definition used in sales orders and cost accounting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Preferred supplier per material is required for MRP planning and procurement contracts; experts expect a default vendor_id on material_master.

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC classification for inventory management prioritization. A items are high-value requiring tight control, B items are moderate-value, C items are low-value with relaxed controls. Used for cycle counting frequency and safety stock strategies.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit in which the material is managed in inventory and production. Examples: EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter). All stock quantities are maintained in this unit.

attributes.name: batch_management_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires batch or lot tracking. When active, all inventory transactions must reference a batch number for full traceability and quality control.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and material lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for material valuation. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP. All prices and values are maintained in this currency.

attributes.name: dimension_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height dimensions. Examples: MM (millimeter), CM (centimeter), M (meter), IN (inch).

attributes.name: goods_receipt_processing_time_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Goods Receipt (GR) Processing Time in Days
attributes.description: Time required for quality inspection and goods receipt posting after physical delivery. Added to planned delivery time for total procurement lead time.

tag_set.value: Goods Receipt (GR) Processing Time in Days

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the material including all packaging. Used for logistics planning, freight calculation, and warehouse capacity management.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Classification of hazardous material type per UN/DOT regulations. Examples: flammable liquid, corrosive, toxic, oxidizer. Determines packaging, labeling, and shipping requirements.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is classified as hazardous. Triggers additional safety, handling, storage, and transportation requirements per OSHA and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the material. Used for storage bin assignment, handling equipment selection, and transportation planning.

attributes.name: inspection_setup_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether incoming goods require quality inspection before stock placement. Triggers QM (Quality Management) inspection lot creation at goods receipt.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Master Last Modified By User
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the material master record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

tag_set.value: Material Master Last Modified By User

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was last changed. Used for audit trail and change management tracking.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the material. Used for storage bin assignment, handling equipment selection, and transportation planning.

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Lot-sizing procedure code determining how procurement or production quantities are calculated. Examples: EX (exact order quantity), FX (fixed lot size), HB (lot-for-lot).

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original manufacturer or OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) of the material. Used for quality tracking, warranty claims, and supplier management.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original part number assigned by the manufacturer or OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer). Used for cross-referencing, procurement, and technical documentation.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Full textual description of the material including key characteristics, specifications, and usage. Used for identification and communication across procurement, production, and sales.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Hierarchical classification code grouping materials with similar characteristics for procurement, planning, and reporting purposes. Used in MRP (Material Requirements Planning) and purchasing strategies.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the material assigned by the enterprise. This is the externally-known SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code used across all systems and documentation.

attributes.name: material_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material master record. Controls whether the material can be procured, produced, or sold. Blocked materials cannot be used in new transactions.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material based on its role in the manufacturing and supply chain process. Determines procurement, production, and inventory management rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|semi_finished|finished_good|trading_good|spare_part|consumable|packaging_material|service — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: maximum_lot_size
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Constrained by storage capacity, shelf life, or supplier limitations.

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Driven by supplier MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) or production setup constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Remaining Shelf Life in Days
attributes.description: Minimum remaining shelf life required at goods receipt. Materials with less remaining shelf life are rejected. Ensures adequate usable life for production and customer delivery.

tag_set.value: Minimum Remaining Shelf Life in Days

attributes.name: moving_average_price
attributes.description: Weighted average cost per base unit of measure, recalculated with each goods receipt. Used when price control is set to moving average price.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure code controlling how the material is planned. Determines reorder point planning, forecast-based planning, or time-phased planning methods.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the material itself excluding packaging. Used for production planning, yield calculations, and material consumption tracking.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Expected lead time in days from order placement to goods receipt. Used by MRP to calculate order release dates. Includes supplier lead time and internal processing time.

attributes.name: price_control_indicator
attributes.description: Defines material valuation method. S = standard price (fixed cost), V = moving average price (recalculated with each goods receipt). Determines inventory valuation approach.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity unit for which the price is maintained. Example: if price is $100 per 1000 units, price unit is 1000. Allows fractional pricing for low-cost materials.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Defines whether the material is manufactured internally, purchased externally, or both. Controls MRP (Material Requirements Planning) logic and sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: product_hierarchy
attributes.description: Multi-level classification structure organizing materials into product families and categories. Used for sales reporting, forecasting, and product portfolio management.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers automatic replenishment. When stock falls below this level, MRP generates procurement proposals. Critical for JIT (Just In Time) inventory control.

attributes.name: safety_stock
attributes.description: Minimum inventory buffer maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Never falls below this level under normal planning. Used in safety stock optimization algorithms.

attributes.name: serial_number_profile
attributes.description: Configuration code defining serial number management requirements. Determines whether material requires unique serial number tracking for traceability, warranty, and asset management.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Shelf Life Expiration Period in Days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the material from production or goods receipt date. After this period, material expires and cannot be used. Critical for perishable materials and chemicals.

tag_set.value: Shelf Life Expiration Period in Days

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: Fixed valuation price per base unit of measure. Used when price control is set to standard price. Updated periodically through cost accounting processes.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for material storage. Examples: temperature range, humidity control, light protection, hazardous material segregation. Used for warehouse bin assignment and handling instructions.

attributes.name: temperature_conditions
attributes.description: Specific temperature range requirements for storage and transportation. Examples: ambient, refrigerated (2-8°C), frozen (-20°C), controlled room temperature (15-25°C).

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Accounting classification code linking material to general ledger accounts. Determines which GL (General Ledger) accounts are posted for inventory movements and consumption.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Physical volume occupied by the material. Used for warehouse space planning, container loading optimization, and transportation planning.

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume field. Examples: L (liter), M3 (cubic meter), GAL (gallon).

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross and net weight fields. Examples: KG (kilogram), LB (pound), TON (metric ton).

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width dimension of the material. Used for storage bin assignment, handling equipment selection, and transportation planning.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the material master record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

products.name: stock_balance
products.description: Current and period-end stock balance record capturing on-hand quantity by stock category (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked, in-transit, reserved) for each material at each storage location. Tracks valuation price, total stock value, last physical count date, and last movement date. Serves as the single source of truth for real-time stock position used by material planning, available-to-promise calculations, and inventory reporting across all facilities.

attributes.name: stock_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock balance record. Primary key for the stock balance entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost‑center accounting of on‑hand inventory supports internal cost reporting and variance analysis per production site.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Customer‑owned stock balances (e.g., VMI) need a FK to the customer account for reporting on on‑hand quantities per customer.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Stock balance includes inspection status; linking to the specific inspection lot enables detailed traceability for quality release decisions.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which this stock balance is maintained. Links to the material product in the Product Engineering domain.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.mrp_run. Business justification: INVENTORY RECONCILIATION: each stock balance snapshot is associated with the MRP run that calculated it.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where the stock is physically located. Links to the plant master data.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Project Material Reservation Report requires tracking inventory reserved for each project to ensure accurate cost allocation.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location within the plant where the material is stored. Links to storage location master data.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Consignment stock ownership must be tracked; vendor_id links stock_balance to the supplying vendor for liability and reporting.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification based on material value and consumption. A items are high-value/high-usage requiring tight control; B items are moderate; C items are low-value/low-usage with relaxed control.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for new orders or production, calculated as unrestricted quantity on hand minus reserved quantity. Used for Available-to-Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for batch-managed materials. Used for traceability and quality control. Null for non-batch-managed materials.

attributes.name: blocked_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason why stock is blocked from use. Examples include quality hold, pending investigation, customer return, damaged goods, regulatory hold. Null if stock is not blocked.

attributes.name: consignment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock is consignment stock owned by the supplier but held at the customer location. True for consignment stock; false for own stock.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stock balance record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the material should not be used due to shelf life limitations. Applicable for perishable materials, chemicals, and time-sensitive components. Null for non-expiring materials.

attributes.name: inventory_turnover_days
attributes.description: Average number of days this material remains in stock before being consumed or sold. Calculated as (quantity on hand / average daily usage). Used for inventory performance KPI tracking.

attributes.name: last_count_variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between book quantity and physical count quantity from the last inventory count. Positive values indicate surplus; negative values indicate shortage.

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction that decreased stock for this material at this location. Used for inventory turnover analysis.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction that increased stock for this material at this location. Used for inventory aging analysis.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed for this material at this location. Used to track count frequency and compliance.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stock balance record was last modified. Updated with each stock movement transaction. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when the material or batch was manufactured or produced. Used for traceability and shelf life calculations. Applicable for batch-managed materials.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Upper limit for stock quantity to prevent overstocking and excess inventory carrying costs. Used in inventory optimization and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: obsolete_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this material is classified as obsolete and should be phased out or written off. True if material is no longer used in production or sales.

attributes.name: period_end_snapshot_date
attributes.description: Date representing the period-end for which this stock balance snapshot was captured. Used for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end inventory reporting and financial close processes.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical quantity of material available in this storage location and stock category. Measured in the materials base unit of measure.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Stock level at which a replenishment order should be triggered. Calculated based on lead time demand and safety stock requirements.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material reserved for specific sales orders, production orders, or other commitments. Reduces available-to-promise quantity.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum stock level maintained as buffer against demand variability and supply disruptions. Used in MRP calculations and reorder point determination.

attributes.name: slow_moving_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this material is classified as slow-moving based on consumption patterns. True if no movement in the defined threshold period (e.g., 90 days).

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: Natural key or unique identifier from the source operational system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

attributes.name: special_stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of special stock scenarios. Standard is regular stock; consignment is supplier-owned; project stock is allocated to specific projects; sales order stock is customer-specific; subcontracting is at vendor location; returnable packaging is reusable containers.

attributes.name: stock_category
attributes.description: Classification of stock availability status. Unrestricted stock is available for use; quality inspection stock is pending QA approval; blocked stock cannot be used; in-transit stock is moving between locations; reserved stock is allocated to specific orders or production.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the stock balance record. Active indicates normal operations; frozen indicates temporary hold; blocked indicates quality or compliance issues; pending disposal indicates scheduled for write-off or scrap.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of material by its role in the production process. Raw material is input to production; WIP is work in progress; finished goods are ready for sale; semi-finished are intermediate products; spare parts support maintenance; packaging materials; MRO is maintenance, repair, and operations supplies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|wip|finished_goods|semi_finished|spare_parts|packaging|mro — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_stock_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the stock on hand, calculated as quantity on hand multiplied by valuation price. Used for inventory valuation reporting and balance sheet preparation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the quantity on hand. Examples include EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter), etc.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Financial accounting classification used to determine the general ledger accounts for inventory postings. Links material movements to specific GL accounts for financial reporting.

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation price. Typically the plant or company code currency.

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: Standard or moving average price used to value the stock for financial reporting. Price per base unit of measure.

attributes.name: vendor_batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number assigned by the supplier for purchased materials. Used for supplier traceability and quality issue resolution.

attributes.name: warehouse_bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, rack, or shelf location within the storage location where the material is physically stored. Used for warehouse picking and putaway operations.

products.name: lot_batch
products.description: Lot and batch master record for materials subject to batch management, capturing batch number, material reference, manufacturing date, expiry date, shelf life expiration date (SLED), batch status (unrestricted, restricted, blocked), origin plant, supplier batch number, and quality inspection results. Supports full lot traceability from raw material receipt through production and customer shipment per ISO 9001 and PPAP requirements.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot or batch record. Primary key for lot and batch master data tracking.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Regulated batch tracking often requires associating a batch with the specific customer that ordered it.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record that this lot or batch belongs to. Links to the material product for which batch management is enabled.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.plant. Business justification: Lot_batch records the originating plant; a foreign key enforces referential integrity.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order under which this batch was manufactured. Links batch to specific manufacturing execution records for full production traceability.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order under which this batch was procured from an external supplier. Applicable only to purchased materials and components.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Batch production in regulated industries (pharma, chemicals) is subject to specific regulatory requirements; linking batches to those requirements supports batch release compliance.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary storage location or warehouse where this batch is currently stored. Supports location-based inventory tracking and warehouse management.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who provided this batch for purchased materials. Null for internally manufactured batches. Supports supplier quality tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: The current unrestricted quantity of this batch available for use in production or shipment. Updated in real-time based on goods movements, consumption, and quality status changes.

attributes.name: batch_classification
attributes.description: The material type classification for this batch indicating its stage in the production process. Used for inventory segmentation and MRP planning logic.

attributes.name: batch_cost_amount
attributes.description: The total production or procurement cost for this batch in the company currency. Used for inventory valuation, cost of goods sold calculation, and financial reporting per IFRS/GAAP standards.

attributes.name: batch_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional information, special handling instructions, quality observations, or deviation notes specific to this batch. Used by production, quality, and warehouse personnel.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this specific lot or batch. This is the externally-known business identifier used across procurement, production, quality, and shipment processes.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the batch indicating its usability. Unrestricted: available for use; Quality Inspection: under QA review; Restricted: limited use with approval; Blocked: not available for use due to quality or compliance issues.

attributes.name: blocked_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of this batch that is blocked and not available for any use. Set when batch fails quality inspection or is subject to hold for investigation per CAPA or NCR processes.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who created this batch record. Audit field for accountability and data governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this batch record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the batch cost amount. Typically the company code currency for manufactured batches or purchase order currency for procured batches.

attributes.name: customer_batch_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this batch must be tracked and reported to customers on shipping documents and certificates of analysis. True when customer contracts require batch-level traceability.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the batch should not be used due to degradation, safety, or regulatory constraints. Applicable to materials with limited shelf life such as chemicals, adhesives, and perishable components.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date when this batch was received into inventory via goods receipt posting. Marks the start of inventory availability and shelf life tracking for purchased materials.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this batch contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and transportation per OSHA and EPA regulations. True for materials classified as dangerous goods.

attributes.name: last_goods_movement_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent goods movement transaction for this batch (receipt, issue, transfer, or adjustment). Used for inventory aging analysis and slow-moving stock identification.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this batch record. Audit field for accountability and change management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this batch record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this batch was produced or manufactured. Critical for shelf life calculation, expiry determination, and lot traceability per ISO 9001 and PPAP requirements.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin for this batch. Required for customs, trade compliance, and country-of-origin labeling.

attributes.name: quality_certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate number or document identifier for the quality certificate issued for this batch. Required for customer shipments and regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: quality_decision
attributes.description: The final quality decision for this batch based on inspection results. Accepted: meets all specifications; Rejected: fails quality criteria; Conditional: accepted with restrictions; Pending: awaiting inspection completion.

attributes.name: quantity_produced
attributes.description: The total quantity of material produced in this batch, expressed in the base unit of measure for the material. Used for inventory valuation and yield analysis.

attributes.name: restricted_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of this batch that is restricted and requires special approval for use. Typically set during quality inspection or when quality issues are identified.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_date
attributes.description: The calculated shelf life expiration date based on manufacturing date and material-specific shelf life duration. Used in SAP MM for automatic batch determination and FEFO (First Expired First Out) logic.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock types such as consignment stock, project stock, or customer stock. Used for specialized inventory management scenarios and ownership tracking.

attributes.name: supplier_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned by the supplier or vendor for raw materials and purchased components. Used for upstream traceability and supplier quality management.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity produced (e.g., KG for kilograms, EA for each, L for liters, M for meters). Aligns with material master UOM configuration.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The valuation type or split valuation indicator for this batch when multiple valuations exist for the same material (e.g., domestic vs. imported, new vs. refurbished). Used for financial accounting and cost segregation.

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement event including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, internal transfers between bins, returns, adjustments, write-offs, and scrapping. Captures movement type code, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination storage locations, plant, cost center, reference document (purchase order, production order, delivery, cost center), posting date, movement reason code, picker/operator assignment, and confirmation status. Serves as the single source of truth for all inventory transaction activity, supporting stock balance updates, audit trails, and material document history across all facilities.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Document (MSEG/MKPF) / Goods Movement

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each stock movement transaction. Primary key for the stock movement data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each inventory movement is charged to a cost center for activity‑based costing; the FK enables accurate cost allocation in the general ledger.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the customer when this movement is a goods issue for sales delivery or a return from customer.

attributes.name: delivery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the outbound delivery document when this movement is part of a shipment to customer.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the person who created or posted this stock movement transaction, supporting accountability and audit requirements.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Goods movements that trigger inspections must reference the inspection lot to associate movement data with inspection outcomes, used in compliance reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Goods‑issue movement must be tied to the invoicing event for revenue recognition and downstream reporting.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record representing the SKU, raw material, WIP component, or finished good that was moved.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the sales order when this movement is a goods issue for customer delivery.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.plant. Business justification: Stock movement occurs within a plant; adding plant_id enforces correct plant association.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the production order when this movement is a goods issue to manufacturing or a goods receipt from production.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Project material issue/receipt movements are reported in the Project Material Movement report for traceability.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the purchase order when this movement is a goods receipt from procurement.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Shipment‑movement reconciliation report requires tying each inventory posting to the originating shipment for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: source_stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Link stock movement to its source location for traceability; replace free‑text code with FK.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supplier when this movement is a goods receipt from external procurement.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number for batch-managed materials, enabling traceability for quality control, expiration management, and recall scenarios.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock movement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or warehouse location identifier to which the material was placed or moved.

attributes.name: destination_storage_location_code
attributes.description: For transfer movements, the receiving storage location to which the material was moved.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document (e.g., delivery note, production confirmation) that triggered this stock movement. May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this stock movement record was created in the system, capturing the moment of transaction entry.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account number to which the inventory value change is posted for financial accounting integration.

attributes.name: goods_issue_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this movement decreases inventory (goods issue scenario).

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this movement increases inventory (goods receipt scenario).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock movement record was last updated, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: material_document_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the material document, representing the sequence of this movement within a multi-line transaction.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP material document number that uniquely identifies this inventory movement transaction in the ERP system. This is the business identifier used for audit trails and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year of the material document posting, used in combination with material document number for unique identification in SAP systems.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The business material number (SKU) identifying the specific product, component, or raw material involved in this movement.

attributes.name: movement_indicator
attributes.description: High-level classification of the movement direction: receipt (inbound), issue (outbound), transfer (location-to-location), or adjustment (correction/write-off).

attributes.name: movement_reason_code
attributes.description: Code explaining the business reason for the movement (e.g., damaged goods, quality defect, process scrap, customer return, inventory correction). Used for root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock movement transaction: posted (completed and effective), pending (awaiting confirmation), cancelled (voided before posting), or reversed (corrected after posting).

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: Three-digit SAP movement type code that classifies the nature of the inventory transaction (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 261=Goods Issue to Production Order, 311=Transfer Posting, 551=Scrapping). This code determines the accounting impact and stock ledger behavior.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the stock movement was posted to the inventory ledger and became effective for stock balance and financial accounting purposes. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material moved in this transaction, expressed in the base unit of measure. Positive for receipts, negative for issues in some system configurations.

attributes.name: reference_document_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the reference document that corresponds to this stock movement.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the source transaction (e.g., purchase order number, production order number, sales order number) that initiated this stock movement.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document that triggered this stock movement (e.g., purchase order for goods receipt, production order for goods issue, delivery for shipment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase_order|production_order|sales_order|delivery|transfer_order|physical_inventory|reservation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this movement is a reversal (correction) of a previously posted transaction.

attributes.name: reversed_material_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number of the original transaction that this movement reverses, establishing audit trail linkage for corrections.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized materials, providing individual unit-level traceability for high-value or regulated items.

attributes.name: source_bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or warehouse location identifier from which the material was picked or moved, enabling precise warehouse management and cycle count accuracy.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating special stock categories such as consignment stock, project stock, sales order stock, or returnable packaging.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stock status: unrestricted (available for use), quality_inspection (awaiting QA approval), blocked (not usable), or restricted (limited use).

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the storage location (warehouse, stockroom, or inventory area) within the plant where the material is stored or was moved from.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter, M=Meter). Follows ISO standard UOM codes.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Split valuation indicator used when the same material is valued differently based on procurement type or quality grade (e.g., own production vs. external procurement).

products.name: cycle_count
products.description: Cycle count event header record capturing scheduled and ad-hoc physical inventory counts for specific materials, storage locations, or zones. Tracks count document number, count date, count type (ABC cycle, annual physical, ad-hoc recount), counter assignment, zone or location scope, planned vs actual count date, overall variance summary, approval status, and posting status. Supports ABC-based cycle count programs, annual physical inventory compliance, and inventory accuracy KPI tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count event. Primary key for the cycle count record.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.plant. Business justification: Cycle count is performed at a plant; plant_id replaces the string code.

attributes.name: primary_cycle_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or user identifier of the person who performed the physical count. Used for accountability and quality tracking.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cycle Count Stock Location Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Link cycle count header to the physical location where the count occurs; replace code with FK.

tag_set.value: Cycle Count Stock Location Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: tertiary_cycle_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the count results. Required for audit trail and segregation of duties.

attributes.name: tertiary_quinary_cycle_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier who last updated the cycle count record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC classification of materials included in this count. A=high-value/high-frequency, B=medium, C=low-value/low-frequency, X=unclassified. Drives cycle count frequency per ABC methodology.

attributes.name: accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Inventory accuracy rate for this count, calculated as (items with zero variance / total items counted) × 100. Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for inventory management.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the cycle count results. Counts with material variances typically require supervisor or manager approval before posting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count was approved. Used for compliance reporting and cycle time tracking.

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the physical count was performed. Principal business event timestamp for the cycle count activity.

attributes.name: count_document_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cycle count document. Externally-known unique reference number used in SAP WM and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: count_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the physical counting activity was completed. Used to calculate count duration and resource utilization.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: Technology or method used to perform the physical count. Impacts count accuracy and efficiency metrics.

attributes.name: count_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the counting activity. Indicates whether count covers entire warehouse, specific zones, material categories, or individual items.

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the physical counting activity began. Used for labor tracking and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count event. Tracks progression from planning through execution, approval, and posting to inventory ledger. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Planned|In Progress|Completed|Approved|Posted|Cancelled|On Hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cycle count event. Defines the counting methodology and business purpose (ABC-based frequency, annual compliance, variance investigation, or continuous counting program).
attributes.value_regex: ABC Cycle|Annual Physical|Ad-Hoc Recount|Spot Count|Blind Count|Perpetual Inventory

attributes.name: count_zone
attributes.description: Physical zone or area within the warehouse designated for this count. Used to organize counting activities by geographic sections or material groupings.

attributes.name: counter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who performed the physical count. Used for operational visibility and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was first created in the system. Audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the cycle count was performed. Used for annual physical inventory compliance and year-over-year accuracy trending.

attributes.name: freeze_book_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether book inventory was frozen (locked from transactions) during the count to ensure data integrity. True=frozen, False=not frozen.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was last updated. Audit field for tracking record changes and data currency.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: SAP Material Management (MM) document number generated when inventory adjustments are posted. Links cycle count to inventory movement transactions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the cycle count event. Used to document unusual conditions, issues encountered, or explanations for variances.

attributes.name: planned_count_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for the cycle count. Used to track adherence to ABC cycle count schedules and annual physical inventory calendars.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Accounting date when inventory adjustments from this count were posted to the financial ledger. May differ from count_date for period-end controls.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) to which inventory adjustments are posted. Used for period-end close and financial reporting.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Status of inventory adjustment posting to the general ledger and inventory subledger. Posted=variances reflected in stock balances, Not Posted=count complete but not yet posted.

attributes.name: recount_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for requiring a recount. Populated when recount_required_flag is True.

attributes.name: recount_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount is required due to significant variances exceeding tolerance thresholds. True=recount needed, False=count accepted.

attributes.name: tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Acceptable variance threshold as a percentage of book quantity. Variances within tolerance may auto-approve; exceeding tolerance triggers recount or management review.

attributes.name: total_items_counted
attributes.description: Total number of distinct Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) or material numbers included in this cycle count event.

attributes.name: total_variance_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity variance across all materials in this count (sum of absolute differences between book and physical quantities). Measured in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: total_variance_value
attributes.description: Aggregate financial value of inventory variances in this count. Calculated as sum of (variance quantity × standard cost) across all materials. Used for materiality assessment and financial impact analysis.

attributes.name: variance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total variance value. Typically plant or company code default currency.

attributes.name: warehouse_number
attributes.description: Warehouse Management (WM) number for complex warehouse structures. Used when storage location has multiple warehouse subdivisions.

products.name: cycle_count_line
products.description: Individual line item within a cycle count document representing the count result for a specific material-batch-bin combination. Captures line number, material, batch, storage bin, book quantity, counted quantity, difference quantity, unit of measure, recount indicator, and posting result. Enables granular variance analysis and audit trail for physical inventory reconciliation per ISO 9001 inventory accuracy requirements.

attributes.name: cycle_count_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count line item. Primary key for the cycle count line entity.

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent cycle count document header. Links this line item to its containing cycle count execution.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record being counted. Identifies the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) or raw material subject to physical verification.

attributes.name: primary_cycle_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the warehouse employee who performed the physical count. Enables accountability and audit trail per ISO 9001 quality management requirements.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the storage location where the material is physically located. Represents the warehouse or plant-level storage area.

attributes.name: accounting_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the financial accounting document generated when the variance was posted. Links the physical inventory adjustment to General Ledger (GL) entries in SAP Financial Accounting (FI).

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for batch-managed materials. Enables traceability and quality control per ISO 9001 requirements. Null for non-batch-managed materials.

attributes.name: book_quantity
attributes.description: System-recorded quantity of material in the storage bin at the time of cycle count initiation. Represents the expected quantity per Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) records before physical verification.

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the physical count was scheduled or performed. May differ from counted_timestamp for counts spanning multiple shifts or days.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this cycle count line item. Tracks progression from initiation through counting, verification, and posting stages.

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: Actual physical quantity counted by warehouse personnel during the cycle count execution. This is the verified on-hand quantity observed in the storage bin.

attributes.name: counted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the physical count was completed by warehouse personnel. Represents the actual business event time of inventory verification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cycle count line record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: difference_quantity
attributes.description: Variance between book quantity and counted quantity. Calculated as counted_quantity minus book_quantity. Positive values indicate surplus, negative values indicate shortage. Critical for inventory accuracy Key Performance Indicator (KPI) measurement.

attributes.name: freeze_book_inventory_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the book inventory quantity was frozen at the time of count initiation to prevent changes during the count period. True if frozen, false if dynamic.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cycle count line record was last updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the cycle count document. Determines the ordering and position of this count line within the parent document.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the material document generated when the variance was posted. Links the cycle count result to the inventory movement transaction in SAP MM.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material being counted. The externally-known Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code or material code from the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for counter observations, exceptions, or additional context regarding the count result. Supports audit trail and Non-Conformance Report (NCR) documentation.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory variance was posted to the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system and financial ledgers. Null if not yet posted. Critical for period-end inventory valuation per International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

attributes.name: posting_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the variance on this line has been posted to inventory and financial ledgers. True if posted, false if pending approval or recount.

attributes.name: recount_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item requires or has undergone a recount due to variance exceeding tolerance thresholds. True if recount is required or completed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: recount_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason a recount was triggered. Used for root cause analysis and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes per ISO 9001.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock categories that require separate tracking. Consignment stock is vendor-owned, project stock is allocated to specific projects, sales order stock is reserved for customer orders.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of inventory stock status at the time of count. Unrestricted stock is available for use, quality inspection stock is pending Quality Management (QM) approval, blocked stock is unavailable due to quality or legal holds.

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or rack location within the storage location where the material is stored. Enables precise physical location tracking for Warehouse Management System (WMS) operations.

attributes.name: tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Acceptable variance threshold as a percentage of book quantity. Variances within this tolerance may be auto-posted without recount. Supports Just In Time (JIT) inventory control and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) accuracy.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields on this line. Examples include EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter). Must align with material master base unit of measure.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Split valuation indicator for materials managed with multiple valuation types. Examples include origin-based valuation, quality-based valuation. Null for materials without split valuation.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Root cause classification for inventory variance identified during cycle count. Enables variance analysis and process improvement initiatives. Required when difference_quantity is non-zero and exceeds tolerance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: counting_error|theft|damage|obsolescence|system_error|goods_receipt_not_posted|goods_issue_not_posted|transfer_not_posted|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: verified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the count result was verified by a supervisor or second counter. Null if verification is not required or not yet completed.

products.name: replenishment_order
products.description: Planning-driven, kanban-triggered, or manually-created replenishment and reservation record for restocking materials to safety stock or reorder point levels, or committing stock for planned consumption. Captures order number, material, plant, storage location, replenishment type (planning-driven, kanban, min-max, JIT, manual reservation), required quantity, requested delivery date, source (purchase requisition, production order, stock transfer), reference order (production order, sales order, maintenance order), priority, reserved quantity, and fulfillment status. Unifies demand commitment and replenishment execution into a single record for available-to-promise calculation.
products.reference: SAP MM MRP Planned Order / Replenishment Request

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment order record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center that will be charged for this replenishment, used for financial accounting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Vendor‑Managed Inventory (VMI) orders are generated per customer; linking the order to the customer account enables demand‑driven replenishment.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or SKU being replenished. Links to the material master record.

attributes.name: planned_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.planned_order. Business justification: MRP ORDER CONVERSION: replenishment orders are created from MRP planned orders; linking enables traceability.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where the material is being replenished.

attributes.name: primary_replenishment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRP controller or planner responsible for managing the replenishment of this material.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Replenishment orders generated for project consumption must be linked to the project for cost and schedule tracking.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location or warehouse bin where the replenished material will be stored.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external supplier or vendor from whom the material will be procured, applicable when source type is external procurement.

attributes.name: tertiary_replenishment_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system process that last modified this replenishment order record.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment order was approved for execution, marking transition from draft to active status.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Specific batch or lot number assigned to the replenished material for traceability and quality control purposes.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment order was closed after complete fulfillment or cancellation.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual confirmed delivery date provided by the supplier or internal source, may differ from requested date based on availability and lead time.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost and financial transactions related to this replenishment order.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost for fulfilling this replenishment order, including material cost, freight, and handling charges.

attributes.name: fulfilled_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material that has been delivered and received against this replenishment order.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the replenishment cost or inventory value will be posted for financial reporting.

attributes.name: inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming quality inspection is required before the replenished material can be released for use.

attributes.name: kanban_card_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the kanban card that triggered this replenishment, applicable when replenishment type is kanban-based pull system.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from order placement to material availability at the storage location, used for planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: Standard or economic order quantity used for replenishment, may be based on MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity), EOQ (Economic Order Quantity), or fixed lot size rules.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment order record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information related to this replenishment order.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the replenishment order, used for tracking and reference across systems and documents.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment order indicating its progress through the fulfillment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|in_progress|partially_fulfilled|fulfilled|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this replenishment order, used for scheduling and allocation decisions when material is constrained.

attributes.name: reference_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the consuming order that requires this replenishment (e.g., production order, sales order, maintenance order). Used to link demand to supply.

attributes.name: reference_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reference order type that is consuming or requiring this replenishment.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level threshold that triggers automatic replenishment when stock falls below this point, used in min-max and reorder point planning strategies.

attributes.name: replenishment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment trigger mechanism: planning-driven (MRP-based), kanban (pull-based), min-max (reorder point), JIT (Just In Time), manual reservation, or safety stock replenishment.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the replenished material is required to be available at the storage location to meet production or demand requirements.

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material required to meet the replenishment target or reservation commitment, expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently reserved or committed against this replenishment order, used for available-to-promise (ATP) calculation.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum buffer stock quantity that should be maintained at the storage location to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions.

attributes.name: serial_number_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual serial number tracking is required for the replenished material items.

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the originating document that triggered or fulfills this replenishment order (e.g., purchase requisition number, production order number, stock transfer order number).

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source from which the material will be replenished: purchase requisition (external procurement), production order (internal manufacturing), stock transfer (inter-plant), external procurement, or internal transfer.

attributes.name: special_procurement_type
attributes.description: Classification of special procurement arrangements such as consignment stock, subcontracting, pipeline materials, or inter-plant stock transfers.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the material quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter, M for meter).

products.name: wip_stock
products.description: Work-in-progress inventory record tracking semi-finished materials and assemblies currently in production on the shop floor. Captures WIP stock identifier, production order reference, material or assembly, current operation step, quantity in process, storage location or production area, start date, expected completion date, and WIP valuation amount. Integrates shop floor execution data with production order status for real-time WIP visibility and cost tracking.
products.reference: SAP PP WIP / MES WIP Tracking

attributes.name: wip_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work-in-progress inventory record. Primary key for the WIP stock entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: WIP valuation must be assigned to a cost center for work‑in‑process accounting and financial statements.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: WIP stock may be subject to in‑process inspection; linking to the inspection lot records results for each batch, supporting real‑time quality control.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or assembly being produced. Identifies the semi-finished good, subassembly, or component currently in work-in-progress status.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.plant. Business justification: WIP stock records the plant where work is in progress; plant_id provides a proper reference.

attributes.name: primary_wip_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production operator or worker currently responsible for processing this WIP stock. Used for labor tracking and quality accountability.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order under which this WIP stock is being manufactured. Links to the production order that authorized the manufacturing of this semi-finished material or assembly.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: WIP stock is tied to a specific project; project execution dashboards need a FK to link WIP to its project.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production station where this WIP stock is currently being processed. Identifies the specific manufacturing resource performing the current operation.

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when this WIP stock completed all production operations. Null if production is still in progress. Used for lead time analysis and schedule adherence tracking.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, rack, or staging position within the storage location where the WIP stock is placed. Provides granular physical location tracking for material handling and retrieval.

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version number of the bill of materials used for producing this WIP stock. Tracks which BOM configuration was applied, important for engineering change management and traceability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this WIP stock record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the WIP valuation amount. Standard codes include USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY.

attributes.name: customer_order_number
attributes.description: Customer sales order number for which this WIP stock is being produced, if applicable. Used for make-to-order production tracking and customer-specific inventory management. Null for make-to-stock production.

attributes.name: expected_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or scheduled date when this WIP stock is expected to complete all production operations and be ready for transfer to finished goods inventory. Used for production planning and delivery commitment.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason why this WIP stock is on hold, if applicable. Values: quality_issue (failed inspection), material_shortage (awaiting components), equipment_failure (machine breakdown), engineering_change (ECO/ECN pending), customer_request (order change), other (miscellaneous reasons). Null if not on hold.

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: Accumulated direct labor cost incurred in producing this WIP stock up to the current operation. Includes operator wages and benefits allocated to this production activity.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent stock movement or status change for this WIP stock. Used for tracking material flow and identifying stagnant inventory.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this WIP stock record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: material_cost
attributes.description: Accumulated cost of raw materials and components consumed in producing this WIP stock up to the current operation. Component of total WIP valuation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this WIP stock record. May include special handling instructions, quality observations, or production issues. Used for operational communication and documentation.

attributes.name: operation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Current operation step or routing sequence number in the production process where this WIP stock is located. Indicates the specific manufacturing stage within the overall production routing.

attributes.name: operation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when processing began at the current operation step. Used for cycle time tracking and operation-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: overhead_cost
attributes.description: Accumulated manufacturing overhead cost allocated to this WIP stock up to the current operation. Includes indirect costs such as utilities, depreciation, and facility expenses.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Production priority level assigned to this WIP stock. Values: urgent (expedited processing required), high (priority customer order), normal (standard production), low (fill-in work). Used for shop floor scheduling and resource allocation.

attributes.name: production_start_date
attributes.description: Date when production of this WIP stock began. Marks the start of the manufacturing process for this batch or lot.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this WIP stock requires quality inspection before moving to the next operation or to finished goods. True if inspection is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: quantity_completed
attributes.description: Quantity of the material or assembly that has completed processing at the current operation step and is ready to move to the next stage. Used for tracking operation-level progress and yield.

attributes.name: quantity_in_process
attributes.description: Current quantity of the material or assembly in work-in-progress status, measured in the base unit of measure. Represents the number of units currently being manufactured at this operation step.

attributes.name: quantity_scrapped
attributes.description: Quantity of the material or assembly that was scrapped or rejected during processing at the current operation. Used for scrap rate calculation and quality analysis.

attributes.name: rework_operation_sequence
attributes.description: Operation sequence number to which this WIP stock must be returned for rework, if rework is required. Null if no rework is needed. Used for routing rework items back through the production process.

attributes.name: rework_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this WIP stock requires rework or reprocessing due to quality issues. True if rework is needed, false otherwise. Used for quality management and cost tracking.

attributes.name: routing_version
attributes.description: Version number of the production routing or process plan used for manufacturing this WIP stock. Tracks which manufacturing process was followed, important for process control and traceability.

attributes.name: serial_number_range_end
attributes.description: Ending serial number in the range assigned to this WIP stock batch, if serialized tracking is required. Used for individual unit traceability in high-value or regulated products. Null if not serialized.

attributes.name: serial_number_range_start
attributes.description: Starting serial number in the range assigned to this WIP stock batch, if serialized tracking is required. Used for individual unit traceability in high-value or regulated products. Null if not serialized.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production shift during which this WIP stock is being processed. Used for shift-level performance tracking and labor allocation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this WIP stock record originated. Values: SAP_PP (SAP Production Planning), OPCENTER_MES (Siemens Opcenter Manufacturing Execution System), DYNAMICS_SCM (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management), MANUAL (manual entry). Used for data lineage and integration management.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the storage location, production area, or staging zone where this WIP stock is physically located. May represent shop floor buffer zones, work-in-process storage areas, or production line staging locations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the WIP quantity. Standard units include EA (each), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), M (meter), FT (foot), L (liter), GAL (gallon), PC (piece), SET (set). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|LB|M|FT|L|GAL|PC|SET — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wip_batch_number
attributes.description: Unique batch or lot number assigned to this work-in-progress inventory for traceability and quality control purposes. Used for tracking materials through production stages.

attributes.name: wip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the WIP stock. Values: in_process (actively being manufactured), on_hold (production paused), awaiting_inspection (pending quality check), ready_to_move (completed operation, awaiting transfer), scrapped (rejected), completed (finished all operations).

attributes.name: wip_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total valuation amount of this WIP stock in the company's base currency. Represents the accumulated cost of materials, labor, and overhead consumed up to the current production stage. Used for inventory valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
