attributes.description: Calculated yield percentage for this WIP stock at the current operation, representing the ratio of good output to total input. Used for process performance monitoring and OEE calculation. Formula: (quantity_completed / (quantity_completed + quantity_scrapped)) * 100.

products.name: inventory_safety_stock_policy
products.description: Safety stock and reorder point policy configuration for each material-plant combination, defining the minimum stock buffer to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. Captures safety stock quantity, reorder point, maximum stock level, replenishment lead time, demand variability factor, service level target, review cycle, JIT flag, and policy effective dates. Drives planning-based replenishment calculations and inventory optimization across all facilities.
products.reference: SAP MM MRP Safety Stock / Dynamics 365 SCM Inventory Policy

attributes.name: inventory_safety_stock_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety stock policy record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory planner or supply chain analyst responsible for maintaining and reviewing this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) governed by this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this safety stock policy applies.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location or warehouse bin within the plant where the material is stocked.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and consumption: A (high value, tight control), B (moderate value), C (low value, relaxed control).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for policy changes, indicating whether the policy has been reviewed and authorized by management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the manager or authority who approved this safety stock policy for implementation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock policy was formally approved for use in planning systems.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the safety stock quantity: fixed quantity, fixed days of supply, statistical (using demand variability), forecast error-based, or hybrid approach.

attributes.name: coverage_profile
attributes.description: The time horizon unit used to express inventory coverage targets (days of supply, weeks of supply, or months of supply).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock policy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: demand_variability_factor
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand fluctuation expressed as coefficient of variation or standard deviation factor, used to calculate safety stock buffer size.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this safety stock policy expires or is superseded by a new policy version. Null indicates an open-ended policy.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this safety stock policy becomes active and is used in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) calculations.

attributes.name: forecast_model
attributes.description: The demand forecasting model used to calculate expected consumption and variability for safety stock determination.

attributes.name: holding_cost_per_unit_per_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Holding Cost Per Unit Per Year
attributes.description: The annual cost to hold one unit of this material in inventory, including warehousing, insurance, obsolescence, and capital cost.

tag_set.value: Holding Cost Per Unit Per Year

attributes.name: jit_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material-plant combination follows Just In Time (JIT) inventory principles with minimal or zero safety stock.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this safety stock policy was reviewed and validated by inventory planning or supply chain management.

attributes.name: lot_size_rule
attributes.description: The rule governing replenishment order quantities: fixed quantity, Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), lot-for-lot matching demand, period-based batching, weekly, or monthly aggregation.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: The upper inventory limit for this material-plant combination to prevent overstocking and excess capital tied up in inventory.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The smallest replenishment order quantity allowed by supplier constraints or economic order quantity calculations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock policy record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review and potential adjustment of this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: planning_strategy
attributes.description: The inventory planning methodology applied: Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP II), Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), Kanban pull system, or manual planning.

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the safety stock policy, typically combining material, plant, and policy version identifiers.

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planners to document special considerations, exceptions, business rationale, or historical context for this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety stock policy indicating whether it is actively used in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) calculations.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety stock policy approach: fixed buffer, dynamic calculation, seasonal adjustment, Just In Time (JIT) minimal stock, zero stock strategy, or consignment inventory.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level threshold that triggers a replenishment order, calculated as safety stock plus demand during lead time.

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The total time in days from order placement to material receipt, including procurement, production, and transportation lead times.

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: The frequency in days at which inventory levels are reviewed and replenishment decisions are made for periodic review policies.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum buffer stock quantity to be maintained to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty, expressed in the material base unit of measure.

attributes.name: safety_time_days
attributes.description: Additional time buffer in days added to the replenishment lead time to protect against supply delays and schedule variability.

attributes.name: seasonal_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy includes seasonal demand pattern adjustments that modify safety stock levels throughout the year.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: The target probability of not experiencing a stockout during the replenishment lead time, typically expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95%, 99%).

attributes.name: stockout_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The estimated business cost incurred per unit when a stockout occurs, including lost sales, expediting costs, and customer dissatisfaction impact.

attributes.name: target_coverage_value
attributes.description: The target number of coverage periods (days, weeks, or months) that the safety stock should protect against stockouts.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for all quantity fields in this policy (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters).

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: Demand variability classification: X (stable demand), Y (moderate variability), Z (highly variable or sporadic demand).

products.name: kanban_card
products.description: Kanban card master and status record supporting JIT pull-based replenishment on the shop floor. Captures kanban card number, control cycle reference, material, supply area, responsible work center, container quantity, number of containers in cycle, kanban loop time, current status (empty, in transit, full, in use, locked), signal type (electronic, physical, barcode), and last status change timestamp. Enables real-time pull signal processing for lean manufacturing material flow, reducing WIP and supporting continuous flow production.

attributes.name: kanban_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the kanban card record. Primary key for the kanban card entity.

attributes.name: control_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the kanban control cycle that governs this card. Defines the replenishment loop parameters.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Kanban loops can be customer‑specific in contract manufacturing; the card needs to identify the customer account.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the person or operator responsible for managing this kanban card and its replenishment.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or component that this kanban card controls. Links to the material master record.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this kanban card operates.

attributes.name: primary_kanban_stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the current physical location of the kanban card container. Enables real-time material tracking.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Kanban cards used on project production lines need a project reference to monitor lean execution per project.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier for external kanban cards where material is replenished directly from vendor.

attributes.name: supply_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply area or warehouse location from which material is replenished.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the responsible work center that uses material from this kanban card.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this kanban card is currently active in the control cycle. Inactive cards are excluded from replenishment processing.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode value printed on the physical kanban card for scanning and automated signal processing.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the kanban card is blocked or locked. Used for quality holds, safety issues, or process exceptions.

attributes.name: consumption_area_code
attributes.description: Reference to the consumption area or work center where material is used.

attributes.name: container_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity of material held in one container for this kanban card. Represents the pull signal quantity.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of physical container used to hold the material quantity for this kanban card.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this kanban card record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this kanban card is retired or deactivated from the control cycle. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this kanban card becomes effective and active in the control cycle.

attributes.name: kanban_card_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique kanban card number used for identification on the shop floor. Typically barcode or RFID-encoded for scanning.

attributes.name: kanban_card_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kanban card. Empty triggers replenishment signal, in_transit indicates material movement, full indicates ready for consumption, in_use indicates active consumption, locked prevents usage, blocked indicates quality or safety hold.

attributes.name: kanban_loop_time_minutes
attributes.description: Expected cycle time in minutes for one complete kanban loop from consumption signal to replenishment completion.

attributes.name: last_consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when material was last consumed from this kanban card. Used for demand pattern analysis.

attributes.name: last_replenishment_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when material was last replenished for this kanban card. Used for consumption rate analysis.

attributes.name: last_status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the kanban card status was last changed. Critical for tracking loop time performance and identifying bottlenecks.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected lead time in days from replenishment signal to material availability. Used for kanban sizing calculations.

attributes.name: maximum_lot_size
attributes.description: Maximum order quantity for replenishment. Prevents over-stocking and excess WIP inventory.

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity (MOQ) for replenishment. Ensures economic order quantities are maintained.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this kanban card record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this kanban card for operational guidance and special handling instructions.

attributes.name: number_of_containers
attributes.description: Total number of containers in the kanban control cycle for this card. Determines the total inventory in the loop.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level for replenishment processing. Critical materials are replenished first to prevent production stoppage.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Production version or routing variant associated with this kanban card for manufactured materials.

attributes.name: replenishment_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy for material replenishment. Pull is pure JIT demand-driven, push is forecast-driven, hybrid combines both.

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier for automated tracking and real-time location monitoring of the kanban card.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum safety stock quantity maintained in the kanban loop to buffer against demand variability and supply disruptions.

attributes.name: signal_type
attributes.description: Type of signal mechanism used for this kanban card. Electronic signals integrate with MES, physical cards are manual, barcode and RFID enable automated scanning.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the container quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, M for meter).

products.name: stock_valuation
products.description: Inventory valuation record capturing the financial value of stock for each material at each plant and valuation area. Tracks valuation class, price control method (standard price vs. moving average price), current standard price, moving average price, total stock value, price unit, last valuation date, and period-end valuation adjustments. Supports cost of goods sold calculation, inventory asset reporting, and write-down provisions per IFRS and GAAP requirements.

attributes.name: stock_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock valuation record. Primary key for the stock valuation entity.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Financial reporting requires posting inventory valuation to a specific GL account; linking enables automated journal entry generation for balance‑sheet reporting.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material being valued. Links to the material master record in the product engineering domain.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where the stock is held. Links to the plant master data.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit in which the material quantity is managed (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter, M for meter).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity code for which the inventory is valued. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the cost center associated with inventory holding costs. Used for internal cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of goods sold for this material during the fiscal period. Calculated based on goods issues valued at standard or moving average price.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system process that created this valuation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock valuation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the material is valued (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year to which this valuation record applies. Typically ranges from 1 to 12.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this valuation record applies. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-over-year analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_accounting_method
attributes.description: Cost flow assumption method used for inventory valuation. FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), weighted average, or specific identification.

attributes.name: inventory_write_down_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which inventory value has been written down due to obsolescence, damage, or net realizable value being lower than cost. Required for IFRS and GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: is_consignment_stock
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this stock is held on consignment from a vendor. Consignment stock is not valued on the balance sheet until it is withdrawn for use.

attributes.name: is_special_stock
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is special stock (e.g., project stock, sales order stock, returnable packaging). Special stock may have different valuation rules.

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction for this material at this valuation area. Used for inventory turnover and movement analysis.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction for this material at this valuation area. Used for inventory aging and obsolescence analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system process that last modified this valuation record. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock valuation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_price_change_date
attributes.description: Date when the standard price or moving average price was last changed. Used for price history tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: material_overhead_amount
attributes.description: Total material overhead amount included in the stock valuation. Calculated by applying the material overhead rate to the base material cost.

attributes.name: material_overhead_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to material cost to account for procurement overhead, handling, and storage costs. Used in full costing calculations.

attributes.name: moving_average_price
attributes.description: Weighted average price per unit that is recalculated automatically with each goods receipt. Used when price control method is set to moving average.

attributes.name: net_realizable_value
attributes.description: Estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business less estimated costs of completion and estimated costs necessary to make the sale. Used to determine lower of cost or NRV per IAS 2.

attributes.name: previous_period_price
attributes.description: Price per unit from the previous fiscal period. Used for period-over-period variance analysis and price trend tracking.

attributes.name: price_change_amount
attributes.description: Absolute change in price per unit compared to the previous period. Calculated as current price minus previous period price.

attributes.name: price_change_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in price compared to the previous period. Used for inflation tracking and cost variance analysis.

attributes.name: price_control_method
attributes.description: Indicator determining whether material is valued using standard price (S) or moving average price (V). Standard price remains fixed until manually changed; moving average price recalculates with each goods receipt.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Number of units to which the price refers. For example, if price unit is 100, the standard price or moving average price applies to 100 units of the material.

attributes.name: price_variance_amount
attributes.description: Total price variance amount for the period, representing the difference between standard price and actual purchase price multiplied by quantity received. Used in standard costing variance analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the profit center responsible for this inventory. Used for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: provision_for_obsolescence
attributes.description: Reserve amount set aside for slow-moving, obsolete, or excess inventory. Reduces the carrying value of inventory on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: Fixed price per unit used for material valuation when price control method is set to standard price. Used for variance calculation in cost accounting.

attributes.name: total_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material in stock at the valuation area, including unrestricted, quality inspection, and blocked stock. Expressed in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: total_stock_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of all stock for this material at this valuation area. Calculated as total stock quantity multiplied by the applicable price (standard or moving average).

attributes.name: valuation_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for any manual valuation adjustments made during the period. Used for audit trail and management review.

attributes.name: valuation_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational unit for which material is valued. Typically corresponds to plant or company code level valuation.

attributes.name: valuation_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of inventory being valued. Aligns with balance sheet presentation and inventory management strategy.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Classification code that groups materials for accounting purposes and determines the General Ledger (GL) accounts to which inventory value is posted. Maps materials to chart of accounts.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this valuation snapshot was taken. Typically corresponds to period-end closing date for financial reporting.

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the valuation record indicating whether the material is actively valued, blocked from transactions, restricted use, or flagged for write-off.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Differentiates between multiple valuations of the same material within a valuation area (e.g., own production vs. external procurement, different quality grades).

products.name: quarantine_stock
products.description: Quarantine and blocked stock record for materials placed on hold pending quality inspection, regulatory review, customer complaint investigation, or supplier dispute resolution. Captures quarantine record number, material, batch, quantity, storage location, quarantine reason (incoming inspection, in-process failure, customer complaint, NCR, regulatory hold, shelf life expiry), initiating document reference, responsible quality engineer, quarantine start date, expected release date, and disposition decision (release, use-as-is, rework, return to vendor, scrap). Supports regulatory traceability for FDA, ISO 9001, and IATF 16949 requirements.
products.reference: SAP QM Blocked Stock / Quality Inspection Stock

attributes.name: quarantine_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quarantine stock record. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE (quarantine stock is a resource state/container with lifecycle). No canonical skip needed.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Quarantined stock often originates from a specific customer complaint; linking to the customer account supports traceability and liability reporting.

attributes.name: customer_complaint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer complaint record if the quarantine was triggered by a customer-reported quality issue or product return.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or product that is placed under quarantine. Links to the master material record in SAP MM or PLM system.

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) that documented the quality issue leading to the quarantine.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.plant. Business justification: Quarantine stock is tied to a plant; plant_id provides referential integrity.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Quarantine decisions are driven by particular regulatory mandates; linking to the regulatory requirement provides traceability for compliance audits.

attributes.name: responsible_quality_engineer_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Responsible Quality Engineer Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory compliance requires a qualified quality engineer to approve quarantine releases; linking to employee provides traceability for audits.

tag_set.value: Responsible Quality Engineer Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor from whom the quarantined material was received, if applicable for incoming inspection or supplier quality issues.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or facility where the quarantined stock is physically located.

attributes.name: actual_release_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the quarantine was lifted and the material was released, reworked, returned, or scrapped.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the quarantined material, enabling traceability to production run, supplier shipment, or manufacturing date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quarantine stock record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated financial impact amount. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|INR|CAD|AUD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: disposition_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposition decision was formally approved by the authorized quality or management personnel.

attributes.name: disposition_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized person who approved the disposition decision, ensuring accountability and traceability.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: Final disposition decision made by the quality team regarding the quarantined material. Options include release to stock, use as-is with deviation, rework, return to vendor, scrap, or pending decision.

attributes.name: disposition_justification
attributes.description: Detailed justification and rationale for the disposition decision, documenting the quality assessment, risk analysis, and approval basis.

attributes.name: erp_system_code
attributes.description: Code or identifier of the source ERP system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365) from which the quarantine record originated.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact or cost associated with the quarantined stock, including material value, potential rework costs, or scrap loss.

attributes.name: expected_release_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date by which the quarantine investigation and disposition decision are expected to be completed, allowing for release or other action.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: Goods receipt document number from SAP MM or WMS that recorded the inbound delivery of the quarantined material.

attributes.name: initiating_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the document that initiated the quarantine, enabling traceability to the root cause investigation or quality event.

attributes.name: initiating_document_type
attributes.description: Type of document that triggered the quarantine action, such as NCR (Non-Conformance Report), CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), inspection report, customer complaint, supplier notification, or regulatory notice.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: Inspection lot number from SAP QM or quality management system that tracks the inspection activity associated with the quarantined material.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the quarantine stock record, enabling change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the receipt of the quarantined material, enabling traceability to procurement records.

attributes.name: quarantine_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or instructions related to the quarantine case, supporting investigation and disposition activities.

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material placed under quarantine, expressed in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: quarantine_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for placing the material under quarantine. Values include incoming inspection, in-process failure, customer complaint, NCR (Non-Conformance Report), regulatory hold, or shelf life expiry.

attributes.name: quarantine_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason for quarantine, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: quarantine_record_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the quarantine record, externally visible and used for traceability and audit purposes. Typically follows a structured format for easy reference.

attributes.name: quarantine_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the material was placed under quarantine and blocked from use or shipment.

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quarantine record. Values include open, under investigation, pending approval, released, or closed.

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the quarantine is due to a regulatory hold imposed by FDA, EPA, or other governing body.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit responsible for investigating and resolving the quarantine case (e.g., Quality Assurance, Incoming Inspection, Production).

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the individual item under quarantine, if applicable for serialized inventory tracking.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry or best-before date of the material, relevant when quarantine is due to approaching or exceeded shelf life.

attributes.name: storage_bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin or rack location within the storage area where the quarantined stock is placed for physical segregation.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Storage location code within the warehouse where the quarantined material is held, as defined in SAP WM or WMS.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quarantine quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|TON|LB|GAL|FT|PC — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: serialized_unit
products.description: Individual unit tracking record for serialized components, assemblies, finished goods, and handling units (pallets, containers, totes, drums, reels) managed by unique identifier throughout their inventory lifecycle. Captures serial/unit number, material, unit type (serialized part, pallet, container, tote), contents (for handling units), batch, quantity, gross/net weight, dimensions, current plant and storage location, status (in stock, in production, shipped, returned, scrapped), seal number, and last movement timestamp. Provides pallet-level and serial-level traceability for warehouse operations, field service, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: serialized_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the serialized unit record. Primary key for individual unit tracking across inventory lifecycle.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owns or has been allocated this serialized unit. Used for customer-specific inventory, consignment stock, and field service tracking.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lot or batch record from which this serialized unit originated. Links unit-level traceability to batch-level quality and production data.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record that defines the product specification, Bill of Materials (BOM), and material characteristics for this serialized unit.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order for which this serialized unit has been allocated or shipped. Links inventory to order fulfillment and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: parent_unit_serialized_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent handling unit (pallet, container, tote) that contains this serialized unit. Enables hierarchical packing structure and nested unit tracking for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.plant. Business justification: Serialized units are produced at a plant; linking via plant_id removes the free‑text code.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order that manufactured or assembled this serialized unit. Links unit traceability to production execution and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) data.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Serialized equipment assigned to a project requires linking for asset tracking and project cost allocation.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order through which this serialized unit was procured. Enables procurement traceability and supplier performance analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record if this serialized unit is currently in transit or has been shipped. Enables logistics tracking and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier that provided this serialized unit. Links to procurement data and supplier quality management.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse master record where this serialized unit is currently stored. Provides detailed warehouse attributes and operational parameters.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, rack, or storage position identifier within the warehouse where this serialized unit is physically located. Enables precise picking and putaway operations.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where this serialized unit was manufactured or assembled. Required for customs declarations and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person who created this serialized unit record. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this serialized unit record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record creation and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Enables multi-currency inventory valuation and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: customs_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) code or Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) code for customs classification and duty calculation. Required for international shipments.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this serialized unit reaches end of shelf life or warranty expiration. Used for First Expired First Out (FEFO) inventory management and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the serialized unit including packaging and contents, measured in kilograms. Used for logistics planning and transportation compliance.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: United Nations (UN) hazard classification code for hazardous materials (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives). Required for transportation and storage compliance.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this serialized unit contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and transportation compliance.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the serialized unit or handling unit in centimeters. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person who last modified this serialized unit record. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this serialized unit record was last updated. Enables change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent inventory movement transaction for this serialized unit. Used for inventory aging analysis and cycle count prioritization.

attributes.name: last_movement_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent inventory movement transaction for this serialized unit (e.g., goods receipt, goods issue, transfer posting, physical inventory). Provides audit trail context.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the serialized unit or handling unit in centimeters. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when this serialized unit was manufactured or assembled. Critical for warranty tracking, shelf life management, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the material contents excluding packaging, measured in kilograms. Used for material valuation and yield calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about this serialized unit. Used for special handling instructions, quality observations, or operational remarks.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates the legal ownership of the serialized unit. Distinguishes between company-owned inventory, customer consignment, vendor consignment, and third-party logistics (3PL) owned stock.

attributes.name: quality_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of Conformance (CoC) or quality certificate number issued for this serialized unit. Required for regulated industries and customer quality requirements.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Current quality inspection status of the serialized unit. Indicates whether the unit has passed quality checks and is approved for use or shipment.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material contained in this serialized unit. For serialized parts typically 1; for handling units represents the aggregate quantity of contents.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to handling units (containers, pallets) for tamper detection and customs compliance. Required for international shipments and high-value goods.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number or unit identifier assigned to this individual component, assembly, or finished good for traceability throughout its lifecycle. Enables field service tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the serialized unit indicating its position in the inventory and production workflow. Drives availability for Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and order fulfillment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_stock|in_production|in_transit|shipped|delivered|returned|blocked|scrapped|consumed — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of stock availability indicating whether the unit is unrestricted for use, under quality inspection, blocked, or held as consignment inventory.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Storage location code within the plant identifying the specific warehouse, yard, or storage area where this unit is physically located.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the hazardous substance for transportation and emergency response (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Required for hazmat shipping documentation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters). Aligns with material master UOM definition.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the serialized unit indicating whether it is a serialized component part, assembly, finished good, or handling unit (pallet, container, tote, drum, reel) used for material handling and logistics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: serialized_part|assembly|finished_good|pallet|container|tote|drum|reel|handling_unit — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Monetary valuation of this serialized unit for inventory accounting and financial reporting. Represents standard cost, moving average price, or actual cost depending on valuation method.

attributes.name: volume_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Total volume of the serialized unit or handling unit in cubic meters. Used for warehouse capacity planning and freight cost calculation.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the serialized unit or handling unit in centimeters. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Supply chain planning and demand management domain covering MRP/MRP II runs, demand forecasting, capacity planning, APS scheduling, supplier lead times, MOQ management, supply risk, multi-tier supplier coordination, and supply network optimization. Integrates Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM and SAP PP/MM for end-to-end supply network visibility.

products.name: mrp_run
products.description: Captures each MRP/MRP II planning run execution, recording planning horizon, run type (regenerative vs. net change), plant scope, planning parameters, BOM/routing explosion level, and completion status. Serves as the authoritative audit record of when and how material requirements were calculated, enabling traceability of all planned orders and material requirements back to their originating MRP execution in SAP PP/MM or Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MRP/MRP II planning run execution. Primary key.

attributes.name: eco_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.eco. Business justification: MRP run generation must consider active Engineering Change Orders to adjust material plans; the MRP Run Report includes ECO impact, requiring mrp_run.eco_id FK to engineering.eco.eco_id.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or system account that initiated or triggered this MRP run. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when this MRP run completed or terminated. Used to calculate run duration and identify performance bottlenecks.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when this MRP run began execution. Key audit field for tracking planning run performance and compliance with scheduling windows.

attributes.name: bom_explosion_level
attributes.description: Maximum depth of BOM explosion performed during this MRP run. Indicates how many levels down the product structure the planning calculation extended (e.g., 1 for single-level, 99 for full multi-level explosion).

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by planners or system administrators regarding the outcome, issues, or special circumstances of this MRP run.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MRP run record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: demand_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the run date within which the MRP system does not automatically create, reschedule, or cancel planned orders. Defines the frozen zone where manual intervention is required.

attributes.name: error_messages_count
attributes.description: Total number of error messages generated during this MRP run that prevented successful completion or caused partial failures.

attributes.name: exception_messages_count
attributes.description: Total number of exception or warning messages generated during this MRP run, indicating planning issues such as material shortages, capacity overloads, or invalid master data.

attributes.name: include_forecast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether demand forecast data was included in the MRP calculation (True) or only firm customer orders were considered (False).

attributes.name: include_safety_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether safety stock requirements were included in the MRP calculation (True) or excluded (False).

attributes.name: include_wip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether existing work-in-progress inventory was considered as available supply during this MRP run (True) or excluded (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MRP run record was last updated. Audit field for tracking changes to run status or metadata.

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: Global lead time offset (in days) applied to all planned orders during this MRP run to account for additional buffer time beyond standard procurement or production lead times.

attributes.name: lot_sizing_rule
attributes.description: Default lot sizing method applied during this MRP run for planned order quantity calculation: lot-for-lot (LFL), fixed lot size, economic order quantity (EOQ), or period order quantity (POQ).

attributes.name: materials_processed_count
attributes.description: Total number of material master records processed during this MRP run. Indicates the scope and scale of the planning calculation.

attributes.name: planned_orders_cancelled_count
attributes.description: Total number of existing planned orders that were cancelled by this MRP run because they were no longer needed to satisfy material requirements.

attributes.name: planned_orders_created_count
attributes.description: Total number of new planned orders (purchase requisitions or production orders) created by this MRP run to satisfy material requirements.

attributes.name: planned_orders_rescheduled_count
attributes.description: Total number of existing planned orders that were rescheduled (date or quantity changed) by this MRP run due to changes in demand or supply.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_days
attributes.description: Total number of days covered by the planning horizon for this MRP run, calculated from start to end date.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning horizon for this MRP run. Defines the end of the period for which material requirements are calculated.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning horizon for this MRP run. Defines the beginning of the period for which material requirements are calculated.

attributes.name: planning_mode
attributes.description: Manufacturing planning strategy applied during this MRP run: make-to-stock (MTS), make-to-order (MTO), assemble-to-order (ATO), or engineer-to-order (ETO).

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the run date within which the MRP system can reschedule but not create new planned orders. Defines the slushy zone between frozen and free planning periods.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code for which this MRP run was executed. Defines the scope of materials and production resources included in the planning calculation.

attributes.name: routing_explosion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether production routing and work center capacity requirements were calculated during this MRP run (True) or only material requirements were computed (False).

attributes.name: run_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from actual start to actual end of the MRP run. Key performance indicator for planning system efficiency.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business-facing identifier for the MRP run, typically system-generated or user-assigned for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: run_parameters_json
attributes.description: JSON-formatted string containing additional MRP run configuration parameters and settings not captured in dedicated columns. Enables flexible storage of system-specific or advanced planning parameters.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of the MRP run: scheduled (queued for execution), running (in progress), completed (successfully finished), failed (terminated with errors), or cancelled (manually aborted).

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Type of MRP planning run executed: regenerative (full recalculation of all materials), net_change (incremental update based on changes since last run), single_level (one BOM level), or multi_level (full BOM explosion).

attributes.name: safety_stock_method
attributes.description: Safety stock calculation method applied during this MRP run: fixed quantity, days of supply, statistical (based on demand variability), or none.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when this MRP run was scheduled to begin execution.

attributes.name: scheduling_method
attributes.description: Scheduling algorithm applied during this MRP run: forward (schedule from earliest start), backward (schedule from due date), finite (capacity-constrained), or infinite (no capacity constraints).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source ERP or planning system that executed this MRP run (e.g., SAP_PP, DYNAMICS_SCM, OPCENTER_APS).

products.name: planned_order
products.description: Represents a planned production, procurement, or stock transfer order generated by MRP/APS to satisfy a material requirement. Consolidates all replenishment proposals awaiting planner review through to firmed orders ready for conversion. Tracks planned quantity, scheduled start/finish dates, order type (production order, purchase requisition, stock transfer), priority, firming status, proposal lifecycle (open, under review, firmed, converted, rejected), planner override details, converting planner ID, and the material/plant combination. Serves as the single actionable output of MRP runs requiring human review before release to procurement or production. Sourced from SAP PP/MM and Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM planning outputs.

attributes.name: planned_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the planned order generated by MRP/APS system. Primary key.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bill of materials that defines the component requirements for this planned production order.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Procurement Cost Allocation Report assigns each planned order to a cost center for budgeting and cost accounting.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Make‑to‑order production planning requires linking each planned order to the originating customer account for order tracking and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: engineering_revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.revision. Business justification: Production scheduling uses a specific component revision; the Planned Order Detail report references engineering.revision.revision_id to ensure the correct version is manufactured.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which this planned order was generated.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the MRP or APS planning execution that generated this planned order.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Planned orders in make‑to‑order environments originate from a specific sales order; linking enables the 'Planned Order to Sales Order Traceability' process.

attributes.name: primary_planned_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the planner who firmed this planned order, locking it from automatic replanning.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.recipe. Business justification: Associates each planned order with the recipe governing its production steps, required for the Order‑Recipe Traceability dashboard.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing that defines the sequence of operations and work centers for manufacturing this material.

attributes.name: sales_order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Planned orders are created from confirmed order intake; linking enables order‑to‑production tracking.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Production planning ties each planned order to the SKU master for cost, compliance, and reporting of the manufactured product.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred supplier for this material when the order type is purchase requisition or subcontract order.

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours
attributes.description: Production capacity in hours available at the work center or plant for executing this planned order, used for capacity planning validation.

attributes.name: converted_order_number
attributes.description: Document number of the production order, purchase requisition, or stock transfer order created when this planned order was converted to an executable order.

attributes.name: converted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the planned order was converted to an executable order.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this planned order record was first created in the system by the planning run.

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that this planned order has been marked for deletion by a subsequent planning run because the requirement no longer exists or has been satisfied by other means.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying planning exceptions or issues requiring planner intervention (e.g., capacity overload, material shortage, lead time violation, MOQ conflict).

attributes.name: exception_message
attributes.description: Detailed description of the planning exception or constraint violation that requires planner review and resolution.

attributes.name: firmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the planned order was firmed by the planner.

attributes.name: firming_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this planned order has been firmed by the planner, preventing it from being automatically changed or deleted by subsequent planning runs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this planned order record was last updated, either by a subsequent planning run or by manual planner intervention.

attributes.name: lot_size_rule
attributes.description: Lot sizing method applied by the planning system: exact_quantity (order exact requirement), moq (minimum order quantity), fixed_lot (standard batch size), or rounding (round up to packaging unit).

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity constraint from the supplier or production process that was applied during lot sizing.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Code identifying the planner or planning group responsible for reviewing and converting this planned order.

attributes.name: multi_tier_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that this planned order requires coordination across multiple tiers of the supply network (e.g., raw material supplier, component manufacturer, final assembly).

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Type of replenishment action proposed by the planning system: production order for in-house manufacturing, purchase requisition for external procurement, stock transfer for inter-plant movement, or subcontract order for external processing.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material proposed for replenishment by the planning run, expressed in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the planner documenting decisions, constraints, or coordination details related to this planned order.

attributes.name: planner_override_date
attributes.description: Manually adjusted scheduled finish date entered by the planner to override the system-calculated date based on capacity constraints or customer negotiation.

attributes.name: planner_override_quantity
attributes.description: Manually adjusted quantity entered by the planner to override the system-calculated planned quantity based on business judgment or known constraints.

attributes.name: planning_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the planning run that created this planned order was executed.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or distribution center where the planned order will be executed.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Planning priority assigned to this order based on demand urgency, customer importance, or supply risk. Critical orders require immediate planner attention.

attributes.name: procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to procure or produce the material, used by the planning system to calculate scheduled start date from requirement date.

attributes.name: proposal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the planned order proposal: open (awaiting planner review), under_review (being evaluated), firmed (approved for conversion), converted (released to execution), rejected (not needed), or cancelled (superseded by new planning run).

attributes.name: required_capacity_hours
attributes.description: Production capacity in hours required to complete this planned order based on routing and quantity.

attributes.name: requirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the material is needed to fulfill a sales order, production order component, or safety stock replenishment.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock level maintained to protect against demand variability or supply disruptions, factored into the planning calculation.

attributes.name: scheduled_finish_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the material should be available to satisfy the downstream requirement or customer demand.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date when production or procurement activities should begin to meet the requirement date, calculated backward from finish date using lead time.

attributes.name: source_requirement_number
attributes.description: Document number of the originating requirement (sales order, production order, forecast entry) that drove the creation of this planned order.

attributes.name: source_requirement_type
attributes.description: Type of demand that triggered the creation of this planned order: sales order (customer demand), production order (component requirement), safety stock (replenishment), forecast (anticipated demand), or service order (spare parts).

attributes.name: supply_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk assessment score (0-100) indicating the likelihood of supply disruption for this planned order based on supplier performance, lead time volatility, and geopolitical factors.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the planned quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, M for meter).

products.name: demand_forecast
products.description: Stores version-aware demand forecast records supporting scenario comparison and consensus planning. Captures statistical baseline forecasts, sales-adjusted forecasts, consensus forecasts, and approved forecasts with full version lineage. Each record includes forecast quantity, forecast horizon, forecast model used, confidence interval, demand class (independent vs. dependent), item/location combination, version type, version approval workflow status, and planning period. Supports S&OP processes by maintaining multiple demand scenarios for supply planning sensitivity analysis. Sourced from Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM demand planning module.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand forecast record. Primary key for the demand forecast entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Customer‑specific demand forecasts are generated per account to support sales‑aligned planning and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: demand_plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the forecast version record enabling scenario comparison and version lineage tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this forecast version in the workflow. Used for accountability and audit trail in demand planning governance.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or item being forecasted. Links to the material master record in inventory domain.

attributes.name: sales_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.forecast. Business justification: Demand forecasting aligns internal plans with external sales forecasts; linking enables S&OP reconciliation.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Forecasting uses the SKU master to align demand quantities with product specifications and pricing.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planning location, warehouse, or distribution center for which demand is forecasted.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Comments or notes provided by the approver during the forecast approval workflow, documenting decision rationale or conditions.

attributes.name: bias_percent
attributes.description: Systematic forecast bias expressed as percentage, indicating tendency to over-forecast (positive) or under-forecast (negative). Used to detect and correct systematic errors.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the forecast confidence interval, representing the pessimistic demand scenario for risk analysis and safety stock planning.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the forecast confidence interval, representing the optimistic demand scenario for capacity planning and supply risk assessment.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level of the forecast interval expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95% confidence). Used for supply planning sensitivity analysis.

attributes.name: consensus_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast achieved consensus approval in the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process, marking it as the agreed demand plan.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_segment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer segment or channel for which this forecast applies (e.g., OEM, AFTERMARKET, DISTRIBUTOR). Enables segment-level demand planning.

attributes.name: demand_class
attributes.description: Classification of demand type: independent (end-customer driven, forecasted) or dependent (derived from BOM and parent item demand via MRP explosion).

attributes.name: demand_pattern
attributes.description: Characterization of the historical demand behavior pattern used to select appropriate forecasting models and safety stock strategies.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Historical accuracy percentage of the forecast model for this material-location combination, calculated as (1 - MAPE) * 100. Used for model selection and tuning.

attributes.name: forecast_consumption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast is subject to consumption by actual customer orders in the MRP logic. Controls forecast vs. order-driven planning behavior.

attributes.name: forecast_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the forecast was generated by the forecasting engine or planning system. Represents the business event time of forecast creation.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days into the future that this forecast covers, calculated from the planning period start date. Used for lead time coverage analysis.

attributes.name: forecast_model_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the statistical or algorithmic model used to generate the forecast (e.g., ARIMA, EXP_SMOOTH, MOVING_AVG, ML_ENSEMBLE).

attributes.name: forecast_model_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the forecasting model or algorithm applied to generate this forecast.

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the forecast record, externally visible and used for tracking and reference in planning meetings.

attributes.name: forecast_quantity
attributes.description: Predicted demand quantity for the material at the specified location during the planning period. Core forecast value used for MRP and capacity planning.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast record in the approval workflow. Tracks progression from draft through approval or rejection.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this forecast record, tracking manual adjustments or workflow updates.

attributes.name: mean_absolute_percentage_error
attributes.description: MAPE metric measuring forecast error as a percentage of actual demand. Lower values indicate better forecast accuracy. Key KPI for demand planning performance.

attributes.name: mrp_area_code
attributes.description: MRP area code defining the planning scope and organizational unit for material requirements planning execution.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this forecast record, capturing planner insights, assumptions, or special considerations.

attributes.name: outlier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast was flagged as a statistical outlier requiring review. Used for data quality monitoring and exception management.

attributes.name: outlier_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this forecast was flagged as an outlier, documenting the business or statistical reason for the exception.

attributes.name: planning_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the planning group or demand planner responsible for this forecast. Used for workload distribution and accountability.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning period for which this forecast applies. Defines the end of the demand horizon.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning period for which this forecast applies. Defines the beginning of the demand horizon.

attributes.name: product_lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the product in its lifecycle. Influences forecasting model selection and demand pattern expectations.

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast includes promotional or campaign-driven demand uplift. Used to separate base demand from promotional spikes.

attributes.name: promotional_uplift_percent
attributes.description: Expected percentage increase in demand due to promotional activities during the planning period. Used for promotional planning and inventory pre-positioning.

attributes.name: sales_adjustment_quantity
attributes.description: Manual adjustment quantity applied by sales team to the statistical baseline forecast, reflecting market intelligence and customer commitments.

attributes.name: sales_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the sales adjustment, documenting market intelligence, customer commitments, or promotional activities driving the override.

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Name of the planning scenario this forecast belongs to (e.g., Base Case, Optimistic, Pessimistic, New Product Launch). Enables scenario comparison and sensitivity analysis.

attributes.name: seasonality_index
attributes.description: Seasonal adjustment factor applied to the forecast for this planning period. Values above 1.0 indicate peak season, below 1.0 indicate off-season.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system that generated or provided this forecast record (e.g., D365_SCM, SAP_APO, CUSTOM_MODEL).

attributes.name: trend_coefficient
attributes.description: Trend component coefficient from the forecasting model, indicating the rate of demand growth or decline over time.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the forecast quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter). Must align with material master base UOM.

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast version: baseline (statistical model output), sales_adjusted (sales team input), consensus (S&OP aligned), approved (final for MRP), or working (draft).

products.name: plan
products.description: Master supply plan record representing the approved supply response to demand for a given planning period, plant, and material group. Captures planned supply quantities by time bucket, planning method (MRP, APS, manual), plan version, approval status, planning parameters (strategy, horizon, time fences, lot-sizing procedure, MRP controller), and variance against demand forecast. Integrates outputs from SAP PP and Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM APS scheduling into a unified supply position for S&OP review.
products.reference: APS Supply Plan / SAP PP - Planning Table

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for plan

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Supply Plan vs Budget variance analysis requires linking each supply plan to its responsible cost center.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this supply plan for execution, establishing accountability for S&OP decisions.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Specific material or SKU for which this supply plan is created. May be null for aggregate material group plans.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Supply plans reference the SKU master to allocate production capacity and material supply per product.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply plan was approved, marking the transition from planning to execution phase.

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of available production or procurement capacity utilized by this supply plan, indicating capacity constraints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this supply plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_quantity
attributes.description: Total forecasted demand quantity for the planning period, serving as the primary input to the supply plan.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this supply plan record was last updated, tracking the most recent change to planning parameters or status.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total lead time in days from order placement to material availability, including procurement, production, and transportation time.

attributes.name: lot_sizing_procedure
attributes.description: Lot-sizing rule used to determine planned order quantities: LOT_FOR_LOT (exact requirement), FIXED_LOT (fixed quantity), EOQ (Economic Order Quantity), POQ (Periodic Order Quantity), or PERIOD_LOT (period-based aggregation).

attributes.name: material_group_code
attributes.description: Material group or product family covered by this supply plan, enabling aggregated planning at the product category level.

attributes.name: maximum_lot_size
attributes.description: Maximum order quantity constraint applied during supply planning, reflecting capacity or storage limitations.

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity (MOQ) constraint applied during supply planning, reflecting supplier or production constraints.

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for this supply plan, enabling workload distribution and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from planners regarding assumptions, constraints, or special considerations for this supply plan.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the supply plan, used for cross-system reference and S&OP review documentation.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply plan: DRAFT (under development), PENDING_REVIEW (awaiting S&OP approval), APPROVED (approved for execution), ACTIVE (currently executing), SUPERSEDED (replaced by newer version), or CANCELLED (voided).

attributes.name: planned_supply_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material planned to be supplied during the planning period, aggregated across all time buckets.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days into the future covered by this supply plan, defining the forward-looking planning window.

attributes.name: planning_method
