attributes.name: blocked_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material that is blocked for use due to quality issues, damage, or other restrictions. This stock cannot be used for production or sales.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory position record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: The number of days the current on-hand inventory will last based on average daily demand. Calculated as on-hand quantity divided by average daily consumption rate.

attributes.name: excess_stock_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the material has excess inventory above normal levels. True if on-hand quantity significantly exceeds safety stock plus near-term demand.

attributes.name: forecast_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Total forecasted demand quantity for the material within the planning horizon. This is the statistical forecast used for supply planning when firm sales orders are not yet available.

attributes.name: in_quality_inspection_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently in quality inspection status and not yet released for unrestricted use. This stock is physically available but not yet approved for consumption.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory position record was last updated in the lakehouse. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: last_mrp_run_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Run Date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent MRP run that calculated this inventory position. Used to track data freshness and planning cycle frequency.

tag_set.value: Last Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Run Date

attributes.name: lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: The standard lot size or batch quantity used for replenishment orders. This is the fixed order quantity or economic order quantity (EOQ) used in lot-sizing calculations.

attributes.name: manufacturing_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days required to manufacture the material from raw materials to finished goods. This is the production lead time used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in the ERP system. This is the business key for the material master record.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from the supplier or produced in a manufacturing run. MRP respects this constraint when generating planned orders.

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for managing this material. Used for workload distribution and accountability.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: The MRP type code that determines how the material is planned. PD = MRP, VB = consumption-based planning, ND = no planning, X0 = no MRP.

attributes.name: net_requirement_quantity
attributes.description: The net material requirement calculated by MRP as total demand minus available supply. A positive value indicates a shortage that requires replenishment action.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Physical stock quantity currently available in the warehouse or storage location. This is the unrestricted-use stock available for consumption or sale.

attributes.name: open_planned_order_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material on planned orders generated by MRP but not yet converted to firm production or purchase orders. These are MRP-generated supply recommendations.

attributes.name: open_production_order_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material on open production orders (manufacturing orders) that are in progress or scheduled but not yet completed and received into stock.

attributes.name: open_purchase_order_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material on open purchase orders that have been released to suppliers but not yet received. This represents inbound supply in transit or scheduled for delivery.

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which a planned or open order is scheduled to be received into stock. This is the next expected supply arrival date.

attributes.name: planning_strategy_group
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the planning strategy for the material (e.g., make-to-stock, make-to-order, engineer-to-order). Determines how demand and supply are matched.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or distribution center where the inventory is held.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is procured. E = in-house production (manufactured), F = external procurement (purchased), X = both.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered. When on-hand stock falls to or below this level, MRP (Material Requirements Planning) generates a planned order.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of on-hand stock that has been reserved or allocated for specific production orders, projects, or customer orders and is not available for general consumption.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The target safety stock level maintained to buffer against demand variability and supply uncertainty. This is the minimum inventory level the planner aims to maintain.

attributes.name: sales_order_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material committed to open sales orders. This represents firm customer demand that must be fulfilled.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The date for which this inventory position snapshot was calculated. This is the business event date representing the point-in-time view of supply and demand.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this inventory position data was extracted (e.g., SAP, D365 for Dynamics 365, MES for Manufacturing Execution System).

attributes.name: stock_out_risk_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the material is at risk of stock-out based on current inventory position and demand forecast. True if ATP is below safety stock or net requirement is positive.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific storage location within the plant where the material is stored.

attributes.name: supplier_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days required from order placement to receipt of material from the supplier. This is the procurement lead time used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the material quantity is measured (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter, M for meter).

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: The XYZ classification of the material based on demand variability. X items have stable demand, Y items have moderate variability, Z items have highly variable or sporadic demand.

products.name: moq_constraint
products.description: Captures Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) and lot-sizing constraints for each material-supplier combination, including MOQ value, order quantity rounding value, maximum order quantity, fixed lot size, and the business justification for the constraint. Tracks MOQ negotiation history and exceptions approved by supply planners. These constraints directly influence MRP lot-size calculations and procurement cost optimization.
products.reference: SAP MM - Purchasing Info Record / Material Master MRP Data

attributes.name: moq_constraint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MOQ constraint record. Primary key for the moq_constraint product.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material subject to this MOQ constraint. Links to the material master record in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: moq_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supply planner or procurement specialist who negotiated this MOQ constraint with the supplier.

attributes.name: moq_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this MOQ constraint record.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: MOQ constraints are defined per SKU to enforce minimum order quantities in procurement.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier imposing this MOQ constraint. Links to the supplier master record.

attributes.name: apply_to_forecast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MOQ constraint should be applied to forecast-driven planned orders in addition to customer order-driven requirements.

attributes.name: apply_to_safety_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MOQ constraint should be applied when MRP generates planned orders to replenish safety stock levels.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale for this MOQ constraint, including supplier requirements, cost optimization considerations, logistics constraints, or contractual obligations.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Reason for the most recent change to this MOQ constraint, documenting supplier negotiations, market conditions, or business strategy shifts.

attributes.name: constraint_source
attributes.description: Origin or driver of this MOQ constraint, indicating whether it stems from supplier requirements, logistics limitations, cost considerations, or other factors.

attributes.name: constraint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MOQ constraint. Only active constraints are applied by MRP during planning runs.

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Type of lot-sizing constraint applied to this material-supplier combination. Determines how MRP calculates procurement quantities.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the purchasing contract or supplier agreement that defines this MOQ constraint.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost impact value.

attributes.name: cost_impact_per_unit
attributes.description: Estimated cost impact per unit when ordering below the MOQ threshold. Used for cost-benefit analysis of MOQ exceptions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MOQ constraint record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this MOQ constraint is no longer effective. Null indicates an open-ended constraint with no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this MOQ constraint becomes effective and is applied by MRP planning logic.

attributes.name: exception_approval_authority
attributes.description: Role or position authorized to approve exceptions to this MOQ constraint (e.g., Supply Planning Manager, Procurement Director).

attributes.name: exception_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether exceptions to this MOQ constraint can be approved by supply planners on a case-by-case basis.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size
attributes.description: Fixed lot size for procurement. When set, MRP generates planned orders in exact multiples of this quantity regardless of net requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MOQ constraint record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this MOQ constraint was last reviewed and validated by supply planning or procurement teams.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum order quantity allowed per purchase order for this material-supplier combination. MRP will split requirements exceeding this limit into multiple planned orders.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the MOQ value (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters). Must align with material base unit or order unit.

attributes.name: moq_value
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity that must be purchased from this supplier for this material. MRP will not generate planned orders below this threshold.

attributes.name: mrp_lot_sizing_procedure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Lot-Sizing Procedure Code
attributes.description: SAP MRP lot-sizing procedure code that incorporates this MOQ constraint (e.g., EX for lot-for-lot with rounding, HB for replenish to maximum stock level).

tag_set.value: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Lot-Sizing Procedure Code

attributes.name: negotiation_date
attributes.description: Date when this MOQ constraint was negotiated and agreed upon with the supplier.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this MOQ constraint to ensure it remains aligned with business needs and supplier capabilities.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this MOQ constraint, including special handling instructions, exception history, or supplier communication details.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code where this MOQ constraint applies. May be null if constraint applies globally across all plants.

attributes.name: previous_moq_value
attributes.description: Previous minimum order quantity value before the most recent change. Used to track MOQ negotiation history and trends.

attributes.name: priority_ranking
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this constraint when multiple MOQ constraints exist for the same material from different suppliers. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization_code
attributes.description: Purchasing organization responsible for negotiating and managing this MOQ constraint.

attributes.name: rounding_value
attributes.description: Rounding increment for order quantities. MRP rounds planned order quantities up to the nearest multiple of this value (e.g., rounding value of 10 means orders in multiples of 10).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this MOQ constraint record originated (e.g., SAP_MM, ARIBA, D365_SCM).

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this MOQ constraint record in the source system, enabling traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: supplier_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from this supplier for this material, associated with orders meeting the MOQ constraint.

attributes.name: supplier_package_quantity
attributes.description: Standard package or container quantity defined by the supplier. Orders must be placed in multiples of this package size.

products.name: demand_plan_version
products.description: Manages versioned demand plan records enabling scenario comparison and consensus planning. Captures plan version identifier, version type (baseline statistical, sales-adjusted, consensus, approved), creation date, planning horizon, total planned demand quantity, and version approval workflow status. Supports S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) processes by maintaining multiple demand scenarios for supply planning sensitivity analysis in Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.
products.reference: Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM - Demand Planning Versions

attributes.name: demand_plan_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand plan version record. Primary key for the demand plan version entity.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent demand plan that this version belongs to. Links to the master demand plan entity.

attributes.name: primary_demand_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who granted final approval for this demand plan version. Links to the user or employee master for audit trail and accountability in the S&OP approval workflow.

attributes.name: superseded_by_version_demand_plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer demand plan version that replaces this version. Null if this is the current active version. Maintains version lineage and audit trail for plan evolution tracking.

attributes.name: tertiary_demand_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who most recently modified this demand plan version record. Links to the user or employee master for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this demand plan version was formally approved by authorized stakeholders. Null if version has not yet been approved. Marks the transition to executable plan status.

attributes.name: approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demand plan version has received formal approval through the S&OP governance process. True if approved for execution, false if still in draft or review.

attributes.name: baseline_version_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this version serves as the baseline reference for variance analysis and scenario comparison. True if this is the authoritative baseline, false for alternative scenarios or working versions.

attributes.name: bias_percentage
attributes.description: Systematic tendency of this demand plan version to over-forecast (positive bias) or under-forecast (negative bias) actual demand. Calculated as the sum of forecast errors divided by sum of actuals, used to detect and correct persistent forecasting errors.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percentage
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the demand forecast in this version. Represents the probability that actual demand will fall within the forecasted range, typically 80%, 90%, or 95% confidence intervals used for safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this demand plan version record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: demand_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the current date within which demand changes are frozen or restricted. Defines the period where MRP (Material Requirements Planning) will not automatically adjust planned orders based on forecast changes, protecting near-term production stability.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Measured accuracy of this demand plan version compared to actual demand realization. Calculated as 100 minus the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), used for continuous improvement of forecasting methods and model selection.

attributes.name: forecast_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the statistical or algorithmic model used to generate demand forecasts in this version (e.g., ARIMA, exponential smoothing, machine learning model). Applicable when planning method is statistical or APS.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this demand plan version record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: material_group_code
attributes.description: Product family or material group classification for demand aggregation. Used to organize demand planning at the product category level before disaggregation to individual SKUs (Stock Keeping Units).

attributes.name: planning_horizon_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days covered by this demand plan version. Calculated as the difference between planning horizon end and start dates, used for capacity planning and lead time analysis.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the planning period covered by this demand plan version. Defines the end of the forecast window, typically aligned with fiscal quarters or annual planning cycles.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the planning period covered by this demand plan version. Defines the beginning of the forecast window for supply planning and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) execution.

attributes.name: planning_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to generate this demand plan version. Statistical uses algorithmic forecasting, collaborative incorporates cross-functional input, consensus reflects S&OP agreement, APS (Advanced Planning and Scheduling) uses optimization engines, and manual indicates planner-driven creation.

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the current date within which supply planning changes require manual approval. Defines the period where automated MRP adjustments are restricted to prevent disruption to committed production schedules.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code for which this demand plan version applies. Links to the plant master in SAP PP or Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM for location-specific demand planning.

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Business name for the planning scenario represented by this version. Used for what-if analysis and sensitivity testing in S&OP processes (e.g., Optimistic Growth, Conservative Base, Supply Constrained).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the operational system that created or owns this demand plan version record. Typically Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM, SAP APO (Advanced Planning and Optimization), or specialized demand planning applications for data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: total_planned_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate demand quantity across all materials and time buckets within this plan version. Represents the total forecasted demand volume for supply network capacity planning and scenario comparison.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the total planned demand quantity. Typically base inventory unit (EA, KG, L, M) aligned with material master UOM definitions in SAP MM or Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.

attributes.name: version_notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary and business context for this demand plan version. Captures assumptions, market conditions, promotional events, supply constraints, or other factors influencing the forecast that are relevant for scenario interpretation and decision-making.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the demand plan version. Human-readable version code used for tracking and referencing specific plan iterations (e.g., V1.0, V2.1, BASELINE-2024Q1).

attributes.name: version_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand plan version. Tracks the approval workflow state from initial draft through review, approval, and eventual archival or supersession by newer versions.

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand plan version indicating its purpose and stage in the S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) process. Baseline represents initial statistical forecast, sales-adjusted includes sales team input, consensus reflects cross-functional agreement, approved is the final authorized plan, and working is an in-progress draft.

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date when this demand plan version was created. Represents the business event timestamp for version instantiation in the S&OP cycle.

products.name: sop_cycle
products.description: Represents a Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle record for the industrial manufacturing business, capturing the monthly integrated business planning process execution. Records planning cycle period, participating business units (automation, electrification, smart infrastructure), demand review status, supply review status, pre-S&OP meeting outcomes, executive S&OP decisions, approved supply plan version, approved demand forecast version, key supply/demand gap resolutions, and financial reconciliation status. Serves as the governance audit record linking demand consensus to supply commitment for each planning period. Managed through Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM integrated business planning.

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the S&OP cycle record. Primary key.

tag_set.value: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID

attributes.name: primary_sop_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user responsible for orchestrating and managing this S&OP cycle. Typically the S&OP manager or demand planning manager.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the S&OP cycle was formally approved by executive leadership, marking the transition to execution phase.

attributes.name: approved_demand_forecast_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the demand forecast approved during this S&OP cycle. Links to the demand forecast master data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.

attributes.name: approved_supply_plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the supply plan approved during this S&OP cycle. Links to the supply plan master data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM and SAP PP/MM.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary business unit participating in this S&OP cycle (e.g., AUTO for Automation, ELEC for Electrification, INFRA for Smart Infrastructure).

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target capacity utilization percentage for manufacturing plants during the planning period. Used to assess supply plan feasibility and identify capacity constraints.

attributes.name: cost_plan_amount
attributes.description: Total planned cost of goods sold (COGS) for the planning period based on the approved supply plan and material/labor cost assumptions. Used for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP cycle record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the S&OP cycle, often including the planning period and business context (e.g., 'January 2024 S&OP Cycle - Automation Division').

attributes.name: cycle_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special circumstances, or important observations related to this S&OP cycle.

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the S&OP cycle, typically formatted as SOP-YYYY-MM representing the planning period.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the S&OP cycle. Tracks progression through demand review, supply review, pre-S&OP meeting, executive S&OP decision, approval, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|demand_review|supply_review|pre_sop|executive_sop|approved|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: demand_review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the demand review phase was completed and demand consensus was achieved.

attributes.name: demand_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the demand review phase within this S&OP cycle. Tracks completion of demand consensus building across sales, marketing, and product management.

attributes.name: demand_supply_gap_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity gap between demand forecast and supply plan across all materials and time periods within this S&OP cycle. Positive values indicate demand exceeds supply; negative values indicate supply exceeds demand.

attributes.name: demand_supply_gap_value
attributes.description: Aggregate financial value of the demand-supply gap in base currency. Represents revenue at risk (if demand exceeds supply) or excess inventory exposure (if supply exceeds demand).

attributes.name: executive_sop_decision
attributes.description: Summary of executive decisions made during the executive S&OP meeting, including strategic trade-offs, investment approvals, and final plan authorization.

attributes.name: executive_sop_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date when the executive S&OP meeting was held for final decision-making and plan approval by senior leadership.

attributes.name: financial_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when financial reconciliation was completed and the S&OP plan was aligned with the financial budget.

attributes.name: financial_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of financial reconciliation between the approved S&OP plan and the financial budget. Ensures alignment between operational plans and financial commitments.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year, typically 1-12, used for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this S&OP cycle belongs, used for financial reconciliation and annual planning alignment.

attributes.name: gap_resolution_strategy
attributes.description: Description of the strategy approved to resolve demand-supply gaps, including capacity expansion, supplier escalation, demand shaping, inventory build, or customer allocation decisions.

attributes.name: inventory_plan_value
attributes.description: Target inventory value at the end of the planning period based on the approved supply plan. Used for working capital planning and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: key_assumptions
attributes.description: Critical assumptions underlying the S&OP plan, including market conditions, customer demand drivers, supplier performance, capacity availability, and economic factors.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP cycle record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_months
attributes.description: Number of months into the future covered by this S&OP cycle planning horizon. Typically 12-18 months for industrial manufacturing.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning horizon covered by this S&OP cycle. Typically the last day of the month for monthly S&OP cycles.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning horizon covered by this S&OP cycle. Typically the first day of the month for monthly S&OP cycles.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Primary manufacturing plant code for which this S&OP cycle is executed. Links to SAP S/4HANA plant master data.

attributes.name: pre_sop_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date when the pre-S&OP meeting was held to reconcile demand and supply plans and prepare recommendations for executive review.

attributes.name: pre_sop_meeting_outcome
attributes.description: Summary of key decisions, gap resolutions, and recommendations from the pre-S&OP meeting. Captures consensus on demand-supply balance and escalation items for executive S&OP.

attributes.name: revenue_plan_amount
attributes.description: Total planned revenue for the planning period based on the approved demand forecast and pricing assumptions. Used for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this S&OP cycle record originated. Typically Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM integrated business planning module.

attributes.name: supply_review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply review phase was completed and supply commitment was established.

attributes.name: supply_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the supply review phase within this S&OP cycle. Tracks completion of supply capability assessment across manufacturing, procurement, and logistics.

attributes.name: supply_risk_level
attributes.description: Overall supply risk assessment for this S&OP cycle, considering supplier lead times, capacity constraints, material availability, and geopolitical factors.

attributes.name: supply_risk_mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Description of actions planned to mitigate identified supply risks, including supplier diversification, safety stock increases, or alternative sourcing strategies.

products.name: allocation
products.description: Records supply allocation decisions made when available supply is insufficient to meet total demand across the industrial manufacturing portfolio. Specifies how constrained supply of automation components, electrification modules, or smart infrastructure products is distributed across OEM customers, regional distribution centers, plants, or product lines. Captures allocation quantity, allocation priority, allocation method (proportional, priority-based, customer-tier, contractual commitment), allocation period, demand requests being fulfilled or partially fulfilled, and the constraining supply plan reference. Critical for managing semiconductor shortages, long-lead-time component constraints, and force majeure events in industrial manufacturing supply chains.
products.reference: SAP ATP - Supply Allocation / Dynamics 365 SCM Allocation

attributes.name: allocation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for allocation

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account receiving the allocation when allocation_recipient_type is customer or oem_partner.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain manager or executive who approved this allocation decision.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Allocation of supply to specific sales order lines is required for the 'Order Fulfillment Allocation' process, ensuring each line's quantity is matched to available supply.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the automation component, electrification module, or smart infrastructure product being allocated.

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_contract. Business justification: Allocation of supply quantities to fulfill obligations under specific service contracts (Contract Allocation dashboard).

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Allocation records allocate available supply to specific SKUs for order fulfillment.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier whose capacity or delivery constraints triggered the allocation decision.

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the constrained supply plan that triggered this allocation decision.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material allocated to the recipient entity (customer, plant, distribution center, or product line).

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique allocation identifier used for tracking and reference in supply chain communications.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allocation decision in the supply chain workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|proposed|approved|active|partially_fulfilled|fulfilled|cancelled|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the allocation decision was formally approved for execution.

attributes.name: available_supply_quantity
attributes.description: Total constrained supply quantity available for allocation across all competing demand requests.

attributes.name: communication_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether allocation notification has been sent to the affected customer or recipient entity.

attributes.name: communication_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when allocation notification was sent to the recipient.

attributes.name: constraint_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the supply constraint circumstances, including supplier names, affected components, and expected resolution timeline.

attributes.name: constraint_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the supply constraint that necessitated this allocation decision.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the supply contract or SLA that mandates this allocation when contractual_commitment_flag is true.

attributes.name: contractual_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation fulfills a contractual supply commitment or service level agreement (SLA) obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_tier
attributes.description: Customer segmentation tier used in priority-based or customer-tier allocation methods to determine allocation preference.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the allocation decision was made by the supply planning team or automated allocation engine.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation decision required executive escalation due to high business impact or customer sensitivity.

attributes.name: expected_resolution_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the supply constraint will be resolved and normal supply levels restored.

attributes.name: fulfillment_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of requested quantity that was allocated, calculated as (allocated_quantity / requested_quantity) * 100.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation record was last updated or revised.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Algorithm or business rule used to distribute constrained supply across competing demand requests.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special considerations, exceptions, or business rationale for the allocation decision.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time period for which this allocation decision is effective.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period for which this allocation decision is effective.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or distribution center where the constrained supply originates.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking assigned to this allocation decision, where lower numbers indicate higher priority in fulfillment sequencing.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product line receiving the allocation when allocation_recipient_type is product_line.

attributes.name: recipient_distribution_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regional distribution center receiving the allocation when allocation_recipient_type is distribution_center.

attributes.name: recipient_plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the recipient plant when allocation_recipient_type is plant.

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Type of entity receiving the allocated supply, used to determine the appropriate recipient identifier field.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity requested by the recipient before allocation constraints were applied.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that created this allocation record (e.g., D365_SCM for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, SAP_PP for SAP Production Planning).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the allocated quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, M for meter).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the allocation decision, incremented when allocation is revised or rebalanced.

products.name: replenishment_proposal
products.description: Consolidates MRP-generated replenishment proposals for buyer/planner review before conversion to purchase orders or production orders. Captures proposal type (purchase requisition, planned production order, stock transfer), proposed quantity, proposed dates, supplying source, proposal status (open, firmed, converted, rejected), and planner override details. Represents the actionable output of MRP runs requiring human review in SAP MM/PP.

attributes.name: replenishment_proposal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment proposal record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which replenishment is proposed.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRP run that generated this replenishment proposal.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Replenishment proposals are triggered by individual sales orders; linking to order_header enables the 'Replenishment Proposal Generation' report.

attributes.name: primary_replenishment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who firmed this proposal, locking it from automatic MRP adjustments.

attributes.name: replenishment_plant_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.plant

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.request. Business justification: Replenishment proposals are generated from field service requests for spare parts (Service‑Driven Replenishment process).

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Replenishment proposals are generated per SKU to trigger purchase orders or production.

attributes.name: source_plant_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.plant

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred or proposed supplier for external procurement proposals. Null for in-house production proposals.

attributes.name: converted_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the purchase order, production order, or stock transport order created from this proposal. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: converted_document_type
attributes.description: Type of execution document created when the proposal was converted: purchase_order, production_order, stock_transport_order, or subcontract_order. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: converted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the proposal was converted into a purchase order, production order, or stock transport order.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment proposal record was first created in the system, typically during MRP run execution.

attributes.name: exception_message_code
attributes.description: MRP exception or warning code associated with this proposal (e.g., reschedule in, reschedule out, cancel, increase quantity, decrease quantity). Alerts planner to abnormal conditions.

attributes.name: exception_message_text
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the MRP exception or planning situation requiring planner attention.

attributes.name: firmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposal has been firmed by the planner. Firmed proposals are protected from automatic MRP changes in subsequent runs.

attributes.name: firmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the proposal was firmed by the planner.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment proposal record was last updated, capturing planner actions, status changes, or subsequent MRP run adjustments.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total procurement or production lead time in days used to calculate the proposed order date from the requirement date. Includes processing, manufacturing, and transit time.

attributes.name: lot_sizing_procedure
attributes.description: Algorithm used by MRP to determine the proposed quantity: lot_for_lot (exact requirement), fixed_lot_size (standard batch), economic_order_quantity (EOQ optimization), period_lot_size (aggregate period demand), or replenish_to_max (fill to maximum stock level).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity constraint applied during MRP calculation, typically driven by supplier requirements or production batch minimums.

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or buyer/planner responsible for reviewing and actioning this proposal.

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the planner documenting decisions, overrides, or special handling instructions for this proposal.

attributes.name: planner_override_date
attributes.description: Manually adjusted delivery date entered by the planner, overriding the MRP-calculated proposed delivery date. Null if no override applied.

attributes.name: planner_override_quantity
attributes.description: Manually adjusted quantity entered by the planner, overriding the MRP-calculated proposed quantity. Null if no override applied.

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this proposal falls within the planning time fence period where automatic MRP changes are restricted and planner approval is required for modifications.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Urgency level assigned to the proposal: critical (immediate action required), high (expedited processing), normal (standard lead time), or low (can be delayed if needed).

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Method of procurement for the material: external (purchased from supplier), in_house (manufactured internally), or both (mixed procurement strategy).

attributes.name: proposal_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the replenishment proposal, typically system-generated or following organizational numbering convention.

attributes.name: proposal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment proposal: open (awaiting planner review), firmed (approved by planner but not yet converted), converted (transformed into purchase order or production order), rejected (declined by planner), cancelled (voided due to changed requirements), or on_hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: proposal_type
attributes.description: Type of replenishment action proposed by MRP: purchase requisition for external procurement, planned production order for in-house manufacturing, stock transfer request for inter-plant movement, subcontract order for external processing, or external procurement for direct vendor shipment.

attributes.name: proposed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the material should be available to meet demand requirements, calculated by MRP based on lead time and requirement date.

attributes.name: proposed_order_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition or production order should be created to meet the proposed delivery date, accounting for procurement or manufacturing lead time.

attributes.name: proposed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material recommended by MRP for replenishment, calculated based on net requirements, lot sizing rules, and safety stock policies.

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities for this material category. Used for purchase requisition routing.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the planner rejected this proposal (e.g., obsolete material, demand cancelled, alternative source selected). Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_text
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the proposal was rejected by the planner. Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers replenishment proposal generation in reorder point planning scenarios.

attributes.name: requirement_date
attributes.description: Original date when the material is needed to satisfy customer orders, production schedules, or safety stock targets. Drives the MRP calculation.

attributes.name: rounding_value
attributes.description: Rounding increment applied to the proposed quantity to align with packaging, pallet, or container standards (e.g., round to nearest 10, 50, or 100 units).

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Safety stock level maintained for this material at this location. MRP generates proposals to maintain this buffer against demand variability.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that generated this replenishment proposal (e.g., SAP_PP, D365_SCM, APS_SYSTEM).

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Specific storage location within the plant where the replenished material will be received and stored.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the proposed quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter, M for meter).

products.name: planning_parameter
products.description: Stores the configurable planning parameters that govern MRP and APS behavior for each material-plant combination, including planning strategy (make-to-stock, make-to-order, assemble-to-order), planning horizon, time fence (firm zone, trade-off zone, planning zone), lot-sizing procedure, planning calendar, and MRP controller assignment. These parameters directly control how the supply planning engine generates planned orders and requirements.
products.reference: SAP MM - Material Master MRP1/MRP2/MRP3 Views

attributes.name: planning_parameter_id
attributes.description: Primary key for planning_parameter

attributes.name: planning_calendar_id
attributes.description: Factory calendar identifier that defines working days, holidays, and shifts used to schedule planned order dates and calculate lead times.

attributes.name: primary_planning_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the planner or administrator who created this planning parameter configuration record.

attributes.name: primary_planning_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which these planning parameters apply.

attributes.name: process_parameter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.process_parameter. Business justification: Connects planning parameters to defined process parameters, enabling the Production Planning‑Execution Alignment report that validates parameter consistency.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Planning parameters (lot size, lead time) are stored per SKU to drive MRP calculations.

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the material based on consumption value or strategic importance: A=High Value/Critical, B=Medium Value/Moderate, C=Low Value/Routine, used to prioritize planning attention and inventory policies.

attributes.name: assembly_scrap_percent

domains.name: logistics
domains.description: Inbound and outbound logistics domain managing shipment planning, carrier selection, LTL/FTL routing, freight cost, customs documentation, TMS execution, delivery tracking, route optimization, and distribution network management. Coordinates material flow from suppliers to plants and finished goods from plants to customers.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core transactional entity representing an individual shipment of goods — inbound (supplier to plant) or outbound (plant to customer/DC). Tracks shipment number, direction (inbound/outbound), mode (LTL/FTL/parcel/rail/air/ocean), origin and destination locations, scheduled and actual departure/arrival dates, total weight, total volume, freight class, hazmat flag, shipment status (planned/tendered/in-transit/delivered/exception), TMS reference number, carrier SCAC code, PRO number, BOL number, service level (standard/expedited/priority), and consolidation group for load planning. Includes embedded multi-leg routing structure: leg sequence, leg origin/destination nodes, per-leg carrier assignment, per-leg transport mode, intermodal transfer points, leg distances (km/miles), per-leg scheduled/actual timestamps, leg status, per-leg freight costs, and cross-dock/transshipment/relay indicators. Serves as the central transactional entity and SSOT for all transport execution within the logistics domain, linking freight orders, tracking events, delivery documents, customs declarations, and carrier contracts.

products.name: carrier_contract
products.description: Negotiated rate and service agreement between Manufacturing and a carrier, serving as the single source of truth (SSOT) for ALL carrier pricing within the logistics domain — including contract rates, spot rates, and benchmark rates. Captures contract-level terms (effective/expiry dates, volume commitments, service level guarantees, penalty clauses, payment terms) and granular lane-level rate records (per cwt, per mile, per shipment, per pallet by origin-destination zone/postal code range, freight class, weight break, and service level). Includes fuel surcharge schedules, accessorial charge tables, rate basis (weight break/flat/distance), rate currency, rate effective date ranges, rate source classification (contract/spot/benchmark), minimum volume thresholds, and rate validity periods. Used by TMS for automated carrier selection, freight cost calculation, spot rate benchmarking, and freight invoice audit. No other entity in this domain stores rate data.

products.name: freight_invoice
products.description: Carrier-issued freight invoice submitted for payment of transportation services rendered. attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: cost_per_km

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_to_date

attributes.name: equipment_type

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_applicable

attributes.name: hazmat_approved

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transport route record was last updated, used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: load_type

attributes.name: minimum_transit_time_days

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: optimization_priority
attributes.description: Primary optimization objective for route selection: cost (lowest freight cost), speed (fastest transit), reliability (on-time performance), sustainability (lowest carbon footprint), or balanced (multi-objective).

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin location, used for customs and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the origin node (plant, distribution center, supplier facility, or port) where the shipment begins. Aligns with internal location master or UN/LOCODE for ports.

attributes.name: origin_location_name

attributes.name: route_capacity_constraint

attributes.name: route_code

attributes.name: route_name

attributes.name: route_notes

attributes.name: route_status

attributes.name: route_type

attributes.name: standard_transit_time_days

attributes.name: temperature_controlled

products.name: node
products.description: Master record for all physical nodes in the distribution network — manufacturing plants, distribution centers, cross-dock facilities, ports of entry, customs bonded warehouses, customer delivery points, and supplier pickup locations. Captures node code, node type, address, GPS coordinates, operating hours, dock door count, handling equipment available, customs bonded status, free trade zone flag, TMS location ID, and yard capacity. Serves as the SSOT for network location data within the logistics domain and the reference entity for transport route origin/destination definitions and delivery appointment scheduling.
products.reference: TMS Location Master / Distribution Network Node

attributes.name: vendor_site_id

attributes.name: max_vehicle_weight_kg

attributes.name: ownership_type

attributes.name: port_access_flag

attributes.name: postal_code

products.name: shipment_tracking_event

Enables end-to-end shipment visibility and on-time delivery monitoring.

products.name: customs_declaration
products.description: Customs and trade compliance master document for cross-border shipments, serving as the SSOT for ALL customs declarations AND trade compliance screening within the logistics domain. Captures declaration number, declaration type (import/export/transit), shipment reference, country of origin, country of destination, HS tariff codes, declared value, currency, incoterms, customs broker ID, entry date, customs clearance status, duty amount, VAT amount, bond number, export license number, regulatory hold flags. Embeds full compliance screening workflow: denied party screening results, export control classification (ECCN), applicable regulations (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual-Use), screening outcome (cleared/flagged/blocked), compliance officer ID, resolution notes, license type and number, embargo check results, and dual-use classification determinations. No other entity in this domain stores trade compliance or export control screening data.
products.reference: CBP Entry / AES Filing / SAD (Single Administrative Document)

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Customer identity and account management domain serving as the SSOT for all B2B industrial customers, OEM accounts, distributors, and end-user organizations. Manages customer profiles, contacts, account hierarchies, segmentation, credit terms, relationship history, and SLA agreements via Salesforce CRM.

products.name: customer_account
products.description: Master record for all B2B industrial customers, OEM accounts, distributors, and end-user organizations. Serves as the SSOT for customer identity in Salesforce CRM (Account object) and SAP Business Partner. Captures legal entity name, industry classification (SIC/NAICS), account type (OEM, distributor, system integrator, end-user, EPC contractor), account status with full lifecycle history, annual revenue, employee count, DUNS number, tax ID, VAT registration, credit rating, assigned account manager, parent account reference, and strategic account flag. Foundation entity referenced by all other products in this domain and cross-referenced by sales, service, order, and billing domains. Corporate hierarchy and commercial relationships are managed in account_relationship.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the customer_account master data product. Serves as the SSOT reference key for all downstream domains including sales, service, order, and billing.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Legal‑entity invoicing and tax reporting assign each customer to a company code for statutory compliance.

attributes.name: parent_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent customer_account record in the corporate hierarchy. Enables multi-level account hierarchy modeling (e.g., subsidiary → division → global parent). Null for top-level accounts.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_term. Business justification: Needed to assign a default payment term to each customer account, used in billing cycle setup and compliance with payment‑term policies.

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SAP S/4HANA pricing condition group or price list assigned to this customer. Determines applicable pricing, discounts, and surcharges during sales order creation.

attributes.name: primary_customer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal sales or account manager responsible for managing the customer relationship. References the Salesforce CRM User or Workday HCM employee record. Used for territory management and performance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Primary sales rep on an account drives quota allocation, forecasting, and territory performance metrics in industrial manufacturing.

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the topmost entity in the corporate hierarchy for this customer account. Supports global account consolidation, enterprise-level revenue reporting, and strategic account management.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis per customer uses profit_center_id on the account to attribute revenue and margin to the correct profit center.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Direct FK to sales territory replaces the denormalized code, supporting territory‑based reporting and incentive calculations.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Linking account to its segment enables normalization of segment data and removes redundant string field.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Procurement planning and supplier performance dashboards require each account to designate a primary supplier.

attributes.name: account_source

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer account. Controls whether transactions, orders, and service requests can be processed against this account. Managed in Salesforce CRM and synchronized to SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer's commercial role in the industrial supply chain. Drives pricing tiers, contract templates, and service entitlements. attributes.name: billing_account_id

attributes.name: billing_city

attributes.name: billing_country_code

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the contact including country code where applicable. Used for direct voice communication by field sales, inside sales, and customer service teams.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's stated preferred channel for receiving communications from the company. Drives outreach strategy for sales, service, and marketing teams to maximize engagement effectiveness.

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal honorific or title prefix used when addressing the contact in written and verbal communication (e.g., Mr., Dr., Prof.).

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service Level Agreement tier associated with this contact's account, determining response time commitments and support priority for after-sales service requests. Aligned with the SLA agreements managed in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: technical_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact serves as a technical point of contact for product support, engineering queries, or MES/PLC/SCADA integration activities. True = designated technical contact. Drives routing of technical service cases and engineering change notifications (ECN).

products.name: account_hierarchy
products.description: Defines parent-child corporate hierarchy relationships between customer accounts, enabling roll-up reporting across subsidiaries, divisions, and global enterprise accounts. Captures parent account, child account, hierarchy level, relationship type (subsidiary, division, affiliate, joint venture), effective date, and hierarchy depth. Critical for global OEM and enterprise account management.

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parent-child account hierarchy relationship record in the Salesforce CRM account hierarchy model. Serves as the primary key for this Silver Layer data product.

attributes.name: child_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child account in the corporate hierarchy relationship. References the subsidiary, division, affiliate, or joint venture that reports up to the parent account.

attributes.name: primary_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent account in the corporate hierarchy relationship. References the account that owns or controls the child account (e.g., global OEM headquarters, holding company, or divisional parent).

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Commercial tier classification of the child account within the hierarchy, reflecting strategic importance and revenue contribution. Strategic = top-tier global OEM or enterprise accounts; key = significant regional accounts; standard = regular commercial accounts; transactional = low-volume or spot-buy accounts. Drives SLA, pricing, and service prioritization.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Governance approval status of the hierarchy relationship record. Approved = validated and active for use in reporting; pending_approval = submitted for review; rejected = not approved for use; under_review = currently being evaluated by data governance or account management team.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business user or data steward who approved this hierarchy relationship record. Supports data governance audit trails and accountability for master data changes.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hierarchy relationship record was formally approved by the data steward or account management team. Supports governance audit trails and SLA compliance for master data management processes.

attributes.name: consolidation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's financials must be consolidated into the parent account's financial statements for regulatory and management reporting purposes. Drives SAP S/4HANA FI/CO consolidation processes.

attributes.name: controlling_interest
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parent account holds a controlling interest (majority ownership or effective control) over the child account. True = controlling interest exists; False = non-controlling or minority interest. Drives financial consolidation rules per IFRS 10.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the record lifecycle. Sourced from Salesforce CRM CreatedDate or Informatica MDM record creation timestamp.

attributes.name: credit_rollup_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's credit exposure should be aggregated to the parent account for enterprise-wide credit limit management. True = include in parent credit roll-up; False = manage credit independently. Critical for global OEM credit risk management in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: crm_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: The native Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy record identifier (18-character Salesforce ID) for this relationship. Enables direct traceability back to the source system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Informatica MDM-calculated data quality score for this hierarchy relationship record, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Reflects completeness, accuracy, and consistency of the hierarchy data. Used by data stewards to prioritize remediation efforts and monitor MDM data quality KPIs.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date on which the parent-child hierarchy relationship became legally or commercially effective. Used for temporal reporting, historical roll-up analysis, and compliance with IFRS 10 consolidation timelines.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which the parent-child hierarchy relationship ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active relationship. Populated upon divestiture, restructuring, or dissolution events.

attributes.name: erp_customer_hierarchy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Customer Hierarchy Code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA SD customer hierarchy node code corresponding to this parent-child relationship. Used for cross-system reconciliation between Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA pricing, rebate, and revenue reporting hierarchies.

tag_set.value: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Customer Hierarchy Code

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Indicates the geographic coverage scope of the hierarchy relationship. Global = worldwide enterprise; regional = multi-country region (e.g., EMEA, APAC); national = single country; local = sub-national (city, state, or plant level). Used for territory management and global OEM account segmentation.

attributes.name: hierarchy_category
attributes.description: Classifies the purpose or basis of the hierarchy relationship. Legal = based on legal ownership structure; commercial = based on commercial/contractual relationship; operational = based on operational reporting lines; reporting = created for management reporting consolidation purposes only.

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the hierarchy relationship record, used for cross-system referencing and reporting. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and aligned with SAP S/4HANA customer master hierarchy codes.

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth
attributes.description: Total number of levels in the hierarchy subtree rooted at the parent account in this relationship. Indicates the structural complexity of the account group. Distinct from hierarchy_level (which is the child's absolute position); hierarchy_depth measures the span below the parent.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child account within the corporate hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents the ultimate parent (global enterprise root). Used for roll-up reporting, consolidation logic, and OEM account management. For example, a global HQ is level 1, a regional division is level 2, a local subsidiary is level 3.

attributes.name: hierarchy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the parent-child hierarchy relationship (e.g., 'Siemens AG → Siemens Digital Industries GmbH'). Used in reports, dashboards, and account management interfaces for quick identification.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full materialized path string representing the ancestry chain from the root account to the child account, using a delimiter-separated format (e.g., 'GlobalHQ/RegionEMEA/CountryDE/SubsidiaryXYZ'). Enables efficient tree traversal queries and hierarchy visualization in analytics platforms.

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the parent-child hierarchy relationship. Active indicates the relationship is in force; pending indicates awaiting approval or validation; terminated indicates the relationship has ended (e.g., divestiture, dissolution); suspended indicates temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The primary industry vertical or market segment of the child account within this hierarchy (e.g., Automotive OEM, Aerospace & Defense, Food & Beverage, Pharmaceuticals, Energy & Utilities). Used for market segmentation, strategic account planning, and industry-specific SLA assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|aerospace_defense|food_beverage|pharma|energy_utilities|electronics|heavy_industry|transportation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hierarchy relationship was last reviewed and validated by the account management team or data steward. Supports periodic hierarchy governance reviews and ensures accuracy of the corporate structure for global OEM account management.

attributes.name: mdm_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: The Informatica MDM golden record hierarchy identifier for this relationship, representing the authoritative cross-system master data reference. Ensures data quality and deduplication across Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA hierarchy representations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to any attribute of the record, supporting change detection, incremental data loading, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review and validation of this hierarchy relationship by the account management team or data steward. Ensures timely governance of corporate structure changes and compliance with master data management policies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, business rationale, or special instructions related to the hierarchy relationship. Examples include notes on pending restructuring, legal disputes, or special commercial arrangements that affect the hierarchy structure.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of equity ownership the parent account holds in the child account. Critical for IFRS 10 consolidation thresholds (>50% = subsidiary, 20-50% = associate/affiliate), financial roll-up reporting, and OEM account governance. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 75.00 = 75%).

attributes.name: pricing_rollup_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's purchase volumes should be aggregated to the parent account for volume-based pricing, rebate calculation, and global framework agreement pricing in SAP S/4HANA SD. True = volumes consolidated at parent level; False = priced independently.

attributes.name: primary_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country of the child account within this hierarchy relationship. Used for geographic roll-up reporting, trade compliance, and export control screening.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the corporate relationship between parent and child accounts. Drives legal, financial, and commercial treatment: subsidiary (majority-owned legal entity), division (internal business unit), affiliate (minority-owned or associated entity), joint_venture (co-owned entity), distributor (channel partner), franchise (licensed operator). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subsidiary|division|affiliate|joint_venture|distributor|franchise — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: revenue_rollup_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's revenue should be rolled up and attributed to the parent account for enterprise-level revenue reporting and global OEM account performance tracking. True = include in parent roll-up; False = exclude (e.g., for minority affiliates or reporting-only hierarchy nodes).

attributes.name: sla_inherited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account inherits the Service Level Agreement (SLA) terms from the parent account in this hierarchy relationship. True = child account uses parent SLA; False = child account has its own independently negotiated SLA. Drives Salesforce Service Cloud case routing and escalation logic.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the termination or deactivation of the hierarchy relationship. Captures the event that caused the relationship to end: divestiture (sale of subsidiary), merger (entities combined), acquisition (absorbed by another entity), restructuring (internal reorganization), dissolution (entity closed), reclassification (moved to different hierarchy), data_correction (error correction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: divestiture|merger|acquisition|restructuring|dissolution|reclassification|data_correction — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: segment
products.description: Market segmentation classification for customer accounts used in sales strategy, pricing tiers, and service prioritization. Captures segment name (Strategic, Key Account, Growth, Transactional), segment criteria, revenue band, industry vertical, geographic region, assigned segment manager, and review cycle. Enables targeted commercial strategies for OEMs, distributors, and end-users.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer segment record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins and references.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the segment definition was formally approved by the designated commercial authority. Used for governance audit trails and to establish the authoritative effective date of the segment.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the commercial leadership authority (e.g., VP Sales, Regional Sales Director) who formally approved this segment definition and its commercial parameters. Sourced from Salesforce CRM approval workflow records.

attributes.name: assigned_segment_manager
