attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Supports lead qualification by capturing the exact SKU a prospect is interested in, driving accurate forecasting and targeted marketing.

attributes.name: annual_energy_consumption_mwh
attributes.description: Estimated annual energy consumption of the prospective customer's facilities in megawatt-hours. Key qualification criterion for electrification and energy management solution sales (ISO 50001 alignment).

attributes.name: buying_stage
attributes.description: Estimated stage in the buyer's journey for this lead based on engagement signals and sales rep assessment. Informs content strategy and sales approach for industrial automation solutions.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign (trade show, digital campaign, webinar, email campaign) that generated or influenced this lead. Used for campaign ROI attribution and marketing spend analysis.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the prospective company's primary operating location. Used for geographic segmentation, territory planning, and field sales routing.

attributes.name: company_industry
attributes.description: Industry vertical of the prospective company (e.g., Automotive, Food & Beverage, Oil & Gas, Utilities, Building Automation, Transportation). Used for segmentation and targeted product positioning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive|Food & Beverage|Oil & Gas|Utilities|Building Automation|Transportation|Pharmaceuticals|Metals & Mining|Chemicals|Data Centers — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the prospective customer organization. Represents the B2B account target for industrial automation, electrification, or smart infrastructure products.

attributes.name: company_size
attributes.description: Employee headcount band of the prospective organization. Used for lead scoring, segmentation, and determining appropriate sales motion (inside sales vs. field sales vs. enterprise).

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead was formally converted to a customer account and opportunity. Null for unconverted leads. Used for sales cycle duration analysis and conversion rate reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the prospective company's primary operating location (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Used for territory assignment, regional sales routing, and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lead record was first created in the source CRM system (Salesforce). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for lead age analysis, SLA tracking, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Originating system or method through which this lead record was created or enriched in the data platform. Used for data lineage, quality assessment, and MDM reconciliation.
attributes.value_regex: Salesforce CRM|SAP S/4HANA|Manual Entry|Data Enrichment|Marketing Automation

attributes.name: disqualification_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the lead was disqualified using the BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) framework or other criteria. Populated when lead_status = 'Disqualified'. Used for funnel quality analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: No Budget|No Authority|No Need|No Timeline|Competitor|Duplicate|Invalid Data|Opted Out — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has opted out of all sales and marketing communications. When True, all outreach must cease immediately to comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CASL regulations.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the lead contact. Used for digital outreach, campaign tracking, and lead nurturing communications.

attributes.name: email_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has specifically opted out of email marketing communications. Distinct from do_not_contact which covers all channels. Enforced for GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_revenue
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue of the prospective company in USD. Used for lead scoring, account tiering, and prioritization of sales resources. Sourced from public data, third-party enrichment, or sales rep input.

attributes.name: estimated_close_date
attributes.description: Sales representative's estimated date by which the lead could be converted to a qualified opportunity or closed deal. Used for pipeline timing and sales cycle analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_deal_value
attributes.description: Sales representative's estimate of the potential deal value in the revenue_currency if the lead converts to an opportunity. Used for pipeline forecasting and sales territory planning.

attributes.name: existing_automation_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the incumbent automation or electrification vendor currently deployed at the prospective customer's facilities (e.g., ABB, Rockwell, Schneider). Critical competitive intelligence for sales strategy and displacement campaigns.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: First (given) name of the primary contact person at the prospective organization. Used for personalized outreach and communication.

attributes.name: grade
attributes.description: Alphabetic grade (A–D) representing the lead's firmographic fit against the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) for industrial automation and electrification products. Complements lead_score which measures behavioral engagement.

attributes.name: is_converted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lead has been successfully converted to a customer account, contact, and opportunity in the CRM. True when lead_status = 'Converted'.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Professional title or role of the primary contact at the prospective organization (e.g., Plant Manager, VP Engineering, Procurement Director). Informs sales approach and stakeholder mapping.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales activity (call, email, meeting, demo) logged against this lead. Used to identify stale leads requiring re-engagement and to measure sales rep activity.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Last (family) name of the primary contact person at the prospective organization. Combined with first_name to form the full contact identity.

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: Origination channel through which the lead was acquired. Drives marketing attribution, ROI analysis, and channel effectiveness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Trade Show|Website|Referral|Cold Outreach|Partner Referral|Webinar|Campaign|LinkedIn|Distributor|OEM Partner — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lead_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the sales lead in the qualification funnel. 'New' = uncontacted; 'Working' = active outreach in progress; 'Qualified' = meets ICP criteria; 'Converted' = converted to customer_account; 'Disqualified' = does not meet criteria or opted out.

attributes.name: lead_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lead by origination motion and relationship type. Distinguishes inbound (self-generated interest) from outbound (sales-initiated), and identifies OEM, distributor, or direct end-user engagement models.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the lead record in the source CRM system. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: next_follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next sales follow-up action on this lead. Used by sales reps for pipeline management and by sales managers for activity monitoring.

attributes.name: no_of_employees
attributes.description: Exact or estimated number of employees at the prospective company. Used alongside company_size band for more precise lead scoring and account tiering.

attributes.name: no_of_production_sites
attributes.description: Estimated number of manufacturing plants, production facilities, or operational sites operated by the prospective company. Used to assess deal complexity, multi-site deployment potential, and enterprise account classification.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number of the lead contact including country code. Used for direct sales outreach and qualification calls.

attributes.name: plc_installed_base
attributes.description: Description of the existing PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) installed base at the prospect's facilities (e.g., 'Siemens S7-300', 'Allen-Bradley ControlLogix'). Used to assess upgrade/migration opportunity and compatibility.

attributes.name: product_interest_area
attributes.description: Primary product category or solution area the lead has expressed interest in. Drives sales rep assignment, product specialist routing, and targeted content delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Drives|PLCs|Switchgear|Building Automation|Grid Solutions|Motion Control|Industrial IoT|SCADA|HMI|Robotics — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: referral_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the channel partner, distributor, OEM, or system integrator who referred this lead. Populated when lead_source is 'Partner Referral' or 'Referral'. Used for partner performance tracking and commission attribution.

attributes.name: revenue_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated_annual_revenue field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency normalization for global lead management.

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: High-level geographic sales region grouping for the lead. Used for regional pipeline reporting, quota management, and executive dashboards.
attributes.value_regex: North America|Europe|Asia Pacific|Latin America|Middle East & Africa

attributes.name: sales_territory
attributes.description: Geographic or account-based sales territory to which this lead is assigned (e.g., EMEA-North, APAC-Industrial, NA-Midwest). Drives sales rep routing and territory performance reporting.

attributes.name: salesforce_lead_code
attributes.description: Native Salesforce CRM Lead object identifier (18-character Salesforce ID) used for cross-system traceability and synchronization with the source system of record.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 0–100) representing the lead's likelihood to convert based on behavioral signals, firmographic fit, and engagement data. Used for prioritization and sales rep workload management.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the prospective company's primary location. Used for territory management, sales rep assignment, and regional reporting.

attributes.name: website
attributes.description: Official website URL of the prospective company. Used for research, data enrichment, and digital engagement tracking.

products.name: account_site
products.description: Physical plant, factory, or facility locations associated with a customer account where Manufacturing products are installed, delivered, or serviced. Enables field service dispatch, logistics planning, installed base tracking, and preventive maintenance scheduling at customer locations.

attributes.name: account_site_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account site record in the Manufacturing lakehouse. Primary key for the account_site entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Site‑level cost tracking links each plant/site to a cost center for detailed operational expense reporting.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer account to which this site belongs. Links the physical site to the B2B customer, OEM, distributor, or end-user organization in the account master.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary contact person at this site responsible for coordinating field service visits, deliveries, and maintenance activities. Links to the contact master record.

attributes.name: installed_sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Needed for site‑level asset management; links each plant site to the primary product installed for maintenance scheduling and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Linking a manufacturing site to its responsible org unit enables cost allocation, governance and production planning.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit center reporting per manufacturing site requires a profit_center_id on the site record.

attributes.name: site_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Site manager employee is needed for operations, maintenance scheduling and safety compliance reports.

attributes.name: site_sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Site‑level sales rep ownership is required for site‑specific revenue tracking and service contract management.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Linking a customer site to a supply‑chain network node enables routing, capacity, and cross‑docking decisions in logistics planning.

attributes.name: access_restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing access restrictions, security clearance requirements, visitor registration procedures, or special entry protocols for field service engineers and delivery personnel at this site.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the physical site location. Used for field service dispatch, logistics planning, and shipment routing.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the site (suite, building, floor, gate number). Supplements address_line1 for precise field service and logistics routing.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality in which the customer site is located. Used for geographic segmentation, logistics zone assignment, and field service territory planning.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site was formally commissioned and became operational for Manufacturing product installations and services. Used to calculate site age, warranty period tracking, and lifecycle analytics.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the site location (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Drives regulatory compliance framework selection, export control classification, and multi-currency logistics costing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account site record was first created in the system of record (Salesforce CRM). Provides audit trail for data governance and record lineage tracking per ISO 9001 documentation requirements.

attributes.name: crm_site_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM native identifier for this account site record. Used for cross-system data lineage, reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the Salesforce source system, and audit traceability.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site was or is planned to be decommissioned. Populated when site_status transitions to 'decommissioned'. Used for installed base retirement tracking and asset lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: environmental_classification
attributes.description: Environmental condition classification of the site affecting product installation requirements, equipment ratings, and maintenance intervals. Informs selection of appropriate equipment IP ratings and material specifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|controlled|outdoor|corrosive|high_temperature|high_humidity — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: erp_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code corresponding to this customer site. Used for cross-system reconciliation of delivery addresses, service orders, and inventory movements associated with this site.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: Industry vertical or market segment classification of the customer site (e.g., Automotive, Food & Beverage, Oil & Gas, Utilities, Pharmaceuticals). Used for market analytics, product compatibility assessment, and regulatory compliance framework selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full industry taxonomy]

attributes.name: installed_product_count
attributes.description: Total number of Manufacturing products currently installed and tracked at this site. Drives installed base analytics, preventive maintenance scheduling volume, and spare parts demand forecasting.

attributes.name: is_headquarters
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site is the primary headquarters or main facility of the customer account. Used for account hierarchy reporting, executive relationship management, and primary billing address determination.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the account site record in the system of record. Used for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: last_site_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent field service engineer or account manager visit to the site. Used for relationship management, service frequency analysis, and identifying sites overdue for preventive maintenance visits.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Enables geospatial analytics, field service route optimization, and proximity-based spare parts depot assignment.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Enables geospatial analytics, field service route optimization, and proximity-based spare parts depot assignment.

attributes.name: maximo_location_code
attributes.description: IBM Maximo Asset Management location identifier for this site. Used to link account site records to Maximo work orders, preventive maintenance plans, and asset hierarchies for field service execution.

attributes.name: mes_system_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) is installed at the site. Used to assess integration readiness for Siemens Opcenter MES connectivity and shop floor data exchange.

attributes.name: network_connectivity_type
attributes.description: Primary network connectivity type available at the site for IIoT device integration, remote monitoring, and SCADA/MES connectivity. Determines feasibility of remote diagnostics and predictive maintenance services.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance visit at this site. Drives field service dispatch scheduling, spare parts pre-positioning, and resource capacity planning for the service organization.

attributes.name: number_of_production_lines
attributes.description: Count of active production lines at the manufacturing site. Used to estimate installed base potential, maintenance workload, and spare parts demand. Relevant for manufacturing plant site types.

attributes.name: operates_24x7
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site operates continuously 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. When true, overrides operational_hours_start/end for scheduling purposes and may trigger higher SLA tier assignment.

attributes.name: operational_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily operational end time of the site in HH:MM (24-hour) format in the site's local time zone. Used to constrain field service scheduling, maintenance windows, and delivery cutoff times.

attributes.name: operational_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily operational start time of the site in HH:MM (24-hour) format in the site's local time zone. Used to schedule field service visits, preventive maintenance windows, and delivery time slots within permitted hours.

attributes.name: plant_floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total operational floor area of the site in square meters. Used for capacity planning, equipment density analysis, and logistics resource estimation for large-scale installations.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the customer site address. Used for logistics zone mapping, field service territory assignment, and tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: power_supply_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Electrical supply frequency at the site in Hertz (50 or 60 Hz). Required for equipment compatibility validation for automation systems, drives, and electrification products.

attributes.name: power_supply_voltage
attributes.description: Primary electrical supply voltage standard at the site. Critical for ensuring compatibility of electrification solutions and automation equipment installed or to be installed at the site. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 110V|220V|380V|400V|480V|600V|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Safety and environmental classification of the site indicating special handling requirements for field service engineers and delivery personnel. Drives PPE requirements, access protocols, and compliance documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hazardous|non_hazardous|restricted_access|cleanroom|explosion_proof — promote to reference product if additional classifications are required]

attributes.name: scada_system_present
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System Present Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a SCADA system is installed and operational at the site. Relevant for integration planning with Aveva SCADA and for determining remote monitoring service eligibility.

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System Present Flag

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the site across operational systems (SAP, Salesforce, Maximo). Used as the cross-system business key for site-level transactions, work orders, and shipments.

attributes.name: site_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary on-site contact for service notifications, maintenance scheduling confirmations, and delivery alerts.

attributes.name: site_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary on-site contact person for field service coordination, delivery acceptance, and maintenance scheduling. Captured directly for operational use when the contact master record may not yet be established.

attributes.name: site_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary on-site contact. Used by field service engineers and logistics teams for on-site coordination and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: site_criticality_rating
attributes.description: Business-assigned criticality level of the site reflecting the operational impact of downtime or service disruption. Drives SLA priority, spare parts stocking strategy, and preventive maintenance frequency. Aligned with FMEA risk classification.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the physical plant, factory, or facility location (e.g., 'Chicago North Assembly Plant', 'Frankfurt Distribution Hub'). Used in field service dispatch, logistics planning, and installed base reporting.

attributes.name: site_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer site. Determines eligibility for field service dispatch, new product installations, and preventive maintenance scheduling. 'decommissioned' sites are retained for historical installed base tracking.

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Classification of the facility type indicating the primary operational purpose of the site. Drives field service routing, SLA tier assignment, and preventive maintenance scheduling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_plant|warehouse|distribution_center|data_center|commercial_building|substation — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA service tier assigned to this site, determining response time commitments, on-site support priority, and spare parts availability guarantees for field service and maintenance activities.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the customer site. Used for regulatory compliance jurisdiction determination (OSHA, EPA), tax zone assignment, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the site location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'Europe/Berlin'). Used for scheduling preventive maintenance windows, field service appointments, and operational hours alignment.

products.name: customer_certification
products.description: Customer-held certifications and compliance qualifications relevant to industrial procurement and partnership eligibility, such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949, AS9100, and UL certifications. Captures certification type, issuing body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and associated account or site. Used in OEM qualification, distributor onboarding, and regulatory compliance checks.

attributes.name: customer_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer certification record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the customer_certification data product.

attributes.name: account_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer facility, plant, or operational site to which this certification applies. A single account may hold certifications at multiple sites.

attributes.name: auditor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Certification audits are performed by internal auditors; tracking the employee provides audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B customer account or OEM organization that holds this certification. Links the certification to the customer master record in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: applicable_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories or commodity codes to which this certification applies, as declared in the certificate scope. Used to match certification coverage against specific procurement line items and OEM qualification requirements.

attributes.name: body_country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the certifying body is registered and operates (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'GBR'). Used for jurisdictional compliance analysis and accreditation authority mapping.

attributes.name: capa_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the customer must submit or complete their Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan to the certifying body or internal compliance team. Null when capa_required is False.

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan is required as a condition of maintaining or renewing this certification. Set to True when non-conformances have been identified that require formal corrective action.

attributes.name: ce_marking_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is associated with or required for CE Marking (European Conformity) compliance. Relevant for customers supplying products to the European market under EU product safety directives.

attributes.name: certificate_document_url
attributes.description: URL or path to the scanned or digital copy of the certificate document stored in the document management system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter or SharePoint). Enables direct access to the source certificate for audit and verification purposes.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The official certificate number or registration number issued by the certifying body. Used as the externally-known unique identifier for the certification document (e.g., 'ISO9001-2024-00123456'). Required for OEM qualification and distributor onboarding verification.

attributes.name: certification_scope
attributes.description: The declared scope of the certification as stated on the certificate, describing the products, processes, or services covered (e.g., 'Design, manufacture, and supply of industrial automation components'). Critical for determining applicability to specific procurement categories.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer certification. 'active' = valid and in force; 'expired' = past expiry date without renewal; 'suspended' = temporarily withdrawn by issuing body; 'withdrawn' = permanently revoked; 'pending_renewal' = renewal audit in progress; 'under_review' = under surveillance audit.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the certification by its governing domain (e.g., quality management, environmental management, product safety). Used to segment certifications for compliance reporting and supplier qualification workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: quality_management|environmental_management|occupational_health_safety|energy_management|automotive_quality|aerospace_quality|product_safety|cybersecurity — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which the certification is valid or was issued (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'CHN'). Relevant for multi-national customers where certifications may be jurisdiction-specific.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this certification record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: days_to_expiry
attributes.description: The number of calendar days remaining until the certification expires, calculated from the current date to expiry_date. Used to drive automated renewal alerts and qualification eligibility checks. Negative values indicate the certification has already expired.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Used to trigger renewal workflows and to gate OEM qualification and distributor onboarding eligibility. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: initial_certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer first obtained this certification standard, regardless of subsequent renewals. Used to calculate total years of certified operation and assess supplier maturity in qualification processes.

attributes.name: is_multi_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certificate covers multiple customer sites under a single certificate number (multi-site certification). When True, the certification scope applies to all sites listed in the certificate annex rather than a single facility.

attributes.name: is_primary_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is the primary or most critical certification for the customer account within its certification type. Used to prioritize compliance checks and qualification gate decisions when a customer holds multiple certifications of the same type.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was formally issued or granted by the certifying body. Represents the start of the current certification cycle. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issuing_body_accreditation_number
attributes.description: The accreditation number of the certification body as granted by a national accreditation authority (e.g., ANAB, UKAS, DAkkS). Enables verification that the issuing body is formally accredited to issue the specific standard.

attributes.name: issuing_body_name
attributes.description: The name of the accredited certification body or registrar that issued the certificate (e.g., 'Bureau Veritas', 'TÜV Rheinland', 'SGS', 'DNV', 'Intertek'). Used to validate accreditation status and credibility of the certification.

attributes.name: last_surveillance_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent surveillance audit conducted by the certifying body to verify ongoing compliance. ISO management system certifications typically require annual surveillance audits between recertification cycles.

attributes.name: next_surveillance_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next surveillance audit by the certifying body. Used to proactively manage audit readiness and compliance calendar for the customer account.

attributes.name: nonconformance_count
attributes.description: The number of open or unresolved non-conformances (NCRs) identified during the most recent audit cycle for this certification. A non-zero value may affect qualification eligibility and triggers CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) follow-up.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, conditions, or remarks associated with the certification record (e.g., 'Certificate covers only the Monterrey plant', 'Renewal pending third-party audit scheduled for Q3'). Captured by compliance or procurement teams in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: qualification_eligibility
attributes.description: Derived qualification eligibility status of the customer based on this certification, used in OEM qualification, distributor onboarding, and procurement approval workflows. 'eligible' = meets all certification requirements; 'ineligible' = does not meet requirements; 'conditional' = meets requirements with conditions; 'under_review' = eligibility being assessed.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory requirement, customer contract clause, or industry mandate that necessitates this certification (e.g., 'EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC', 'OSHA 29 CFR 1910', 'CE Marking Directive'). Links the certification to its compliance obligation.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was most recently renewed or recertified. Distinct from issue_date when a renewal results in a new certificate number. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Tracks the current state of the certification renewal process. 'not_due' = renewal not yet required; 'in_progress' = renewal audit underway; 'submitted' = renewal application submitted to certifying body; 'approved' = renewal granted; 'lapsed' = renewal not completed before expiry.

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce CRM record ID, SAP Ariba document number). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and data quality management.

attributes.name: standard
attributes.description: The specific industry standard or scheme to which the certification applies (e.g., 'ISO 9001:2015', 'ISO 14001:2015', 'IATF 16949:2016', 'AS9100 Rev D', 'UL 508A', 'IEC 62443-2-1'). Drives OEM qualification eligibility and regulatory compliance checks.

attributes.name: ul_listing_number
attributes.description: The Underwriters Laboratories (UL) listing or file number associated with this certification, if applicable. Used for product safety certification tracking for customers supplying electrical or industrial components to North American markets.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this certification record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used to detect stale records and trigger re-verification workflows.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified for authenticity and current validity by the internal compliance or procurement team. Used to ensure certifications are periodically re-validated and not relied upon without current confirmation.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the authenticity and validity of the certification. 'manual_review' = reviewed by internal compliance team; 'online_registry' = validated via certifying body's public registry; 'third_party_audit' = verified by an independent auditor; 'self_declaration' = customer-provided without independent verification.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the internal compliance officer or procurement analyst who last verified the certification. Provides an audit trail for compliance accountability.

products.name: customer_entitlement
products.description: Customer entitlement records defining specific support services, warranty coverage, software licenses, and spare parts access a customer account is entitled to based on purchased products and active SLA agreements. Maps to Salesforce Service Cloud Entitlement object. Captures entitlement type (warranty, support incidents, preventive maintenance visits, software updates, spare parts access), start date, end date, remaining quantity, consumed quantity, service hours allocation, coverage schedule, and associated account and SLA tier. Distinct from sla_agreement which defines contractual terms — entitlement tracks the consumable allowances derived from those terms.

attributes.name: customer_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer entitlement record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Maps to the Salesforce Service Cloud Entitlement object primary key.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B customer account (OEM, distributor, or end-user organization) that holds this entitlement. Links to the customer account master in the customer domain.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary customer contact person responsible for managing this entitlement on the customer side. Used for service notifications, renewal communications, and escalation routing.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal Salesforce user (account manager or customer success manager) responsible for managing and renewing this entitlement. Drives ownership-based reporting and renewal task assignment.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific installed asset or equipment unit (e.g., CNC machine, PLC, automation cell) covered by this entitlement. Nullable when the entitlement applies at the account level rather than a specific asset.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA sales order that triggered the creation of this entitlement (e.g., purchase of a product with bundled warranty or support). Provides commercial traceability for entitlement provisioning.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or product family (e.g., automation system, electrification solution) that this entitlement covers. Drives eligibility rules for spare parts access and software updates.

attributes.name: auto_renew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement is configured to automatically renew upon expiry based on the parent SLA agreement terms. Drives renewal workflow triggers in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA SD.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The internal business unit or division of the manufacturing organization responsible for delivering the services covered by this entitlement (e.g., Automation Systems, Electrification Solutions, Smart Infrastructure). Used for revenue attribution and service capacity planning.

attributes.name: consumed_quantity
attributes.description: The cumulative number of service units, incidents, visits, or licenses consumed against this entitlement to date. Updated each time a case, work order, or service event is closed and linked to this entitlement.

attributes.name: contract_line_number
attributes.description: The specific line item number within the parent sales or service contract (SAP S/4HANA SD contract) from which this entitlement was generated. Enables traceability from entitlement back to the originating commercial contract.

attributes.name: contracted_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the services covered by this entitlement as agreed in the commercial contract. Used for revenue recognition, deferred revenue tracking, and customer profitability analysis. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the customer site or asset location covered by this entitlement. Used for regulatory compliance, export control checks, and regional service routing.

attributes.name: coverage_schedule_code
attributes.description: Reference to the operating hours / coverage schedule that defines when this entitlement's services are available (e.g., 8x5, 24x7, business hours only). Maps to the Salesforce Operating Hours object linked to the entitlement.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Defines the mode of service delivery covered by this entitlement. 'on_site' requires a field engineer visit; 'remote' covers phone/digital support only; 'hybrid' allows both; 'parts_only' covers spare parts shipment without labor.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this entitlement record was first created in the source system (Salesforce Service Cloud). Represents the business event of entitlement provisioning, not the ETL ingestion time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values associated with this entitlement (e.g., contracted service value, spare parts credit limit). Supports multi-currency reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.

attributes.name: customer_entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the entitlement record. 'active' indicates the entitlement is valid and consumable; 'expired' indicates the end date has passed; 'suspended' indicates temporary hold pending review; 'pending_activation' indicates awaiting contract confirmation.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the entitlement expires and the customer is no longer entitled to the covered services. Nullable for open-ended entitlements such as perpetual licenses.

attributes.name: entitlement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the entitlement record, used in customer-facing communications, service portals, and cross-system references. Sourced from Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: entitlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entitlement category defining what service or coverage the customer is entitled to. Drives service fulfillment routing and eligibility checks in Salesforce Service Cloud and SAP S/4HANA QM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warranty|support_incident|preventive_maintenance|software_update|spare_parts_access|field_service_visit — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: escalation_contact
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the designated escalation contact (internal or customer-side) for critical service issues under this entitlement. Used when standard response time milestones are breached.

attributes.name: geography_region
attributes.description: The geographic region where the entitlement's covered asset or customer account is located (e.g., EMEA, APAC, AMER). Used for service dispatch routing, regional SLA compliance reporting, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the entitlement is currently active and eligible for service consumption. Derived from status and date fields in Salesforce but stored as a denormalized field for fast eligibility checks in the Silver Layer.

attributes.name: is_perpetual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement has no expiry date and is valid indefinitely (e.g., perpetual software licenses or lifetime warranty on specific components). When True, end_date is expected to be null.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this entitlement record was last updated in the source system (Salesforce Service Cloud). Used for incremental data ingestion, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.

attributes.name: customer_entitlement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the entitlement, such as 'Gold Support – CNC Machining Line 2024' or 'Preventive Maintenance – Automation Cell A'. Used for display and search in service portals.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, exclusions, or operational notes related to this entitlement. Examples include asset modification exclusions, geographic restrictions, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: parts_access_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is entitled to access spare parts under this entitlement. When True, the customer may order spare parts at contracted pricing or at no charge depending on the entitlement terms.

attributes.name: preventive_maintenance_visits
attributes.description: Total number of scheduled preventive maintenance visits allocated under this entitlement per contract period. Applicable to entitlements of type 'preventive_maintenance'. Supports TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) planning.

attributes.name: preventive_maintenance_visits_used
attributes.description: Number of preventive maintenance visits already consumed against the allocated visits for this entitlement. Updated upon completion of each PM work order linked to this entitlement in Maximo or Salesforce.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the entitlement quantity fields (total, consumed, remaining). Examples: 'incident' for support cases, 'visit' for preventive maintenance, 'license' for software seats, 'hour' for service hours.

attributes.name: remaining_quantity
attributes.description: The number of service units, incidents, visits, or licenses still available for consumption under this entitlement (total_quantity minus consumed_quantity). Maintained as a stored field in Salesforce for real-time eligibility checks rather than computed on-the-fly.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this entitlement is scheduled for renewal review or automatic renewal. Used by the customer success team to initiate renewal negotiations and by Salesforce workflows to trigger renewal tasks.

attributes.name: resolution_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which a service issue must be fully resolved under this entitlement, as defined by the SLA tier. Drives escalation workflows and SLA breach alerts in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: response_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which the service team must respond to a service request under this entitlement, as defined by the SLA tier. Used for case routing and SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: service_hours_allocation
attributes.description: Total number of service hours allocated under this entitlement for on-site or remote support activities. Applicable primarily to time-and-materials or block-hour SLA entitlements. Null when the entitlement is incident-based rather than time-based.

attributes.name: service_hours_consumed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of service hours consumed against the allocated service hours for this entitlement. Updated upon closure of service work orders or field service visits linked to this entitlement.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The SLA service tier associated with this entitlement, determining response time commitments, escalation priorities, and service scope. Derived from the parent SLA agreement but stored here for fast eligibility lookup.

attributes.name: software_update_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is entitled to receive software updates, patches, or firmware upgrades for covered products under this entitlement. Relevant for PLC, SCADA, MES, and HMI software components.

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this entitlement in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Entitlement ID '0i0XXXXXXXXXXXX'). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system.

attributes.name: spare_parts_credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value of spare parts the customer may claim or order at no charge or at contracted pricing under this entitlement. Applicable when entitlement_type includes spare_parts_access. Expressed in currency_code.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the entitlement becomes effective and the customer may begin consuming the allocated service allowances. Corresponds to the contract or warranty activation date.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: The total number of service units, incidents, visits, or licenses originally allocated under this entitlement (e.g., 10 support incidents, 4 preventive maintenance visits, 5 software licenses). Represents the full allocation at entitlement creation.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is currently eligible to submit warranty claims under this entitlement. May be set to False if the entitlement is suspended, the asset has been modified outside approved parameters, or warranty conditions have been voided.

products.name: account_team
products.description: Assignment of internal Manufacturing personnel to customer accounts, defining the account team structure including account managers, field sales engineers, application engineers, customer success managers, and executive sponsors. Captures team member role, assignment start date, end date, primary contact flag, and territory assignment. Maps to Salesforce CRM Account Team Member.

attributes.name: account_team_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each account team member assignment record in the Manufacturing CRM system. Primary key for the account_team data product.

attributes.name: account_employee_id
attributes.description: The internal Manufacturing employee identifier for the team member, sourced from Workday HCM. Used for cross-referencing HR records, compensation, and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: account_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Team assignments reference segment for reporting; replace string with FK.

attributes.name: account_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal Manufacturing employee or system user assigned to this account team role. Maps to the Salesforce CRM User record and Workday HCM employee record.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account to which this team member is assigned. Links to the B2B industrial customer, OEM, distributor, or end-user organization record.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory to which this account team assignment belongs. Defines the geographic or market segment scope of the team member's responsibility.

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: The level of access granted to this team member for the customer account record in Salesforce CRM. Controls visibility and edit permissions for account data, contacts, opportunities, and cases.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for this account team assignment (e.g., new account onboarding, territory realignment, escalation coverage, strategic account expansion).

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account team member assignment. Indicates whether the assignment is currently active, pending activation, temporarily suspended, or has been terminated.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the account team assignment as permanent (long-term), temporary (project-based), interim (gap coverage), or coverage (vacation/leave backup). Supports workforce planning and continuity management.

attributes.name: case_access
attributes.description: The level of access granted to this team member for service case records associated with the customer account. Governs visibility into support tickets, NCRs, RMAs, and CAPA records.

attributes.name: contact_access
attributes.description: The level of access granted to this team member for contact records associated with the customer account. Controls visibility into customer stakeholder information.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with the team member's department. Used for internal cost allocation of account management activities and OpEx reporting.

attributes.name: coverage_country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country this team member covers for the assigned account. Used for regulatory compliance, export control, and regional reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this account team assignment record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: crm_owner_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Record Owner ID
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM user ID of the record owner responsible for maintaining this account team member record. Used for data stewardship, governance, and audit accountability.

tag_set.value: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Record Owner ID

attributes.name: crm_team_member_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Team Member ID
attributes.description: External identifier for this account team member record as assigned by Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability back to the source system of record.

tag_set.value: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Team Member ID

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this account team assignment record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and MDM governance processes.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The organizational department or business unit of the Manufacturing employee, sourced from Workday HCM. Used for cost allocation, reporting hierarchy, and cross-functional team analytics.

attributes.name: effective_from_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp from which this account team assignment record version is valid in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 history tracking for the assignment.

attributes.name: effective_to_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp until which this account team assignment record version is valid in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Null indicates the current active version. Supports SCD Type 2 history tracking.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: job_title

attributes.name: last_customer_interaction_date

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: next_scheduled_review_date

attributes.name: opportunity_access

attributes.name: quota_amount

attributes.name: quota_currency

attributes.name: quota_period

attributes.name: sales_district

attributes.name: sales_region

attributes.name: sla_tier

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: termination_reason

products.name: customer_onboarding
products.description: Customer onboarding process records tracking the structured activation workflow for new industrial accounts from contract signature through first order readiness. Captures onboarding stage, checklist completion status, credit setup status, EDI/portal setup status, assigned onboarding coordinator, target completion date, actual completion date, and blockers. Ensures new OEM and distributor accounts are fully operational.

attributes.name: customer_onboarding_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the customer onboarding record. Primary key for the onboarding data product in the customer domain.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account being onboarded. Links this onboarding record to the master customer entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee assigned as the onboarding coordinator responsible for managing the activation workflow.

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the signed contract that triggered the onboarding workflow. Onboarding begins upon contract signature.

attributes.name: account_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the customer account, used to prioritize onboarding resources and apply segment-specific SLA targets.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer account being onboarded. Determines the onboarding workflow template and requirements applied. OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), distributor, end-user, reseller, or strategic account.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the customer onboarding was fully completed and the account achieved first-order readiness. Null if onboarding is still in progress.

attributes.name: assigned_sales_region
attributes.description: The sales region to which the customer account is assigned, used for coordinator assignment, reporting, and regional SLA management.

attributes.name: blocker_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the onboarding blocker type, enabling root cause analysis and process improvement reporting across the onboarding program. attributes.name: blocker_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any current impediment or blocker preventing the onboarding from progressing. Captures the nature of the issue for escalation and resolution tracking.

attributes.name: checklist_completion_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of onboarding checklist items that have been marked as completed. Provides a quantitative measure of onboarding progress (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: completed_checklist_items
attributes.description: The number of onboarding checklist items that have been completed and verified. Numerator for checklist completion percentage.

attributes.name: compliance_check_status
attributes.description: Status of mandatory regulatory and trade compliance screening for the new customer, including export control, sanctions screening, and anti-bribery checks.

attributes.name: contract_signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer signed the contract, marking the official start trigger for the onboarding workflow.

attributes.name: credit_limit_approved
attributes.description: The approved credit limit amount (in base currency) assigned to the customer account during onboarding. Established by the finance team as part of credit setup.

attributes.name: credit_setup_status
attributes.description: Current status of the credit limit and payment terms setup for the new customer account in SAP S/4HANA FI. A prerequisite for first order processing.

attributes.name: customer_primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the customer organization for onboarding communications and coordination.

attributes.name: customer_primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the customer organization responsible for coordinating the onboarding process on the customer side.

attributes.name: edi_setup_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integration setup for the customer. Tracks configuration, testing, and go-live of EDI order transmission channels.

attributes.name: erp_account_created_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer master record has been successfully created in SAP S/4HANA. A mandatory prerequisite for order processing and invoicing.

attributes.name: erp_customer_number

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the onboarding case has been formally escalated to management due to a blocker, SLA risk, or customer dissatisfaction.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control compliance classification for the customer, indicating whether the account is cleared for shipment of controlled goods under applicable trade regulations.

attributes.name: first_order_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer placed their first order following successful onboarding. Used to measure time-to-revenue and validate onboarding effectiveness.

attributes.name: first_order_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all onboarding prerequisites have been met and the customer account is fully ready to place and process its first order. The primary success criterion for onboarding completion.

attributes.name: industry_vertical

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: nda_signed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) has been executed with the customer. Required for OEM and strategic accounts before sharing proprietary product or engineering data.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the onboarding coordinator to capture additional context, special instructions, customer-specific requirements, or internal observations relevant to the onboarding case.

attributes.name: onboarding_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for the onboarding case, used in communications with the customer and internal teams. Format: ONB-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the onboarding workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through full account activation. Values: not_started, in_progress, on_hold, completed, cancelled.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The SAP payment terms code assigned to the customer account (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Defines the payment schedule and early payment discount terms.

attributes.name: portal_setup_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer self-service portal account provisioning, including login credentials, access rights, and order management capabilities.

attributes.name: pricing_setup_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer-specific pricing configuration in SAP S/4HANA SD, including contract pricing, volume discounts, and special pricing agreements.

attributes.name: quality_agreement_signed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal quality agreement has been signed with the customer, defining quality standards, inspection requirements, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) processes.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the onboarding has breached or is at risk of breaching the agreed SLA target completion date. True if the actual or projected completion date exceeds the SLA target.

attributes.name: sla_target_days
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally agreed number of calendar days within which the onboarding must be completed from contract signature. Drives SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current named stage within the onboarding workflow, representing the active phase of the structured activation process (e.g., Contract Review, Credit Setup, System Configuration, Training, First Order Readiness). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: contract_review|credit_setup|erp_account_creation|edi_portal_setup|pricing_setup|training|first_order_readiness — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: The planned date by which the customer onboarding should be fully completed and the account should be first-order ready. Used for SLA tracking and coordinator workload management.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: The official certificate number of the customer's tax exemption document. Required for tax-exempt account configuration in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the onboarding workflow template applied to this account. Templates vary by account type (OEM, distributor, end-user) and define the required checklist items and stage sequence.

attributes.name: total_checklist_items
attributes.description: The total number of onboarding checklist items applicable to this customer account, based on account type and segment. Denominator for checklist completion percentage.

attributes.name: training_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has completed all required product, portal, and ordering process training sessions as part of the onboarding checklist.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer completed all mandatory onboarding training sessions. Null if training has not yet been completed.

products.name: customer_document

Serves as the SSOT for all customer-furnished documentation required for order processing, manufacturing, and compliance in industrial automation and electrification supply chains.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Product catalog and offering management domain serving as the SSOT for all manufactured products, automation systems, electrification solutions, and smart infrastructure components. Manages SKU master data, product families, configurations, pricing structures, product lifecycle stages from NPI to end-of-life, and product portfolio management.

products.name: sku_master
products.description: Single source of truth for all Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) across the manufactured product portfolio. Captures the authoritative SKU identifier, description, unit of measure, weight, dimensions, hazardous material classification (UN number, hazard class, packing group, SDS reference), export control classification (ECCN), and lifecycle status. Serves as the foundational master record referenced by BOM, MES, ERP (SAP S/4HANA MM), and PLM (Siemens Teamcenter) systems. Every manufactured item, automation system component, electrification solution, and smart infrastructure element is registered here before it can be produced, sold, or shipped. Includes base/sales/production UoM with conversion factors and multi-language commercial descriptions. Note: product pricing structures are owned by the sales domain; this domain owns product identity, structure, and commercial catalog definition only.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU master record. Primary key for the SKU master data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost Allocation Report requires each SKU to be charged to a cost center for manufacturing cost tracking.

attributes.name: revenue_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Financial reporting of sales per SKU needs a dedicated revenue GL account for posting invoices.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Primary Supplier Assignment report requires each SKU to reference its main vendor for cost, lead‑time, and compliance decisions.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and consumption: A (high value, tight control), B (moderate value), C (low value, relaxed control). Used for inventory policy and cycle counting frequency.

attributes.name: base_uom
attributes.description: The fundamental unit of measure for inventory tracking and stock keeping. All other UoM conversions are calculated relative to this base unit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|LB|M|FT|L|GAL|M2|FT2|M3|FT3|SET|KIT — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commercial_description
attributes.description: Marketing-optimized product description for sales and customer communication. Multi-language support maintained in PLM system.

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard cost. Typically the company's base or functional currency for financial reporting.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product is manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU master record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: dimension_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height dimensions. Standardized for consistent warehouse and logistics operations.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU is discontinued and no longer available for new orders. Supports end-of-life planning and inventory liquidation strategies.

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned under the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Determines export licensing requirements and trade compliance obligations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU becomes active and available for transactions. Used for new product introductions and lifecycle transitions.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the product including packaging, measured in the weight UoM. Used for logistics planning, freight calculation, and warehouse capacity management.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: UN hazard classification code indicating the primary hazard type (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 8 for corrosive substances). Used for transportation and storage compliance.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the SKU is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation procedures per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the product or its packaging, measured in the dimension UoM. Used for warehouse slotting and transportation planning.

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification code for customs and international trade. Used to determine import duties, tariffs, and trade statistics reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the SKU master record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the product or its packaging, measured in the dimension UoM. Used for warehouse slotting and transportation planning.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle from New Product Introduction (NPI) through end-of-life. Governs availability for new orders, production scheduling, and inventory management decisions.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Detailed product description for technical documentation, sales catalogs, and customer-facing materials. Includes full technical specifications and feature details.

attributes.name: lot_control_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the SKU requires lot or batch number tracking for traceability, quality control, and recall management purposes.

attributes.name: make_or_buy_code
attributes.description: Procurement strategy indicator: make (manufactured in-house), buy (purchased from suppliers), or both (dual-sourced). Drives MRP planning logic and sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number from S/4HANA MM module. Legacy identifier maintained for ERP integration and cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the product excluding packaging, measured in the weight UoM. Used for material content reporting and customs declarations.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group classification indicating the degree of danger: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger). Determines packaging and handling requirements.

attributes.name: plm_item_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier from Siemens Teamcenter PLM system. Links the SKU master record to engineering design data, CAD models, BOMs, and technical documentation.

attributes.name: product_family_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the product family or product line to which this SKU belongs. Used for portfolio management and product hierarchy reporting.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SKU by manufacturing and inventory treatment. Determines BOM structure, production planning, and inventory valuation methods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: finished_good|semi_finished|raw_material|component|assembly|service_part|consumable|tool — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: production_to_base_conversion
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production to Base Unit of Measure (UoM) Conversion Factor
attributes.description: Conversion factor to translate production UoM quantities to base UoM. Used for MRP calculations and production planning.

tag_set.value: Production to Base Unit of Measure (UoM) Conversion Factor

attributes.name: production_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure used in manufacturing execution and shop floor control. Aligns with MES work order quantities and production reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|LB|M|FT|L|GAL|M2|FT2|M3|FT3|SET|KIT|BATCH|LOT — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Current engineering revision or version of the product design. Managed through ECO/ECN processes in PLM. Critical for configuration management and change control.

attributes.name: sds_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the Safety Data Sheet (formerly MSDS) containing detailed hazard information, handling instructions, and emergency procedures.

attributes.name: serial_control_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the SKU requires individual serial number tracking for warranty management, asset tracking, and field service support.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product remains usable or saleable from the date of manufacture or receipt. Used for inventory rotation, expiration management, and quality control.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Concise product description for internal operational use, typically 40 characters or less. Used in MES shop floor displays and warehouse picking lists.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The authoritative, externally-known unique identifier for the SKU. Used across all systems including SAP S/4HANA MM, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, and Siemens Opcenter MES. This is the business key for the product.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard unit cost for inventory valuation and cost accounting. Maintained in the base currency and updated periodically through cost roll-up processes. Note: pricing structures are owned by the sales domain.

attributes.name: un_number
