attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Volumetric measurement of the product or its packaging, measured in the volume UoM. Used for warehouse capacity planning and freight optimization.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume. Used in logistics and warehouse management calculations.

attributes.name: weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross and net weight values. Standardized across the enterprise for consistent logistics and shipping calculations.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width dimension of the product or its packaging, measured in the dimension UoM. Used for warehouse slotting and transportation planning.

products.name: family
products.description: Defines the hierarchical grouping of related manufactured products into product families and sub-families (e.g., Industrial Drives, Low-Voltage Switchgear, Smart Building Controllers). Manages the product portfolio taxonomy used for planning, pricing, and go-to-market segmentation. Supports multi-level hierarchy with parent-child relationships, market segment alignment, and product line ownership. Referenced by PLM (Siemens Teamcenter) and SAP S/4HANA SD for catalog navigation and revenue reporting.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: Primary key for family

attributes.name: parent_family_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product family in the multi-level hierarchy. Enables nested family structures (e.g., Industrial Automation > Drives > Low Voltage Drives). Null for top-level families.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit Center Performance Report groups families to evaluate profitability by product line.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Family-level audits apply a common regulatory requirement to all SKUs within the family.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit or division responsible for this product family. Defines ownership for P&L accountability, product management, and strategic roadmap decisions.

attributes.name: certification_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required certifications and compliance standards for products in this family (e.g., UL, CE, IEC 61131, ISO 9001, ATEX, IECEx). Defines regulatory and safety compliance scope.

attributes.name: family_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the product family. Used in SAP S/4HANA SD for catalog navigation and PLM (Siemens Teamcenter) for product classification. Serves as the business identifier for cross-system integration.

attributes.name: competitive_positioning
attributes.description: Strategic positioning statement describing how this product family competes in the market (e.g., technology leader, cost leader, niche specialist). Used for marketing strategy and sales enablement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product family record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: cybersecurity_classification
attributes.description: Cybersecurity risk classification for products in this family based on connectivity, data handling, and criticality to customer operations. Drives security testing, vulnerability management, and compliance with IEC 62443 and NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

attributes.name: data_source_system

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Production planning reports require each BOM line to reference the engineering component master to ensure design consistency and cost roll‑up.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.drawing. Business justification: Manufacturing execution system uses the drawing ID per BOM line to fetch exact assembly drawings for work orders and quality inspections.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the component material or part from the SKU master data that is required for this assembly. Each BOM line references exactly one component SKU.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: BOM Supplier Allocation process tracks which vendor supplies each component, essential for production scheduling and quality audits.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production resource where this component is consumed. Used for shop floor material staging and kitting.

attributes.name: alternative_item_group
attributes.description: Identifier for a group of interchangeable components that can substitute for each other in the assembly. Used for flexible BOM structures and supply chain resilience.

attributes.name: alternative_item_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this component within its alternative item group. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for material selection during MRP and production execution.

attributes.name: assembly_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this component in the multi-level BOM structure. Level 0 is the finished product, level 1 is direct sub-assembly, level 2 is sub-sub-assembly, etc. Used for BOM explosion and implosion.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is consumed automatically via backflushing when the operation is confirmed (True) or requires manual goods issue (False). Used in lean manufacturing and MES integration.

attributes.name: bulk_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is a bulk material (liquids, powders, gases) that requires special handling, storage, and measurement during production.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Internal change control number tracking modifications to this BOM line. Used for audit trail and version control in engineering change management.

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the component part or material used in the assembly, providing additional context beyond the SKU reference.

attributes.name: component_height_mm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: component_length_mm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: component_origin
attributes.description: Procurement strategy for this component: make (manufactured in-house), buy (purchased from supplier), make_or_buy (flexible sourcing), subcontract (outsourced manufacturing).

attributes.name: component_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the component in kilograms. Used for calculating total assembly weight, shipping weight, and material handling requirements.

attributes.name: component_width_mm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: cost_relevance_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component should be included in product costing calculations. Text items and phantom assemblies are typically not cost-relevant.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this BOM line record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical for production and requires special attention in material planning, procurement, and availability checking.

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Notice that authorized this BOM line change. Provides traceability to engineering change documentation.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order that introduced or modified this BOM line. Links BOM changes to formal engineering change management processes.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM line is no longer active and should not be used in new production orders. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line becomes active and should be used in production planning and execution. Supports date-effectivity for phased component changes.

attributes.name: fixed_quantity_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of parent assembly batch size (True) or scales proportionally with batch size (False). Used for setup materials and consumables.

attributes.name: installation_point
attributes.description: Physical location or position identifier where this component is installed in the parent assembly. Used for assembly instructions and service documentation.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM line item type: stock (regular inventory item), non_stock (direct procurement), phantom (pass-through assembly with no inventory), text (documentation only), variable_size (length/weight variable), co_product (joint output), by_product (secondary output). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock|non_stock|phantom|text|variable_size|co_product|by_product — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the parent assembly start date that this component must be available. Used for backward scheduling in production planning and MRP runs.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the BOM header, used for ordering and referencing specific components in the assembly structure.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this BOM line record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, comments, or special handling requirements for this component in the assembly process.

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: The routing operation number at which this component is consumed or installed in the manufacturing process. Links BOM to routing for integrated production planning.

attributes.name: product_bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line: active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), pending (awaiting approval), obsolete (phased out), blocked (quality hold), released (approved for production).

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The required quantity of this component needed to produce one unit of the parent assembly. Supports up to 6 decimal places for precision in chemical, pharmaceutical, and electronics manufacturing.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Engineering revision level or version of this BOM line. Tracks design iterations and ensures correct component versions are used in production.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percent
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during the manufacturing process. Used by MRP to calculate additional material requirements. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: spare_part_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is also available as a spare part for after-sales service and maintenance. Used for service parts planning and documentation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the component quantity (e.g., EA=Each, PC=Piece, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter, M=Meter). Must align with the component SKU base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|G|L|ML|M|CM|FT|IN|LB|OZ|SET|BOX|ROLL|SHEET — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: lifecycle_stage
products.description: Tracks the lifecycle stage of each product from New Product Introduction (NPI) through active production, phase-down, and end-of-life (EOL). Captures lifecycle stage code, stage entry date, planned EOL date, last-time-buy date, last-time-ship date, replacement product reference, and lifecycle decision rationale. Supports portfolio rationalization, supply chain wind-down planning, and customer communication for discontinued automation and electrification products. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.
products.reference: PLM Lifecycle Management, APQP Phase Gates

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lifecycle_stage

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product in the product master catalog. Links this lifecycle stage record to the specific manufactured product, automation system, electrification solution, or smart infrastructure component.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: EOL and phase‑out decisions depend on regulatory deadlines; linking each lifecycle stage to its governing regulation.

attributes.name: actual_eol_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the product reached end-of-life status. May differ from planned EOL date due to market conditions, inventory levels, or strategic decisions.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_code
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the product. NPI = New Product Introduction (pre-production or early launch), ACTIVE = Full production and sales, MATURE = Established product with stable demand, PHASE_DOWN = Planned reduction in production, EOL = End of Life (discontinued), OBSOLETE = No longer supported or available.

attributes.name: customer_communication_status
attributes.description: Status of customer notification and communication activities regarding the lifecycle stage change. Ensures timely and coordinated customer outreach for product discontinuations and transitions.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when customers were officially notified of the lifecycle stage change, particularly for phase-down and end-of-life transitions. Critical for customer relationship management and contractual obligations.

attributes.name: eco_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Order that authorized or documented the lifecycle stage transition, if applicable. Links lifecycle decisions to formal engineering change management processes.

attributes.name: financial_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Summary of the financial implications of the lifecycle stage transition, including revenue impact, inventory write-offs, cost savings, and investment requirements. Business-confidential information for portfolio management.

attributes.name: internal_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when internal stakeholders (sales, service, manufacturing, engineering) were notified of the lifecycle stage change to align cross-functional activities.

attributes.name: inventory_wind_down_plan
attributes.description: Summary of the inventory management strategy for phasing out the product, including target inventory levels, sell-through timelines, and disposition plans for excess stock.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active lifecycle stage record for the product. Supports lifecycle history tracking with multiple stage records per product over time.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date by which customers can place orders for the product before it is discontinued. Critical milestone for customer communication and order management during product phase-out.

attributes.name: last_time_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date by which the product will be shipped to customers. Represents the absolute end of product availability and delivery.

attributes.name: lifecycle_decision_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the person or committee that authorized the lifecycle stage transition. Supports governance and accountability for product portfolio decisions.

attributes.name: lifecycle_decision_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification and reasoning for the lifecycle stage transition. Documents strategic, market, technical, or regulatory factors driving the lifecycle decision for portfolio rationalization and governance.

attributes.name: lifecycle_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent lifecycle stage review or assessment. Ensures regular evaluation of product portfolio health and lifecycle progression.

attributes.name: manufacturing_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when manufacturing and production of the product will cease. Drives supply chain wind-down, capacity reallocation, and inventory planning.

attributes.name: market_demand_trend
attributes.description: Current market demand trend for the product. GROWING = increasing sales and market share, STABLE = consistent demand, DECLINING = decreasing sales, VOLATILE = unpredictable fluctuations, UNKNOWN = insufficient data. Informs lifecycle stage decisions and portfolio strategy.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the lifecycle stage for reporting and communication purposes.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next lifecycle stage review. Supports proactive lifecycle management and timely decision-making for product portfolio optimization.

attributes.name: planned_eol_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the product will reach end-of-life status and be discontinued from active production and sales. Critical for supply chain wind-down planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: previous_lifecycle_stage_code
attributes.description: The lifecycle stage code that preceded the current stage. Enables lifecycle transition analysis and stage progression tracking.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this lifecycle stage record. Supports accountability and audit trail for lifecycle decisions.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle stage record was created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage for lifecycle management.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this lifecycle stage record. Supports accountability and audit trail for lifecycle changes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this lifecycle stage record. Enables change tracking and audit trail for lifecycle management.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_impact
attributes.description: Description of any regulatory or compliance factors influencing the lifecycle stage decision, such as safety standards updates, environmental regulations, or certification requirements for industrial automation and electrification products.

attributes.name: sales_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when active sales and marketing efforts for the product will cease. May differ from last-time-buy date to allow for inventory sell-through.

attributes.name: service_support_end_date
attributes.description: Date when after-sales service, technical support, and spare parts availability will cease for the product. Critical for customer service planning and SLA management.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this lifecycle stage record in the source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: spare_parts_availability_end_date
attributes.description: Date when spare parts for the product will no longer be available for purchase. Important for maintenance planning and customer communication for automation and electrification systems.

attributes.name: stage_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the lifecycle stage transition became effective in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking for lifecycle decisions.

attributes.name: stage_entry_date
attributes.description: Date when the product entered the current lifecycle stage. Used to track time-in-stage and lifecycle progression analytics.

attributes.name: supplier_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when suppliers and supply chain partners were notified of the lifecycle stage change to coordinate material procurement wind-down and component availability.

attributes.name: warranty_support_end_date
attributes.description: Date when warranty coverage for newly sold units of this product will cease. Affects sales terms and customer commitments during product phase-out.

products.name: product_revision
products.description: Manages engineering revision history for manufactured products, tracking each revision level, Engineering Change Order (ECO) and Engineering Change Notice (ECN) references, revision description, effectivity date, and approval status. Captures the delta between revisions including affected BOM lines, drawing changes, and specification updates. Ensures traceability from product design through manufacturing execution per ISO 9001 document control requirements. Sourced from Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: product_revision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product revision record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Revision approval logs approved_by_employee_id to capture the engineer authorizing the product revision.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product for which this revision applies. Links to the product master record.

attributes.name: superseded_revision_product_revision_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous product revision that this revision replaces. Maintains revision lineage and traceability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision was formally approved for release to manufacturing.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the revision within the engineering change control workflow.

attributes.name: bom_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision includes changes to the product Bill of Materials structure or component list.

attributes.name: change_impact_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the magnitude and scope of impact this revision has on form, fit, function, manufacturing process, or supply chain.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorization of the primary business reason or driver for this engineering revision.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revision record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers must be formally notified of this revision due to impact on form, fit, function, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: drawing_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision includes changes to engineering drawings, CAD (Computer-Aided Design) models, or technical documentation.

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Notice that communicated this revision to stakeholders. Documents the notification of the approved change.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Order that authorized this revision. Provides traceability to the formal change request and approval process.

attributes.name: effectivity_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision becomes effective for manufacturing and procurement. Determines when the new revision must be used in production.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_end
attributes.description: Ending serial number through which this revision is effective, when effectivity is controlled by serial number range.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_start
attributes.description: Starting serial number from which this revision is effective, when effectivity is controlled by serial number.

attributes.name: effectivity_type
attributes.description: Method by which the revision effectivity is controlled (by date, serial number range, lot/batch, or immediate implementation).

attributes.name: interchangeability_code
attributes.description: Defines whether this revision can be substituted for previous revisions in existing assemblies or field installations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revision record was last updated in the source system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, comments, or instructions related to this revision for engineering, manufacturing, or quality teams.

attributes.name: obsolete_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision was marked as obsolete and no longer valid for new production orders.

attributes.name: ppap_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires a new Production Part Approval Process submission to customers.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag

attributes.name: process_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires changes to manufacturing processes, work instructions, or shop floor procedures.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires re-certification or approval from regulatory bodies (UL, CE, OSHA, EPA, etc.).

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision was officially released to production and made available for use in manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: revision_code
attributes.description: Engineering revision level identifier (e.g., A, B, C, 01, 02). Represents the sequential version of the product design.

attributes.name: revision_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the changes introduced in this revision, including design modifications, material changes, or process improvements.

attributes.name: revision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product revision indicating its approval and release state.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this revision record in the source PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) system for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: specification_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision includes changes to product specifications, performance requirements, or acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: testing_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires changes to quality testing procedures, inspection plans, or validation protocols.

attributes.name: tooling_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires changes to manufacturing tooling, fixtures, jigs, or molds.

products.name: product_specification
products.description: Technical and commercial specifications for manufactured products, automation systems, and electrification solutions. Captures electrical ratings, mechanical dimensions, environmental ratings (IP class, NEMA class), operating temperature range, performance parameters, and application suitability. Includes references to associated technical documentation (datasheets, installation manuals, safety data sheets) managed in the engineering domain's document management system. Serves as the authoritative technical specification record referenced by engineering, quality, and sales teams. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and SAP S/4HANA. Note: certification records (UL, CE, IEC, ATEX, RoHS/REACH) are tracked separately in the certification product.
products.reference: PLM Product Specification, IEC/UL/CE Technical Standards

attributes.name: product_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Specification approval workflow tracks which engineer approved each spec via approved_by_employee_id.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Specification approval workflow requires linking each specification to the governing regulatory standard.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product in the product catalog. Links this specification to the master product record.

attributes.name: altitude_rating_meters
attributes.description: Maximum operating altitude in meters above sea level. Defines altitude limitations for product operation due to air pressure and cooling considerations.

attributes.name: application_suitability
attributes.description: Intended application areas and use cases. Describes the industrial applications, environments, or processes for which the product is designed and suitable.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version was formally approved. Tracks the approval milestone in the specification lifecycle.

attributes.name: color_finish
attributes.description: Product color and surface finish. Describes the external appearance and coating (e.g., RAL 7035 light grey, powder coated, anodized aluminum).

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Supported communication protocols for data exchange. Lists the industrial communication standards the product supports (e.g., PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA).

attributes.name: connection_type
attributes.description: Electrical connection or terminal type. Describes the method for connecting wires or cables to the product (e.g., screw terminals, spring clamp, plug connector).

attributes.name: current_rating_amperes
attributes.description: Maximum continuous current rating in amperes. Defines the electrical current capacity of the product.

attributes.name: datasheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the associated product datasheet. Links to the detailed technical datasheet managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: dimensions_height_mm
attributes.description: Product height dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical height for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: dimensions_length_mm
attributes.description: Product length dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical length for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: dimensions_width_mm
attributes.description: Product width dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical width for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version becomes effective and applicable for use in engineering, manufacturing, and sales processes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version is no longer valid or has been superseded by a newer revision. Null for active specifications without planned obsolescence.

attributes.name: frequency_rating_hz
attributes.description: Operating frequency rating in Hertz. Specifies the electrical frequency the product is designed for (e.g., 50Hz, 60Hz, 50/60Hz).

attributes.name: humidity_rating_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity rating or range for product operation. Specifies the acceptable humidity conditions (e.g., 5-95% RH non-condensing).

attributes.name: installation_manual_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the installation manual. Links to the installation instructions managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: ip_rating
attributes.description: Ingress Protection rating per IEC 60529 standard. Defines the level of protection against solid objects and liquids (e.g., IP65, IP67, IP20).

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Primary materials used in product construction. Lists the key materials and their properties (e.g., stainless steel housing, polycarbonate cover, copper conductors).

attributes.name: mounting_type
attributes.description: Physical mounting method for the product. Specifies how the product is installed (e.g., DIN rail, panel mount, wall mount).

attributes.name: nema_rating
attributes.description: NEMA enclosure rating for North American markets. Defines environmental protection level (e.g., NEMA1, NEMA4, NEMA4X, NEMA12).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the specification. Captures supplementary information for engineering, quality, or sales teams.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum operating ambient temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the upper temperature limit for safe and reliable product operation.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum operating ambient temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the lower temperature limit for safe and reliable product operation.

attributes.name: performance_parameter
attributes.description: Key performance parameters and metrics. Describes critical performance characteristics such as response time, accuracy, throughput, or efficiency ratings specific to the product type.

attributes.name: power_rating_watts
attributes.description: Electrical power rating in watts. Specifies the maximum power consumption or output capacity of the product.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was first created in the system. Tracks the initial capture of the specification data.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to any field in the specification record.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier for the specification document. Tracks changes and updates over time.

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Safety Data Sheet. Links to the SDS document for products containing hazardous materials, managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: shock_resistance
attributes.description: Mechanical shock resistance specification. Describes the products ability to withstand mechanical shock per applicable test standards (e.g., IEC 60068-2-27).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this specification record in the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: specification_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the product specification. Provides comprehensive technical and commercial details not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: specification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the product specification. Describes the specification purpose or scope.

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the product specification document. Used for external reference and traceability across engineering, quality, and sales teams.

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product specification. Tracks the approval and active state of the specification document.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification document type. Indicates whether the specification covers technical parameters, commercial terms, or a combination.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the upper temperature limit for product storage when not in operation.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the lower temperature limit for product storage when not in operation.

attributes.name: technical_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for associated technical drawings. Links to CAD drawings, dimensional drawings, or assembly drawings managed in the PLM system.

attributes.name: vibration_resistance
attributes.description: Vibration resistance specification. Describes the products ability to withstand mechanical vibration per applicable test standards (e.g., IEC 60068-2-6).

attributes.name: voltage_rating
attributes.description: Electrical voltage rating or range for the product. Specifies the nominal operating voltage and acceptable voltage range (e.g., 24VDC, 110-240VAC, 400V 3-phase).

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Product weight in kilograms. Defines the mass for shipping, handling, and installation planning.

products.name: product_certification
products.description: Tracks regulatory and safety certifications obtained for manufactured products including UL listings, CE marking, IEC compliance, ATEX ratings, RoHS/REACH declarations, and export control classifications (ECCN). Captures certifying body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, applicable markets/regions, product scope, and renewal status. Critical for market access compliance and customer-facing documentation. Supports ISO 9001 quality records and regulatory reporting to UL, CE, and OSHA.
products.reference: UL Listing, CE Marking, IEC 61131, RoHS/REACH

attributes.name: product_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_asset_certification_id
attributes.description: Reference to SSOT owner asset.asset_certification for certification conflict resolution.

attributes.name: product_asset_asset_certification_ssot_ref_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Asset Asset Certification Ssot Ref Id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to the single source of truth record; this product is a non-authoritative duplicate view.

tag_set.value: Product Asset Asset Certification Ssot Ref Id

attributes.name: responsible_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Certification management assigns responsible_engineer_employee_id to record accountability for each certification.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufactured product, automation system, electrification solution, or smart infrastructure component that holds this certification.

attributes.name: applicable_markets
attributes.description: Geographic markets, regions, or countries where this certification enables product sale and distribution (e.g., European Union, North America, APAC). Pipe-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region identifiers.

attributes.name: applicable_standards
attributes.description: Technical standards, regulations, or directives against which the product was certified (e.g., IEC 61131-2, EN 60204-1, UL 508). Pipe-separated list of standard identifiers.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent audit or inspection conducted by the certifying body to verify ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: certificate_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the certification certificate document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Classification or rating level assigned by the certification (e.g., ATEX Zone 1, IP67, Safety Integrity Level SIL 2, Performance Level PLd).

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number or listing identifier issued by the certifying body (e.g., UL file number, CE declaration number, IEC certificate ID).

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification indicating whether it is valid, expired, pending renewal, or revoked.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory or safety certification obtained. Indicates the certification standard or framework under which the product was evaluated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UL Listing|CE Marking|IEC Compliance|ATEX Rating|RoHS Declaration|REACH Declaration|ECCN Classification|FCC Certification|CSA Approval|TUV Certification — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or authority that issued the certification (e.g., Underwriters Laboratories, TUV Rheinland, Notified Body, National Standards Authority).

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to obtain and maintain this certification, including testing fees, audit fees, and certification body charges.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cybersecurity_certification
attributes.description: Cybersecurity certification or compliance level achieved by the product (e.g., IEC 62443-4-1, IEC 62443-4-2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework).

attributes.name: declaration_of_conformity_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturer's Declaration of Conformity document associated with this certification, particularly for CE marking.

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned under the U.S. Commerce Control List for dual-use items subject to export regulations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the certification becomes valid and the product is authorized for market access under the certification scope.

attributes.name: energy_efficiency_rating
attributes.description: Energy efficiency classification or rating assigned to the product (e.g., Energy Star, EU Energy Label class A+++, IEC 60034-30-1 efficiency class IE3).

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental management or sustainability certification obtained (e.g., ISO 14001, LEED, BREEAM, Cradle to Cradle).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and requires renewal. Null for certifications with indefinite validity subject to ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: functional_safety_certification
attributes.description: Functional safety certification level achieved by the product (e.g., IEC 61508 SIL 2, ISO 13849 PLd, IEC 61511).

attributes.name: is_customer_facing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is typically disclosed to customers in product documentation, datasheets, or sales materials as a market differentiator.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was officially issued or granted by the certifying body.

attributes.name: mandatory_for_markets
attributes.description: List of markets or regions where this certification is legally mandatory for product sale (as opposed to voluntary). Pipe-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next surveillance audit or re-certification assessment by the certifying body.

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Description of the product models, configurations, or variants covered under this certification. Defines the boundary of what is certified.

attributes.name: quality_certification
attributes.description: Quality management system certification under which the product was manufactured (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AS9100).

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product complies with REACH regulation for chemical substance registration and restriction in the European Union.

tag_set.value: Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, conditions, limitations, or special requirements associated with the certification. May include restrictions on use, environmental conditions, or configuration dependencies.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Target or scheduled date for certification renewal or re-assessment to maintain continuous compliance.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product complies with RoHS Directive restricting the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment.

attributes.name: test_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the test report or assessment documentation that supports the certification issuance.

attributes.name: weee_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product complies with WEEE Directive for proper disposal and recycling of electronic waste.

tag_set.value: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) Compliant

products.name: substitution
products.description: Defines approved substitute and alternate products for SKUs that are discontinued, on allocation, or unavailable. Captures the primary SKU, substitute SKU, substitution type (direct replacement, functional equivalent, upward compatible), effective date, approval status, and any application restrictions. Supports order management fallback logic in SAP S/4HANA SD, MRP alternative item processing, and customer service resolution for end-of-life product transitions.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Alternate Item Group

attributes.name: substitution_id
attributes.description: Primary key for substitution

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Substitution approval process logs approved_by_employee_id to capture who authorized a substitution.

attributes.name: primary_sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Link primary SKU to master record for substitution; removes free‑form primary_sku column

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Substituted parts must satisfy the same regulatory requirement as the original part for compliance approval.

attributes.name: application_restriction
attributes.description: Free-text description of any limitations or restrictions on where the substitute can be used. May reference specific customer segments, geographic regions, or application types.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution was formally approved by engineering, quality, or product management.

attributes.name: automatic_substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution can be applied automatically by MRP or order management systems (true) or requires manual approval (false).

attributes.name: compliance_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute product requires additional compliance certifications (UL, CE, IEC) before it can be used in regulated applications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the substitution record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer approval or notification is required before applying the substitution in order fulfillment.

attributes.name: customer_segment_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segment codes where this substitution is restricted or not recommended.

attributes.name: eco_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order that authorized or documented this substitution. Links to PLM system ECO records.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution becomes valid and can be used in order management, MRP, and customer service processes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution is no longer valid. Null indicates indefinite validity.

attributes.name: form_fit_function_match
attributes.description: Indicates the degree of form-fit-function equivalence between primary and substitute. Exact means identical in all dimensions; partial means some differences exist; none means significant differences.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this substitution is NOT permitted due to regulatory, certification, or business policy reasons.

attributes.name: interchangeable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution is bidirectional (true) or unidirectional (false). When true, both SKUs can substitute for each other.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user or system that last modified the substitution record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the substitution record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when this substitution was applied in a business transaction.

attributes.name: lead_time_variance_days
attributes.description: Difference in standard lead time between substitute and primary SKU, measured in days. Positive values indicate longer lead time for substitute.

attributes.name: price_variance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage difference in list price between the substitute and primary SKU. Positive values indicate the substitute is more expensive; negative values indicate cost savings.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating preference order when multiple substitutes exist for the same primary SKU. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by MRP and order management fallback logic.

attributes.name: quality_equivalence_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quality assurance has verified that the substitute meets the same quality standards as the primary SKU through testing or certification.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business reason for establishing the substitution relationship. Captures why the primary SKU requires a substitute. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discontinued|end_of_life|allocation|supply_shortage|obsolete|cost_reduction|quality_improvement|design_change — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this substitution record in the source system of record.

attributes.name: substitute_sku
attributes.description: The replacement or substitute SKU that can be used in place of the primary SKU.

attributes.name: substitution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the substitution record. Active indicates the substitution is in effect; pending approval awaits engineering or quality review; approved is authorized but not yet effective; rejected was not approved; expired is no longer valid; suspended is temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the substitution relationship. Direct replacement indicates identical form-fit-function; functional equivalent provides same capability with potential differences; upward compatible offers enhanced features; temporary substitute is short-term solution; cross-reference indicates OEM equivalence; alternate is approved alternative.

attributes.name: technical_notes
attributes.description: Engineering or technical notes describing differences between primary and substitute SKUs, installation considerations, or compatibility information.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times this substitution has been applied in order management or MRP processes. Used for analytics and substitution effectiveness tracking.

products.name: bundle
products.description: Defines commercial product bundles, solution packages, and system kits that combine multiple SKUs into a single orderable offering (e.g., a complete automation cell bundle including PLC, HMI, drives, and cabling). Captures bundle code, bundle type (fixed, configurable, promotional), component SKU list with quantities, bundle pricing method (sum-of-parts, fixed, discounted), availability period, and minimum order quantity. Supports solution selling for industrial automation and electrification systems in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA SD. Distinct from catalog_entry which represents individual orderable items; bundle represents composite offerings.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales BOM / Bundle

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bundle

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Bundle approval tracking uses approved_by_user_employee_id to identify the employee approving the bundle.

tag_set.value: Approved By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: product_family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.family

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Bundle profitability analysis aggregates revenue and cost under a dedicated profit center.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status for new or modified bundles requiring management or product committee approval before activation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle was approved for sale. Null if approval_status is not 'approved'.

attributes.name: assembly_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bundle requires factory assembly or integration before shipment (True) or is shipped as separate components (False).

attributes.name: availability_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this bundle is no longer available for new orders. Null for ongoing offerings. Used for promotional bundles and product phase-out planning.

attributes.name: availability_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this bundle becomes available for sale. Used for new product introduction (NPI) and promotional campaign timing.

attributes.name: bundle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bundle: draft (under development), active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), discontinued (no longer sold but supported), obsolete (end-of-life).

attributes.name: bundle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bundle structure: fixed (pre-defined components, no substitution), configurable (customer can select options), promotional (time-limited marketing offer), solution (engineered system package), service (includes maintenance/support).

attributes.name: certification_requirements
attributes.description: List of industry certifications or compliance standards the bundle meets (e.g., 'CE', 'UL', 'IEC 61508', 'ATEX'). Critical for regulated industries and export compliance.

attributes.name: bundle_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the bundle, used in sales orders and quotations. Typically follows company SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) pattern for composite offerings.

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) components included in this bundle. Used for complexity assessment and inventory planning.

attributes.name: configuration_rules
attributes.description: Business rules governing component selection and substitution for configurable bundles. Describes constraints, dependencies, and valid option combinations.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary country of manufacture or assembly for the bundle. Used for customs, tariffs, and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this bundle record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the list price (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: bundle_description
attributes.description: Detailed commercial description of the bundle, including key features, benefits, and typical use cases. Used in catalogs, quotations, and sales documentation.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount percentage applied to the sum-of-parts price when pricing_method is 'discounted'. Null for other pricing methods.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the distribution channel through which this bundle is sold (e.g., direct sales, distributor, OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), e-commerce).

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to the bundle for U.S. export control compliance. Determines licensing requirements for international shipments.

attributes.name: energy_efficiency_rating
attributes.description: Energy efficiency classification or rating for the bundle if applicable (e.g., 'A+++', 'Energy Star', 'IE4'). Used for sustainability reporting and customer decision-making.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance
attributes.description: Environmental compliance certifications and declarations for the bundle (e.g., 'RoHS', 'REACH', 'WEEE', 'ISO 14001'). Critical for EU and global environmental regulations.

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: Hazardous material classification code if the bundle contains components subject to dangerous goods regulations. Used for shipping and handling compliance.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code for the bundle. Used for international trade, customs declarations, and duty calculation.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL to the primary product image or rendering of the bundle. Used in e-commerce, catalogs, and sales presentations.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this bundle record. Used for change management and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to delivery for this bundle. Accounts for component availability, assembly, and logistics.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Standard list price for the bundle in the base currency. Represents the published price before any customer-specific discounts or negotiations.

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Extended marketing copy and value proposition for the bundle, used in promotional materials, web catalogs, and sales presentations. Distinct from technical bundle_description.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of bundle units that must be ordered in a single transaction. Used to enforce volume thresholds for bundled offerings.

attributes.name: bundle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the bundle as presented to customers and used in sales materials (e.g., 'Automation Cell Starter Kit', 'Smart Factory Solution Package').

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Description of the standard packaging method for the bundle (e.g., 'Wooden Crate', 'Cardboard Box', 'Pallet', 'Custom Container'). Impacts shipping and handling requirements.

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate bundle price: sum_of_parts (total of component prices), fixed_price (single bundle price regardless of components), discounted (percentage off sum-of-parts), tiered (volume-based pricing), custom (negotiated per deal).

attributes.name: replacement_bundle_code
attributes.description: Bundle code of the successor or replacement bundle when this bundle is discontinued. Used for product transition planning and customer migration.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales organization responsible for this bundle. Used in multi-division enterprises to segment product portfolios by business unit or geography.

attributes.name: service_level_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard service level or SLA (Service Level Agreement) tier included with the bundle (e.g., 'BASIC', 'PREMIUM', '24x7').

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment or industry vertical this bundle is designed for (e.g., 'Automotive Manufacturing', 'Food & Beverage', 'Pharmaceutical', 'Discrete Manufacturing').

attributes.name: technical_documentation_url
attributes.description: URL or document reference to the technical documentation, installation guides, and specifications for the bundle. Used by sales engineering and customer support.

attributes.name: volume_m3
attributes.description: Total shipping volume of the complete bundle in cubic meters, including packaging. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Standard warranty period in months provided with the bundle. Covers all included components under a unified warranty policy.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total shipping weight of the complete bundle in kilograms, including all components and packaging. Used for logistics planning and freight cost calculation.

products.name: plant_data
products.description: Plant-specific master data extensions for each SKU, capturing manufacturing plant assignment, MRP type, lot size procedure, safety stock level, reorder point, planned delivery time, production storage location, and quality inspection type. Represents the SAP S/4HANA MM/PP plant view of the material master, enabling plant-level production planning, MRP runs, and inventory management. Each SKU may have different plant data records per manufacturing facility.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Plant View (MRP1/MRP2/MRP3)

attributes.name: plant_data_id
attributes.description: Primary key for plant_data

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Plant‑level cost reporting requires linking plant data to the plant's cost center.

attributes.name: production_scheduler_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Production scheduling assigns production_scheduler_employee_id to link the scheduler employee for labor planning.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Associate plant‑specific data with the SKU it describes; enables plant‑level planning per SKU

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC classification for inventory management prioritization. A=High-value items requiring tight control, B=Medium-value items, C=Low-value items with relaxed control.

attributes.name: availability_check_group
attributes.description: Two-character key that controls which stock types are included in ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks for sales orders and production orders.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether components are backflushed (automatically issued) when production order confirmations are posted. True=Backflush enabled, False=Manual goods issue required.

attributes.name: batch_management_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether batch/lot tracking is required for this material at this plant. True=Batch management active, False=No batch tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plant data record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_counting_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code that determines the frequency of cycle counting for this material. Used to schedule physical inventory counts.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this material will be discontinued at this plant. Used for phase-out planning and last-time-buy notifications.

attributes.name: effective_out_date
attributes.description: Date from which this plant data record becomes inactive. Used to manage time-dependent plant data changes.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size
attributes.description: Fixed order quantity used when lot size procedure is set to fixed lot size. MRP will always propose this quantity.

attributes.name: gr_processing_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for goods receipt processing, quality inspection, and stock placement after physical delivery.

attributes.name: in_house_production_time_days
attributes.description: Number of working days required to manufacture this material from raw materials to finished goods at this plant. Used in production scheduling and MRP.

attributes.name: inspection_setup_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality inspection setup (inspection lot creation) is required for goods receipts of this material at this plant. True=Inspection required, False=No inspection.

attributes.name: issue_storage_location
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the default storage location from which materials are issued to production orders or sales orders.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plant data record was last updated.

attributes.name: lot_size_procedure
attributes.description: Lot-sizing procedure used in MRP to determine order quantities. EX=Lot-for-lot, HB=Replenish to maximum stock level, FX=Fixed lot size, WB=Weekly lot size, PK=Period lot size, LS=Lot size key.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique material identifier (SKU) from the material master. Links this plant data record to the global material master.

attributes.name: maximum_lot_size
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or produced in a single lot for this material at this plant. Used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Target maximum inventory level for this material at this plant. Used in replenishment planning to determine order quantities.

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or produced in a single lot for this material at this plant. Used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required for goods receipt acceptance. Batches with less remaining shelf life are rejected.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this plant data record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the person or group responsible for MRP and procurement activities for this material at this plant.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure that controls how material requirements are planned. PD=MRP, VB=Manual reorder point, VM=Forecast-based planning, VV=Time-phased planning, ND=No planning, R1=Reorder point planning, R2=Replenishment planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PD|VB|VM|VV|ND|R1|R2 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: negative_stock_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether negative stock balances are permitted for this material at this plant. True=Negative stock allowed, False=System blocks transactions that would create negative stock.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from order placement to goods receipt. Used by MRP to schedule procurement proposals and calculate reorder points.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility where this material is produced or stocked. Each plant has its own plant data record for a given material.

attributes.name: plant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this material at this plant. Active=Normal production/sales, Blocked=Temporarily unavailable, Discontinued=End-of-life, Phase_out=Being phased out, New_product_introduction=NPI stage.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is procured at this plant. E=In-house production, F=External procurement (purchasing), X=Both production and external procurement.

attributes.name: production_storage_location
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the default storage location within the plant where finished goods from production are received.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Ten-character code identifying the profit center responsible for this material at this plant. Used for internal profitability analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_type
attributes.description: QM inspection type that determines when quality inspections are triggered. 01=Goods receipt from vendor, 02=Goods receipt from production, 03=Goods issue to customer, 04=Stock transfer, 05=Physical inventory, 08=Recurring inspection, 09=Audit inspection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|03|04|05|08|09 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Stock level at which MRP triggers a procurement proposal. Calculated based on lead time demand plus safety stock.

attributes.name: rounding_value
attributes.description: Rounding value for lot sizes. MRP rounds proposed order quantities up to the nearest multiple of this value.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum stock level maintained as buffer against demand fluctuations and supply disruptions. MRP triggers procurement when stock falls below this level plus reorder point.

attributes.name: scheduling_margin_key
attributes.description: Key that defines float times (opening period, float before production, float after production) used in production scheduling to add buffer time.

attributes.name: serialization_level
attributes.description: Controls serial number management for this material at this plant. 0=No serial numbers, 1=Serial number at goods receipt, 2=Serial number at goods issue, 3=Serial number at goods receipt and issue, 4=Serial number at production.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life period in days from production date to expiration date. Used for batch management and FEFO (First Expired First Out) logic.

attributes.name: special_procurement_type
attributes.description: Special procurement key for subcontracting, consignment, stock transfer, or other special procurement scenarios. 10=Withdrawal from warehouse, 20=Production in another plant, 30=External procurement, 40=Subcontracting, 50=Phantom assembly, 51=Phantom assembly with lead time, 52=Collective order, 70=Stock transfer, 80=Consignment, 90=Pipeline. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 10|20|30|40|50|51|52|70|80|90 — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Four-digit code that determines the general ledger accounts to which inventory movements are posted. Links material movements to financial accounting.

products.name: classification
products.description: Assigns products to standardized classification schemes including industry taxonomy codes (UNSPSC, eCl@ss, ETIM), internal product category hierarchy, and customs tariff/HS codes for export compliance. Captures classification scheme, class code, class description, and assignment validity. Supports procurement catalog integration via SAP Ariba, customs documentation in logistics, and product search/filtering in the commercial catalog. Managed in SAP S/4HANA MM classification system.
products.reference: UNSPSC, eCl@ss, ETIM, SAP Classification System

attributes.name: classification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for classification

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product being classified. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: application_area
attributes.description: The functional application area or use case for the product (e.g., Process Automation, Building Management, Motion Control, Power Distribution).

attributes.name: assigned_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that assigned this classification. Supports audit trail and data quality accountability.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: The date when this classification was originally assigned to the product. Distinct from effective start date; tracks data lineage.

attributes.name: auto_classified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this classification was assigned automatically by a system or AI/ML model (true) or manually by a human user (false). Supports data quality monitoring and exception handling.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division responsible for the product. Supports P&L reporting and organizational accountability.

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: The specific classification code or identifier within the chosen scheme. For example, UNSPSC segment-family-class-commodity code, eCl@ss class ID, or HS tariff code.

attributes.name: class_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the classification class. Provides business context for the class code.

attributes.name: class_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the classification within the scheme. For example, in UNSPSC: 1=Segment, 2=Family, 3=Class, 4=Commodity. Enables drill-down and roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the classification assignment. Active classifications are used for procurement, catalog, and export documentation. Deprecated classifications are retained for historical reporting.

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Internal or industry-specific commodity code used for procurement categorization, spend analysis, and supplier management. Often aligned with SAP Ariba commodity taxonomy.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: A confidence score (0-100) indicating the certainty or quality of the classification assignment. Used when classifications are assigned by automated systems or AI/ML models.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product is manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs documentation and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this classification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customs_tariff_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System tariff classification code used for customs declarations, import/export documentation, and duty calculation. Critical for international trade compliance.

attributes.name: data_quality_status
attributes.description: The data quality status of this classification record. Indicates whether the classification has been verified, requires review, or has quality issues. Supports data stewardship workflows.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date until which this classification assignment is valid. Null indicates an open-ended assignment. Used for managing classification transitions and product reclassifications.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this classification assignment is valid and should be used for business processes. Supports time-based classification changes for product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification number assigned under export control regulations (e.g., US EAR, EU Dual-Use Regulation). Determines licensing requirements for international shipments of controlled goods.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The primary industry segment or vertical market for which the product is designed (e.g., Automotive, Food & Beverage, Pharmaceuticals, Energy, Infrastructure).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this classification record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
