products.name: sales_contract
products.description: Executed commercial sales contract governing the terms and conditions for supply of industrial automation, electrification, or infrastructure products and systems. Captures contract value, duration, payment milestones, delivery schedule, SLA commitments, warranty provisions, penalty clauses, governing law, and Incoterms. Distinct from procurement contracts (owned by procurement domain) and service contracts (owned by service domain). SSOT for commercial sales agreement terms only.
products.reference: SAP SD Sales Contract / Salesforce Contract

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales contract. Primary key for the sales contract entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Contract accounting requires mapping contract revenue/costs to a cost center for internal cost tracking.

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.credit_profile. Business justification: Linking contracts to credit profiles enables automated credit risk checks required for contract approval in manufacturing.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that is the counterparty to this sales contract. Links to the customer master data for billing, shipping, and relationship management.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or business unit that owns and is accountable for this sales contract. Responsible for contract administration, compliance, and customer relationship.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: Contracts often cover specific equipment for service or warranty; linking provides traceability for compliance and service scheduling.

attributes.name: product_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.family. Business justification: Contracts often cover entire product families; linking enables compliance checks, warranty terms, and pricing rules per family.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit center assignment enables profit margin reporting per contract (mandatory for management reporting).

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Contract‑Project binding: ensures the contractual obligations are tied to the specific project for compliance and cost tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Contracts embed clauses referencing the primary regulatory requirement governing the sale, enabling legal compliance tracking.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager responsible for negotiating and managing this sales contract. Links to employee or sales team master data.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic or organizational sales territory to which this contract is assigned. Used for territory management, quota tracking, and commission calculation.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Sales contracts often reference a supplier responsible for warranty or service parts; linking enables warranty claim routing and supplier performance monitoring.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales contract received final internal approval and was authorized for execution. Marks completion of internal review and sign-off process.

attributes.name: compliance_certifications_required
attributes.description: List of mandatory certifications, standards, or regulatory approvals that products or services must meet under the sales contract. Examples: CE marking, UL certification, ISO 9001, IEC 61131, OSHA compliance.

attributes.name: confidentiality_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provisions protecting proprietary information, trade secrets, technical specifications, and business data shared between parties. Defines confidential information, permitted uses, and disclosure restrictions.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the sales contract. Used for customer communication, legal reference, and cross-system tracking.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sales contract. Draft contracts are being prepared; pending approval contracts await internal or customer sign-off; active contracts are in force; suspended contracts are temporarily on hold; completed contracts have fulfilled all obligations; terminated contracts ended early by mutual agreement; cancelled contracts were voided before activation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|completed|terminated|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sales contract based on commercial structure. Standard contracts use pre-approved terms; custom contracts are negotiated; framework contracts establish terms for multiple orders; blanket contracts cover recurring purchases; spot contracts are one-time transactions; turnkey contracts include design, supply, and commissioning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales contract record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: customer_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative who signed the sales contract on behalf of the customer. Used for legal verification and audit trail.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Physical address or site where contracted products, systems, or equipment will be delivered. May reference customer facility, project site, or designated warehouse.

attributes.name: delivery_schedule
attributes.description: Detailed timeline and milestones for delivery of products, systems, or services under the sales contract. May include phased deliveries, installation schedules, and commissioning dates.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising from the sales contract. Litigation involves court proceedings; arbitration uses neutral arbitrators; mediation involves facilitated negotiation; negotiation is direct party-to-party resolution.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) or file path to the digitally stored executed sales contract document. Links to document management system or secure repository.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales contract becomes legally binding and enforceable. Marks the start of the contract period and triggers obligations for both parties.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales contract ends and obligations cease. Nullable for open-ended contracts or contracts with indefinite terms subject to termination clauses.

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provisions excusing non-performance due to unforeseeable events beyond parties control such as natural disasters, war, pandemics, or government actions. Defines qualifying events and relief procedures.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and body of law that governs the interpretation, enforcement, and dispute resolution of the sales contract. Typically specifies country and state/province.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and seller for delivery of goods. Examples: EXW (Ex Works), FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). attributes.name: insurance_requirements

attributes.name: intellectual_property_terms
attributes.description: Provisions defining ownership, licensing, and usage rights for intellectual property including patents, designs, software, documentation, and technical know-how. Specifies IP ownership and license grants.

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial liability amount that either party can be held responsible for under the sales contract. Limits exposure for damages, losses, or claims arising from contract performance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales contract record was last updated in the system. Part of audit trail for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: net_contract_value
attributes.description: Net monetary value of the sales contract after applying discounts, rebates, and before taxes. Represents the actual revenue to be recognized.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the sales contract. Used for internal communication and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity or deal that resulted in this executed contract. Links to CRM opportunity data for pipeline tracking and conversion analysis.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism through which the customer will remit payment. Wire transfer for electronic bank transfers; letter of credit for trade finance; bank guarantee for secured payments; check for paper-based payments; credit card for card payments; direct debit for automated withdrawals.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Detailed description of payment conditions including milestones, due dates, installment schedules, and payment triggers. Examples: Net 30, 50% upfront 50% on delivery, milestone-based payments.

attributes.name: penalty_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provisions defining financial penalties or liquidated damages for non-performance, late delivery, or breach of SLA commitments. Specifies penalty amounts, triggers, and caps.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal quotation or proposal that was accepted and converted into this sales contract. Links to quote master data for pricing and terms traceability.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Provisions governing automatic renewal, renewal options, or renegotiation terms at contract expiration. Defines renewal notice periods, pricing adjustments, and renewal conditions.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales contract was signed by both parties and became legally executed. May differ from effective date if contract has a future start date.

attributes.name: sla_resolution_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Time Hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which the supplier must resolve customer issues or restore service under the contract. Part of SLA commitments for uptime and availability.

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Time Hours

attributes.name: sla_response_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time Hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which the supplier must respond to customer service requests or incidents under the contract. Part of SLA commitments for support and maintenance.

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time Hours

attributes.name: sla_uptime_percentage
attributes.description: Guaranteed minimum uptime or availability percentage for systems, equipment, or services covered by the sales contract. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.5% uptime).

attributes.name: supplier_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative who signed the sales contract on behalf of the supplier. Used for legal verification and audit trail.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the sales contract. Includes VAT, GST, sales tax, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and product classification.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provisions defining conditions, notice periods, and procedures under which either party may terminate the sales contract. Includes termination for cause, convenience, or force majeure.

attributes.name: value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the sales contract representing the gross revenue commitment. Includes all line items, products, services, and deliverables before adjustments.

attributes.name: value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value. Defines the currency in which all financial terms, payments, and penalties are denominated.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for which the supplier provides warranty coverage for products, systems, or equipment delivered under the sales contract. Covers defects in materials and workmanship.

attributes.name: warranty_terms
attributes.description: Detailed description of warranty provisions including coverage scope, exclusions, repair or replacement terms, and customer obligations. Defines what is covered and what is not under warranty.

products.name: territory
products.description: Sales territory definition representing a geographic, industry-vertical, or account-based assignment used to organize the sales force for industrial automation and electrification markets. Captures territory code, region hierarchy (global/regional/local), assigned revenue quota, product line scope, and effective dates. Enables territory-based pipeline reporting and quota attainment tracking.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Primary key for territory

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales manager or territory owner responsible for this territory. Links to employee or user record in Salesforce or Workday HCM.

attributes.name: parent_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent territory in the hierarchical territory structure. Null for top-level territories.

attributes.name: account_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer accounts assigned to this territory. Used for territory balance and coverage analysis.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_quota
attributes.description: Target annual revenue quota assigned to this territory in the base currency. Used for quota attainment tracking and sales performance measurement.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for territory definition changes: draft (being edited), pending_approval (submitted for review), approved (finalized), or rejected (not approved).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the sales leader or executive who approved this territory definition. Used for governance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory definition was formally approved. Used for compliance and change tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_rule
attributes.description: Business rule or criteria used to assign accounts or opportunities to this territory (e.g., 'Postal codes 10000-19999', 'Annual revenue > $1M in automotive sector'). Free-text description of assignment logic.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the territory used in Salesforce Sales Cloud and reporting systems. Externally-known unique code.

attributes.name: commission_plan_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the commission or incentive compensation plan applicable to sales representatives in this territory. Links to compensation management system.

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes covered by this territory (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX' or 'DEU,AUT,CHE').

attributes.name: coverage_model
attributes.description: Sales coverage approach for this territory: direct (direct sales force), channel (partner/distributor), hybrid (combination), inside_sales (remote/phone), or field_sales (on-site visits).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the territory scope, strategic objectives, and special considerations. Provides context for territory planning and handoff.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this territory definition expires or is superseded. Null for currently active territories with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this territory definition becomes active and operational. Used for territory planning and historical tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which this territory definition and quota are applicable (e.g., 'FY2024', 'FY2025'). Enables year-over-year territory comparison.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic coverage (e.g., 'Germany, Austria, Switzerland', 'US Northeast Corridor', 'Asia-Pacific excluding China').

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: Target industry sector or vertical market for this territory (e.g., 'Automotive Manufacturing', 'Food & Beverage', 'Pharmaceuticals', 'Energy & Utilities'). Applicable when territory_type includes industry_vertical.

attributes.name: is_overlay_territory
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is an overlay territory (True) that operates across other territories for specialized products or services, or a standard exclusive territory (False).

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code for the primary business language in this territory (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'zh', 'es'). Used for localization and communication planning.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment for this territory: enterprise (large corporations), mid_market (medium businesses), smb (small business), oem (Original Equipment Manufacturer), government (public sector), or education (academic institutions).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory record was last modified. Used for change tracking and synchronization.

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the sales territory (e.g., 'North America Industrial Automation', 'EMEA Electrification Solutions').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about the territory, including special instructions, historical context, or strategic considerations. Used for knowledge transfer and planning.

attributes.name: overlay_type
attributes.description: Type of overlay territory if is_overlay_territory is True: product_specialist (specific product expertise), solution_architect (technical pre-sales), key_account (strategic account support), or none (not an overlay).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Strategic priority classification of the territory: strategic (top-tier), high (important growth area), medium (standard), low (maintenance), or emerging (new market development).

attributes.name: product_line_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product lines or families assigned to this territory (e.g., 'PLC,SCADA,HMI' or 'Electrification,Automation,Digitalization'). Defines which products the territory sales team is responsible for.

attributes.name: quota_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the revenue quota (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'CNY').

attributes.name: quota_period
attributes.description: Time period for quota measurement: annual (yearly), semi_annual (twice per year), quarterly (every quarter), or monthly.

attributes.name: region_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the territory within the organizational geography: global (worldwide), regional (multi-country), country (single nation), local (sub-national), district (city/metro), or zone (sub-district).

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel used in this territory: direct (company sales force), distributor (third-party distributor), reseller (value-added reseller), online (e-commerce), oem (embedded in OEM products), or system_integrator (SI partner).

attributes.name: sales_team_size
attributes.description: Number of sales representatives assigned to this territory. Used for capacity planning and workload distribution.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this territory in the source system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data integration.

attributes.name: territory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the territory: active (operational), inactive (not in use), pending (awaiting activation), suspended (temporarily disabled), archived (historical), or planned (future territory).

attributes.name: territory_type
attributes.description: Classification of territory assignment model: geographic (region-based), industry_vertical (sector-based), account_based (strategic accounts), product_line (product family focus), hybrid (combination), or named_account (specific customer assignment).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the territory (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/Berlin', 'Asia/Shanghai'). Used for scheduling and activity coordination.

products.name: territory_assignment
products.description: Association record linking a sales representative or sales team to a specific territory for a defined period. Captures assignment type (primary, overlay, product specialist), effective start and end dates, coverage role, assignment status, revenue allocation percentage, and reporting hierarchy override. Supports matrix sales organizations common in industrial automation where product specialists (e.g., drives expert, PLC specialist, building automation consultant) overlay geographic account managers. Enables territory-based pipeline attribution and split-credit deal tracking.

attributes.name: territory_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the territory assignment record. Primary key for the territory assignment entity.

attributes.name: primary_predecessor_assignment_territory_assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the previous territory assignment record that this assignment replaces. Used to track territory transition history and account handoff lineage. Nullable for initial assignments.

attributes.name: primary_territory_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales manager or team leader to whom this sales representative reports for this territory assignment. Supports matrix reporting structures where a specialist may report to a different manager than the primary account manager.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales territory being assigned. References the geographic or account-based territory definition.

attributes.name: territory_sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales representative or sales team member assigned to the territory. May reference individual contributor or team lead.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment was approved by management. Used for audit trail and effective date validation. Nullable for assignments not requiring approval.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for the territory assignment. Draft indicates in preparation; pending approval indicates submitted for review; approved indicates management authorization; rejected indicates denied assignment. Used in territory planning and governance.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, transition plans, account handoff details, or coverage agreements for this territory assignment. Used for knowledge transfer and audit trail.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this assignment when multiple representatives cover the same territory. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for opportunity routing and conflict resolution in matrix sales organizations.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for creating this territory assignment. New hire indicates onboarding; territory realignment indicates organizational restructuring; promotion indicates role change; backfill indicates replacement; expansion indicates market growth; specialization indicates product or vertical focus; temporary coverage indicates short-term assignment; leave replacement indicates coverage during absence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_hire|territory_realignment|promotion|backfill|expansion|specialization|temporary_coverage|leave_replacement — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignment_source
attributes.description: Origin of the territory assignment record. Manual indicates user-created; automated rule indicates system-generated based on assignment rules; territory model indicates derived from territory planning model; import indicates bulk data load; api indicates external system integration.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the territory assignment. Active indicates currently in effect; inactive indicates terminated; pending indicates future-dated assignment not yet effective; suspended indicates temporarily paused; expired indicates past end date.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment role. Primary indicates main account owner; overlay indicates supporting specialist; product specialist indicates domain expert (e.g., drives, PLC, building automation); technical specialist indicates pre-sales engineering support; inside sales indicates remote coverage; channel partner indicates indirect sales coverage.

attributes.name: assignment_version
attributes.description: Version number of the territory assignment record. Incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit history. Used in territory planning and governance.

attributes.name: commission_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is eligible for commission calculation. True for quota-carrying roles; false for support roles or salaried positions. Used in compensation processing.

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: Scope of coverage responsibility within the territory. Full indicates complete account coverage; partial indicates subset of accounts or opportunities; strategic accounts only indicates focus on key accounts; named accounts indicates specific account list; transactional indicates order processing only.

attributes.name: coverage_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the sales representative in this territory assignment. Account manager owns customer relationship; product specialist provides domain expertise (e.g., drives, automation, electrification); technical consultant provides pre-sales engineering; inside sales rep provides remote support; channel manager manages indirect partners; overlay specialist provides supplemental coverage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the territory assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment ends and coverage responsibility transfers. Nullable for open-ended assignments. Used for territory transition planning and historical pipeline attribution.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment becomes active and the sales representative begins coverage responsibility. Used for territory transition planning and historical pipeline attribution.

attributes.name: industry_vertical_focus
attributes.description: Industry vertical or market segment this assignment covers within the territory. Examples: automotive, food and beverage, pharmaceutical, oil and gas, water and wastewater, discrete manufacturing, process industries. Supports vertical specialist overlay model.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the territory assignment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: primary_assignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary assignment for the territory. True for the main account owner; false for overlay and specialist assignments. Used to determine default opportunity ownership and customer communication responsibility.

attributes.name: product_line_focus
attributes.description: Specific product line or solution area this assignment covers within the territory. Examples: drives and motors, programmable logic controllers (PLC), building automation, electrification products, industrial communication, motion control, process instrumentation. Supports product specialist overlay model common in industrial automation sales.

attributes.name: quota_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of territory quota assigned to this sales representative. Used for performance measurement and capacity planning. May differ from revenue allocation in overlay models where specialists receive credit but not quota burden.

attributes.name: revenue_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of territory revenue credited to this sales representative for quota and commission calculation. Supports split-credit scenarios in matrix sales organizations where multiple specialists support the same account. Sum of all assignments for a territory may exceed 100% in overlay models.

products.name: rep
products.description: Sales representative profile within the sales domain capturing commercial role, quota assignment, product line specialization (drives, PLCs, switchgear, building automation), territory alignment, and performance targets. Distinct from the workforce domain employee record — this is the sales-domain view of a seller including their book of business, commission plan reference, CRM user linkage, and sales hierarchy position (individual contributor, team lead, regional manager). Sourced from Salesforce User / Sales Cloud.

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Primary key for rep

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record in the workforce domain. Links the sales representative to their HR employee profile.

attributes.name: manager_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative record of this rep's direct manager in the sales hierarchy.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory assigned to this representative defining their geographic or account-based coverage area.

attributes.name: active_account_count
attributes.description: Number of active customer accounts currently assigned to and managed by this sales representative.

attributes.name: active_opportunity_count
attributes.description: Number of open sales opportunities currently in the representative's pipeline.

attributes.name: annual_quota_amount
attributes.description: Annual sales quota target assigned to the representative measured in base currency. Used for performance tracking and commission calculation.

attributes.name: book_of_business_value
attributes.description: Total annual recurring revenue or contract value of the customer accounts currently managed by this sales representative.

attributes.name: certification_list
attributes.description: Professional certifications held by the sales representative relevant to industrial automation and electrification sales, such as product certifications, technical sales training, or industry credentials.

attributes.name: rep_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code for the sales representative used in order entry, commission tracking, and reporting systems.

attributes.name: commission_plan_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the commission plan structure governing how this sales representative earns variable compensation based on sales performance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales representative record was first created in the sales system.

attributes.name: crm_user_code
attributes.description: Salesforce Sales Cloud user identifier linking this sales representative to their CRM login and activity tracking.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment that the sales representative primarily serves based on account size and strategic importance.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the sales representative used for customer communication and internal correspondence.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the sales representative as recorded in the sales system.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales representative was hired into the sales organization.

attributes.name: industry_vertical_focus
attributes.description: Target industry vertical or market segment that the sales representative focuses on, such as automotive, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, or infrastructure.

attributes.name: is_key_account_manager
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this sales representative is designated as a key account manager responsible for strategic, high-value customer relationships.

attributes.name: language_proficiency
attributes.description: Languages spoken by the sales representative relevant for customer communication and territory coverage, stored as comma-separated language codes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales representative record was most recently updated in the sales system.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review conducted for this sales representative.

attributes.name: last_training_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales training, product training, or professional development activity completed by the representative.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the sales representative used for field communication and urgent customer contact.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes capturing additional context about the sales representative's specializations, territory nuances, or other relevant information for sales operations.

attributes.name: onboarding_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales representative completed the formal onboarding and training program for new sales hires.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent performance evaluation rating for the sales representative based on quota attainment, customer satisfaction, and other Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the sales representative to be contacted by customers and internal stakeholders.

attributes.name: product_line_specialization
attributes.description: Primary product line or solution area that the sales representative specializes in, such as drives, PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), switchgear, building automation, or electrification systems.

attributes.name: quota_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the quota amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: quota_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current quota period for this sales representative.

attributes.name: quota_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current quota period for this sales representative, typically aligned with fiscal year or calendar year.

attributes.name: rep_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sales representative indicating their availability and eligibility for sales assignments.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel through which the representative conducts business: direct to end customer, through channel partners, distributors, or Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) relationships.

attributes.name: sales_office_location
attributes.description: Primary office location or branch where the sales representative is based for administrative and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: sales_role
attributes.description: Commercial role classification indicating the sales representative's position in the sales organization hierarchy.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales representative's employment or sales role ended. Null for active representatives.

attributes.name: travel_percentage
attributes.description: Expected percentage of work time spent traveling for customer visits, trade shows, and field sales activities.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of sales experience in industrial automation, electrification, or related technical sales roles.

products.name: quota
products.description: Sales quota record defining the revenue, volume, or margin target assigned to a sales representative, team, or territory for a specific period (monthly, quarterly, annual). Captures quota type (revenue, units, new logos), product line breakdown, base quota, stretch target, and attainment tracking. Supports commercial KPI reporting and incentive compensation management for industrial sales organizations.

attributes.name: quota_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales quota record. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_quota_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent quota in a hierarchical quota structure (e.g., a regional quota that rolls up to a global quota). Enables quota hierarchy navigation and rollup reporting.

attributes.name: primary_quota_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this quota record. Links to the user record for audit trail and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: primary_quota_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Quota has a free‑text territory field; adding quota_territory_id links quota to the territory hierarchy and eliminates the redundant string column.

attributes.name: quota_sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales representative, team, or territory to whom this quota is assigned. Links to the employee or organizational unit responsible for achieving the target.

attributes.name: tertiary_quota_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who most recently modified this quota record. Links to the user record for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net amount by which the base quota was adjusted after initial assignment. Positive values indicate quota increases; negative values indicate reductions. Used for variance analysis and compensation dispute resolution.

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the most recent quota adjustment. Used to track when changes were applied for accurate period-over-period performance comparison.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for any mid-period adjustments to the quota (e.g., territory realignment, market condition changes, organizational restructuring). Provides business context for quota modifications.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine this quota amount: top_down (corporate target cascaded down), bottom_up (aggregated from territory forecasts), hybrid (combination), historical (based on prior period performance), or market_based (derived from market opportunity analysis).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow state for this quota assignment: pending (awaiting management review), approved (confirmed and active), or rejected (not accepted, requires revision).

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date when this quota was formally approved by management. Used for audit trail and to track planning cycle timelines.

attributes.name: attainment_amount
attributes.description: The actual performance amount achieved against this quota as of the last calculation date. Updated periodically (daily, weekly, monthly) based on closed-won opportunities or booked orders.

attributes.name: attainment_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of base quota achieved, calculated as (attainment_amount / base_quota_amount) * 100. Key performance indicator (KPI) for sales performance dashboards and incentive compensation calculations.

attributes.name: base_quota_amount
attributes.description: The standard target amount assigned to the quota owner for the period. Represents the minimum performance expectation for full incentive payout.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN) representing the primary country for this quota assignment. Supports country-level performance analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quota record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and to track planning cycle execution timelines.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP) in which the quota amounts are denominated, enabling multi-currency quota management for global sales organizations.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) to which this quota applies, supporting quarterly performance tracking and incentive compensation cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this quota applies, enabling year-over-year performance analysis and annual planning alignment.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The target industry vertical or customer segment for this quota (e.g., Automotive, Energy, Pharmaceuticals, Infrastructure). Enables industry-focused quota planning and vertical market analysis.

attributes.name: is_team_quota
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this quota is assigned to a team (True) or an individual sales representative (False). Supports team-based incentive structures and collaborative selling models.

attributes.name: last_attainment_calculation_date
attributes.description: The date when the attainment amount and percentage were last recalculated. Indicates the freshness of performance metrics for reporting and compensation purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quota record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and data synchronization processes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or instructions related to this quota assignment (e.g., strategic account focus, product launch priorities, market entry considerations).

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the performance period for which this quota is effective. Defines the end of the measurement window.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the performance period for which this quota is effective. Defines the beginning of the measurement window.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The product line or business unit to which this quota applies (e.g., Automation Systems, Electrification Solutions, Smart Infrastructure). Enables product-specific quota allocation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: quota_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the quota record, typically following a pattern such as QTA-YYYYNNNN for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: quota_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the quota: draft (under review), active (in effect), suspended (temporarily paused), closed (period completed), or cancelled (no longer valid).

attributes.name: quota_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quota by measurement type: revenue (monetary sales target), units (volume target), margin (gross profit target), new logos (new customer acquisition target), bookings (order intake target), or pipeline (opportunity generation target).

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: The broader geographic region encompassing the territory (e.g., Americas, EMEA, APAC). Used for regional rollup reporting and executive dashboards.

attributes.name: remaining_amount
attributes.description: The gap between base quota and current attainment, calculated as (base_quota_amount - attainment_amount). Indicates the remaining target to achieve full quota for the period.

attributes.name: stretch_quota_amount
attributes.description: The aspirational target amount beyond the base quota, used to incentivize exceptional performance with accelerated commission rates or bonuses.

products.name: price_book
products.description: Commercial price book defining the standard or customer-specific list prices for industrial automation products, electrification solutions, and smart infrastructure components. Captures price book name, currency, effective date range, customer segment applicability, and whether it is the standard or a custom price book. Sourced from Salesforce CPQ Price Book. SSOT for sales-side pricing (distinct from product catalog cost data).
products.reference: Salesforce Price Book / CPQ Price Book

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price book record. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_price_book_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent or master price book from which this price book inherits base pricing. Null if this is a top-level price book.

attributes.name: primary_price_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or team responsible for maintaining and managing this price book.

attributes.name: tertiary_price_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this price book record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the price book was approved for use by authorized personnel.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether quotes or orders using this price book require management approval before finalization.

attributes.name: price_book_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the price book for system integration and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the specific country for which this price book applies. Null if applicable to multiple countries.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the price book record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all prices in this price book (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY).

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment or classification for which this price book is intended (e.g., 'Enterprise', 'SMB', 'OEM Partners', 'Distributors', 'Government').

attributes.name: price_book_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the price book purpose, scope, and applicability (e.g., 'Standard list prices for North America industrial automation products effective Q1 2024').

attributes.name: discount_policy
attributes.description: Reference to the discount policy or guidelines that govern allowable discounts from this price book (e.g., 'Standard 10% max', 'Volume-based tiered', 'No discounts allowed').

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the price book is no longer valid for new transactions. Null indicates no expiration date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the price book becomes valid and can be used for pricing sales transactions.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: Specific industry vertical or segment for which this price book is designed (e.g., 'Automotive Manufacturing', 'Food & Beverage', 'Pharmaceuticals', 'Energy & Utilities').

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the price book is currently active and available for selection in sales opportunities and quotes.

attributes.name: is_standard
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the standard (default) price book for the organization. Only one standard price book should be active at a time.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the price book record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: price_book_name
attributes.description: Business name of the price book (e.g., 'Standard Price Book', 'EMEA Industrial Automation 2024', 'OEM Partner Pricing').

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: price_book_type

products.name: price_book_entry

attributes.name: price_book_entry_id

attributes.name: primary_price_catalog_entry_id

attributes.name: primary_price_employee_id

attributes.name: tertiary_price_last_modified_by_employee_id

attributes.name: tertiary_price_product_catalog_entry_id

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: cost_price

attributes.name: created_date

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: customer_segment

attributes.name: price_book_entry_description

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: geography_code

attributes.name: is_active

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this price book entry record was last modified. Part of the standard audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: lead_time_days

attributes.name: list_price

attributes.name: market_segment

attributes.name: maximum_discount_percent

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity

attributes.name: minimum_price

attributes.name: price_book_entry_name
attributes.description: A descriptive name or label for this price book entry, typically combining product name, price book name, and currency for easy identification in reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: price_type

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the price (e.g., fixed, cost-plus, market-based, value-based). Supports pricing strategy analysis and governance.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: The product family or category to which this product belongs (e.g., Automation Controllers, Electrification Components, SCADA Systems). Used for reporting and segmentation.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The business product line or division responsible for this product (e.g., Industrial Automation, Building Technologies, Mobility Solutions).

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which this pricing is applicable (e.g., direct sales, distributor, partner, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), online).

attributes.name: tax_code

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: use_standard_price

products.name: forecast
products.description: Periodic sales forecast record capturing the committed, best-case, and pipeline revenue projections submitted by sales reps, managers, and regional leaders for a given forecast period. Tracks forecast category, submitted amount, manager-adjusted amount, product line breakdown, and variance to quota. Supports S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) and executive revenue visibility for industrial automation business units.

attributes.name: material_master_id

attributes.name: opportunity_id

attributes.name: previous_forecast_id

attributes.name: primary_forecast_territory_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Manager or executive who approved this forecast submission.

attributes.name: best_case_amount

attributes.name: forecast_category

attributes.name: closed_amount
attributes.description: Actual revenue from deals already closed and won during the forecast period.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: High-confidence revenue projection that the sales team commits to achieving.

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all forecast amounts.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: End date of the forecast period being projected.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter designation (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) for the forecast period.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for the forecast period.

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the forecast record, typically system-generated.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast record.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: Target industry vertical for the forecasted opportunities (e.g., Automotive, Energy, Pharmaceuticals).

attributes.name: is_latest_version
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the most current version of the forecast for this period and owner.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User who last modified this forecast record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast record was last updated.

attributes.name: manager_adjusted_amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount after manager review and adjustment, may differ from submitted amount based on pipeline scrutiny.

attributes.name: manager_notes
attributes.description: Commentary from the reviewing manager explaining adjustments or concerns.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary from the sales representative explaining assumptions, risks, or opportunities in the forecast.

attributes.name: opportunity_count
attributes.description: Number of opportunities included in this forecast submission.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Time granularity of the forecast period: monthly, quarterly, or annual.

attributes.name: pipeline_amount
attributes.description: Total pipeline revenue including early-stage opportunities with lower probability.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Primary product line or business unit for this forecast (e.g., Industrial Automation, Electrification, Smart Infrastructure).

attributes.name: quota_amount
attributes.description: Assigned sales quota target for the forecast owner during this period.

attributes.name: quota_attainment_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of quota achieved based on committed forecast amount.

attributes.name: region

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the forecast period being projected.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast was submitted by the sales representative or manager.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the forecast was submitted into the system.

attributes.name: submitted_amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount submitted by the sales representative for this forecast period and category.

attributes.name: variance_to_quota
attributes.description: Difference between committed forecast amount and quota target, can be positive or negative.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions to the forecast for the same period.

attributes.name: weighted_pipeline_amount
attributes.description: Pipeline amount adjusted by probability weighting based on opportunity stages.

products.name: channel_partner

attributes.name: partner_program_enrollment_date

products.name: order_intake
products.description: Sales order intake record capturing the commercial handoff from a won opportunity or accepted quote to the order management domain. Records the intake date, confirmed order value, customer PO reference, requested delivery date, payment terms confirmed, and handoff status. This is NOT the SSOT for order fulfillment data — the authoritative order record lives in the order domain. The sales domain retains this record solely for order intake KPI tracking, sales-to-fulfillment cycle time measurement, and booking recognition against quota.
products.reference: SAP SD Order Intake / Salesforce Closed-Won to Order

attributes.name: order_intake_id
attributes.description: Primary key for order_intake

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue allocation to cost center for cost accounting on each order intake (required for statutory cost reporting).

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account placing the order. Links to the master customer account record.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Order intake records the exact material to be delivered, linking to inventory for allocation and picking.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the won sales opportunity that generated this order intake. Links to the originating opportunity record in Salesforce Sales Cloud.

attributes.name: order_intake_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Order intake records a sales territory as text; adding order_intake_territory_id creates a proper FK to sales.territory and removes the ambiguous string column.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Order intake for equipment installation must reference the required permit to ensure legal installation and tracking.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability reporting per profit center for each order intake (used in profit analysis reports).

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer project or program this order is associated with. Used for project-based revenue tracking and multi-phase delivery coordination.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accepted quote that was converted into this order intake. May be null if order originated directly from opportunity without formal quote.

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master sales contract or framework agreement under which this order was placed. May be null for spot orders without framework agreement.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager who owns this order intake. Used for quota attainment and commission calculation.

attributes.name: sales_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales team responsible for this order. Used for team-based performance tracking and collaborative selling analytics.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Order intake processing must map incoming orders to the master product record for inventory allocation and production scheduling.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Order fulfillment planning requires assigning a primary supplier to each order intake for procurement scheduling and delivery coordination.

attributes.name: vendor_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_site. Business justification: Logistics tracking needs the specific supplier site fulfilling the order, enabling shipping, compliance, and performance reporting.

attributes.name: booking_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date when this order intake was recognized as a booking for quota and sales performance measurement. May differ from intake date based on validation rules.

attributes.name: booking_recognized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order intake has been recognized as a booking against sales quota. True when order meets booking recognition criteria per sales policy.

attributes.name: committed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date committed by sales to the customer. May differ from requested date based on production capacity and supply chain constraints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order intake record was first created. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when credit approval was granted for this order, if required. Null if order did not require credit approval or is still pending.

attributes.name: credit_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the customer credit check performed at order intake. Orders failing credit check may require advance payment or credit approval before handoff to fulfillment.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the order value. Essential for multi-currency sales operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: customer_po_date
attributes.description: The date on the customer's purchase order. Used for contract compliance verification and order validity checks.

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: The customer's purchase order reference number. Critical for order validation, invoicing, and customer reconciliation. May be required per customer contract terms.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: The customer's delivery address or site location for this order. May reference a customer site ID or contain full address details.

attributes.name: exchange_rate

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter

attributes.name: handoff_date

attributes.name: handoff_status

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The customer's industry segment or vertical market. Used for market analysis, sales territory planning, and industry-specific KPI tracking.

attributes.name: intake_date
attributes.description: The date when the order was officially received and recorded in the sales system. This is the booking date used for sales quota recognition and revenue pipeline tracking.

attributes.name: intake_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the order intake record. Human-readable unique number used for tracking and reference in sales reporting and KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: intake_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the order intake record was created in the system. Used for sales-to-fulfillment cycle time measurement and operational analytics.

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: order_value_base_currency

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days until payment is due per the agreed payment terms. Used for accounts receivable forecasting and working capital planning.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The primary product line or business unit for this order. Used for sales performance segmentation and product portfolio analysis.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The customer's requested delivery date as captured at order intake. Used for production planning coordination and customer expectation management.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: The agreed shipping or transportation method for order delivery. Impacts delivery lead time and logistics cost allocation. attributes.name: special_terms_conditions
attributes.description: Any special commercial terms, conditions, or customer-specific agreements applicable to this order. May include warranty extensions, service level commitments, or pricing exceptions.

attributes.name: created_by

domains.name: order
domains.description: Order management and fulfillment domain governing the end-to-end order lifecycle from customer purchase orders through production scheduling, shipment, and delivery confirmation. Manages order headers, line items, delivery schedules, RMAs, fulfillment SLAs, and customer order lifecycle via SAP SD.

products.name: order_header
products.description: Core master record for customer purchase orders representing the full order commitment in the order-to-cash lifecycle. Captures customer reference, order type (standard, rush, blanket, consignment), requested delivery date, incoterms, payment terms, pricing date, total net value, currency, sales organization, distribution channel, division, and overall order status. Serves as the SSOT for all customer order commitments in the industrial manufacturing order lifecycle, driving downstream delivery, billing, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: account_site_id

attributes.name: automation_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.automation_project. Business justification: Order‑Project Tracking links a sales order to the automation engineering project delivering the solution, needed for project budgeting and status reporting.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Links sales orders to the 'Contractual Compliance Obligation' record that defines mandatory regulatory actions the order must satisfy.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Overall order budgeting: assigning a sales order to a cost center supports order‑level expense allocation and budgeting reports.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer who placed the order.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Order processing uses a sold‑to contact for invoicing and communication; this contact is stored in customer.contact.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Project linkage: whole sales orders are tied to internal orders for project cost settlement and tracking.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Revenue attribution: linking orders to the originating sales opportunity enables pipeline‑to‑revenue reporting and commission calculations.

attributes.name: order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Order Management traceability: each order must reference the intake record that created it for audit and fulfillment reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue attribution: linking the order to a profit center enables consolidated profit‑and‑loss reporting per sales order.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Project Management Report requires linking each sales order to its implementation project for schedule and cost tracking.

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Contract compliance: orders are executed under a sales contract; linking ensures legal and pricing terms are enforced per order.

attributes.name: sales_rep_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Commission & performance reports require each sales order to be linked to the responsible sales rep employee.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Commission & accountability: each order is credited to the responsible sales rep, supporting commission payout and performance metrics.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Territory reporting: orders must be assigned to a sales territory for quota tracking, regional performance dashboards, and incentive calculations.

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Shipping logistics require a reference to the customer's shipping address; address data resides in customer.address.

attributes.name: supplier_id

products.name: line
products.description: Individual line item within a customer sales order representing a discrete product, automation system, or service being ordered. Captures material number, ordered and confirmed quantities, unit of measure, schedule line dates, net price, pricing conditions, plant assignment, storage location, delivery status, rejection reason, and blanket order release reference. attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost accounting: each sales order line must be charged to a cost center for internal cost reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Regulated products require batch traceability from order line to lot batch for quality, recall, and compliance management.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Order fulfillment requires linking each order line to the material master for inventory reservation, costing, and MRP planning; this is standard in manufacturing ERP systems.

attributes.name: order_header_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability tracking: linking order line revenue to a profit center enables margin reporting per product line.

attributes.name: quote_line_id

attributes.name: recipe_id

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id

attributes.name: serialized_unit_id

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Required for Order Fulfillment & Costing report linking each order line to the master product record for pricing, compliance, and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: spare_part_id

attributes.name: stock_location_id

attributes.name: supplier_id

domains.description: Billing and revenue domain serving as the SSOT for all customer invoices, billing cycles, payment processing, revenue recognition, credit management, collections, payment terms, accounts receivable, and billing dispute resolution across product sales, service contracts, and project-based engagements.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to a customer for product sales, service contracts, or project-based engagements. Captures invoice number, issue date, due date, billing period, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, currency, invoice status (draft, issued, partially_paid, paid, overdue, cancelled, disputed, written_off), invoice type (standard, credit_note, debit_note, proforma, self_billing), payment terms code, billing address, PO reference, contract reference, and source transaction reference. Serves as the SSOT for credit notes (returns, pricing corrections, quality disputes, volume rebate settlements) and debit notes (price adjustments, surcharges, underbilling corrections) via the invoice_type discriminator. Also supports self-billing/evaluated receipt settlement (ERS) for consignment and VMI arrangements. Managed in SAP S/4HANA SD/FI billing document types (VF01/VF04).
