domains.name: supplier
domains.description: Supplier relationship and performance management domain tracking supplier profiles, qualification status, scorecards, audit results, certifications, risk ratings, and long-term relationship data. Distinct from procurement transactions — this domain owns the supplier identity and master data used across procurement, quality, and supply chain.

products.name: supplier
products.description: Core master entity representing the authoritative supplier identity record (SSOT) for all vendors, sub-contractors, and raw material suppliers engaged by Manufacturing. Captures legal entity name, DUNS number, tax ID, SAP vendor master number (from SAP Ariba/S4HANA MM), business type (OEM, distributor, raw material, MRO), incorporation country, headquarters address, primary contact, preferred currency, payment terms, incoterms, and active status. This is the golden record used across procurement, quality, supply chain, and logistics domains.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1), SAP Ariba Supplier Profile

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Primary key for supplier

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PROCUREMENT: Assigns an internal account manager to each supplier for relationship management; required for supplier performance dashboards and contract negotiations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for allocating supplier spend to internal cost centers (Procurement Cost Allocation Report).

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Default GL account for posting supplier invoices (AP posting rules).

attributes.name: business_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supplier based on the type of goods or services provided. OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) supplies finished components, distributor resells products, raw_material provides base materials, MRO (Maintenance Repair Operations) supplies consumables, subcontractor provides manufacturing services, service_provider delivers non-manufacturing services.

attributes.name: supplier_category
attributes.description: Strategic classification indicating the supplier's relationship tier and procurement priority. Strategic suppliers are critical long-term partners, preferred suppliers have favorable terms, approved suppliers meet minimum standards, conditional suppliers are under review, blocked suppliers are prohibited from new business.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and master data governance.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to identify business entities globally. Used for supplier credit checks, risk assessment, and compliance verification.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the supplier's corporate headquarters. Used for legal correspondence, audit notices, and official communications.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or floor information at the supplier's headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the supplier's headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the supplier's headquarters location. May differ from incorporation country for multinational organizations.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the supplier's headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region for the supplier's headquarters address.

attributes.name: incorporation_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the supplier is legally incorporated and registered. Used for trade compliance, tax jurisdiction, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard three-letter Incoterms code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller in international trade (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Published by International Chamber of Commerce. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: iso14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds valid ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. True if certified, False if not certified or certification expired.

attributes.name: iso45001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds valid ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. True if certified, False if not certified or certification expired.

attributes.name: iso9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds valid ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. True if certified, False if not certified or certification expired.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier audit conducted by Manufacturing's quality or procurement team. Used to track audit frequency and schedule next audit per supplier management policy.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this supplier master record. Used for change accountability, audit trails, and data governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier master record was last updated. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_scorecard_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier scorecard evaluation. Scorecards typically assess quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness on a quarterly or annual basis.

attributes.name: minority_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise. Used for diversity supplier programs and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier audit based on risk rating, performance, and audit frequency policy. Used for audit planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the requested delivery date over the evaluation period. Key performance indicator (KPI) for supplier scorecard and performance management. Expressed as percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: overall_scorecard_rating
attributes.description: Composite supplier performance score from the most recent scorecard evaluation, typically on a scale of 0.0 to 10.0 or 0.0 to 100.0. Aggregates quality, delivery, cost, and service metrics into a single performance indicator.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines the payment due date and any early payment discounts available.

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the supplier's preferred currency for invoicing and payment transactions (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary supplier contact for business communications, purchase orders, and quality notifications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the supplier organization for procurement, quality, and supply chain coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number for the primary supplier contact including country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Quality and compliance qualification status indicating whether the supplier has passed required audits, certifications, and capability assessments. Qualified suppliers meet all requirements, conditional suppliers have minor gaps, not_qualified suppliers failed assessment, under_review suppliers are being evaluated.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of received materials that passed incoming quality inspection without rejection or rework over the evaluation period. Key performance indicator (KPI) for supplier quality performance. Expressed as percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this supplier was terminated or the vendor record was deactivated. Null for active suppliers. Used for supplier lifecycle tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this supplier was established and the vendor record was first activated. Used for relationship tenure analysis and supplier lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment for the supplier based on financial stability, geopolitical factors, quality performance, delivery reliability, and compliance history. Used for supply chain risk management and contingency planning.

attributes.name: sap_vendor_number
attributes.description: Vendor master number from SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management) or SAP Ariba. This is the authoritative supplier identifier in the ERP system used for procurement transactions.

attributes.name: small_business
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier qualifies as a small business based on revenue, employee count, or regulatory definitions. Used for small business procurement programs and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supplier relationship. Active suppliers are approved for procurement, inactive suppliers are no longer used, suspended suppliers are temporarily restricted, pending_approval suppliers are under qualification review, blocked suppliers are prohibited from new transactions.

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the supplier (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in India). Used for tax reporting, invoice validation, and compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code assigned to the supplier for identification across procurement, quality, and supply chain systems. Often synchronized with SAP vendor master number.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the supplier organization as registered with incorporation authorities. Used for contracts, purchase orders, and legal documentation.

attributes.name: woman_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a woman-owned business enterprise. Used for diversity supplier programs and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this supplier master record. Used for accountability, audit trails, and data governance.

products.name: site
products.description: Represents a specific physical manufacturing, warehouse, or service site belonging to a vendor. A single vendor legal entity may operate multiple sites with distinct capabilities, certifications, and risk profiles. Captures site address, site type (manufacturing, distribution, R&D), production capacity, geographic region, ISO certification scope, and site-level contact. Used by procurement and quality to route sourcing decisions to the correct facility.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Supplier Site, ISO 9001 Site Scope

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Primary key for site

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Site‑specific cost allocation for production capacity spend (Site Cost Allocation process).

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SITE PERFORMANCE: Links a responsible procurement employee to each supplier site; used in site audit scheduling and capacity monitoring reports.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor legal entity that owns this site. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor site became active and eligible for procurement transactions.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor site was deactivated or disqualified. Null for currently active sites.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the vendor site facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building, suite, or floor number. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: approved_for_new_business
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site is approved to receive new purchase orders and sourcing awards.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the production capacity metric such as units, tons, liters, or square meters.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the primary quality management certification expires. Used to trigger recertification workflows.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the vendor site is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the vendor site. Used for procurement routing and supplier qualification tracking.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor site location. Used for trade compliance, tariff calculation, and regional risk assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor site record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for transactions with this vendor site.

attributes.name: delivery_performance_score
attributes.description: On-time delivery performance score for the vendor site. Scale 0-100.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun and Bradstreet Universal Numbering System identifier for the vendor site. Used for credit assessment and supplier verification.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Macro-geographic region classification for supply chain planning and regional sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: iatf_16949_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds IATF 16949 automotive quality management certification. Required for automotive supply chain participation.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Critical for supplier qualification.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality or compliance audit conducted at the vendor site.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor site record was last updated.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the vendor site. Used for logistics optimization and distance calculations.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from purchase order placement to delivery for this vendor site.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the vendor site. Used for logistics optimization and distance calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the vendor site for purchase orders.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity such as pieces, kilograms, or pallets.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation of the vendor site facility.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next quality or compliance audit at the vendor site.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or site-specific considerations relevant to procurement and quality teams.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms applicable to this vendor site such as Net 30, Net 60, or 2/10 Net 30.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the vendor site address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor site has preferred supplier status for strategic sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary site contact. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the vendor site for procurement and quality coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor site contact. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: production_capacity_annual
attributes.description: Annual production capacity of the site in units relevant to the site type. Used for capacity planning and sourcing allocation decisions.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Composite quality performance score for the vendor site based on defect rates, audit results, and corrective action responsiveness. Scale 0-100.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk classification of the vendor site based on quality performance, financial stability, geopolitical factors, and compliance history.

attributes.name: site_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor site. Controls whether the site is eligible for new purchase orders and sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor site by primary function. Determines sourcing eligibility and capability matching.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the vendor site. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Tax identification or VAT registration number for the vendor site. Used for tax compliance and invoice validation.

products.name: supplier_contact
products.description: Tracks individual contacts associated with a vendor organization, including account managers, quality engineers, logistics coordinators, and executive sponsors. Captures full name, job title, department, email, phone, preferred language, contact role (commercial, technical, quality, logistics), and active status. Supports multi-threaded supplier relationship management across procurement, quality, and after-sales functions.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Contact Management, Salesforce Account Contact

attributes.name: supplier_contact_id
attributes.description: Primary key for contact

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor organization this contact belongs to. Links to the supplier master record.

attributes.name: certification_held
attributes.description: Professional certifications or qualifications held by the contact relevant to their role (e.g., Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, ISO Lead Auditor, APICS CPIM). Multiple certifications separated by semicolon.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method of communication for reaching this contact for routine supplier relationship activities.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Primary functional role of the contact in the supplier relationship. Determines routing of communications and escalations.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact. Inactive or terminated contacts should not receive communications.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact based on their priority and purpose in the supplier relationship hierarchy.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person who created this vendor contact record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Department or functional area within the vendor organization where the contact works (e.g., Sales, Quality Assurance, Logistics, Engineering, Customer Service).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact ceased to be active or left the vendor organization. Null for currently active contacts.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact became active and available for supplier relationship management activities.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the vendor contact. Used for procurement communications, quality notifications, and supply chain coordination.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Numeric escalation tier for this contact in the supplier relationship hierarchy. Level 1 is first point of contact, higher numbers represent management escalation paths.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: First name or given name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Complete name of the vendor contact person, typically concatenation of first and last name.

attributes.name: interaction_frequency_days
attributes.description: Target frequency in days for regular business interactions with this contact. Used for relationship management planning and alerts.

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this contact has decision-making authority for commercial negotiations, contract approvals, or strategic supplier relationship matters.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the vendor organization. Only one primary contact should exist per vendor.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the vendor contact within their organization (e.g., Account Manager, Quality Engineer, Logistics Coordinator, Sales Director).

attributes.name: last_interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent business interaction or communication with this contact. Used for relationship health monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person who most recently modified this vendor contact record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor contact record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Last name or family name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: linkedin_profile_url
attributes.description: URL to the contacts LinkedIn professional profile. Used for relationship intelligence and network mapping.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the vendor contact. Used for urgent supply chain escalations and on-call support.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and observations about the contact, including communication preferences, relationship history, special considerations, or other relevant context for supplier relationship management.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Physical office location or site where the contact is based (e.g., headquarters, regional office, manufacturing plant).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor contact. Includes country code and extension where applicable.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code representing the contacts preferred language for business communications (e.g., ENG, DEU, FRA, SPA, CHI, JPN).

attributes.name: relationship_strength_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100) representing the strength and quality of the business relationship with this contact. Based on interaction frequency, responsiveness, collaboration quality, and business outcomes.

attributes.name: specialization_area
attributes.description: Specific area of expertise or specialization for the contact (e.g., electrification products, automation systems, quality management, supply chain logistics, contract negotiation).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contacts primary work location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Berlin, Asia/Shanghai). Used for scheduling meetings and coordinating real-time communications.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of professional experience the contact has in their field or industry. Used for relationship quality assessment.

products.name: qualification
products.description: Records the formal supplier qualification lifecycle for each vendor, tracking whether a vendor has been approved or disqualified for specific commodity categories or part families. Captures qualification status (prospective, under evaluation, approved, conditional, disqualified), qualification type (new supplier, re-qualification, commodity extension, disqualification), evaluation start/end dates, approving engineer, qualification basis (PPAP, APQP, audit, sample approval), expiry date, and for disqualification events: disqualification reason, affected commodities, transition plan reference, and re-qualification eligibility. Managed in SAP Ariba and aligned with PPAP/APQP standards.
products.reference: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process), APQP, SAP Ariba Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_qualification_approving_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier being qualified. Links to the supplier master data entity.

attributes.name: tertiary_qualification_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified the qualification record, captured for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: affected_commodities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of commodity categories affected by a disqualification event. Null if not disqualified or if disqualification is global.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier was formally approved for the specified scope. Null if not yet approved or if disqualified.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date when the on-site or remote supplier audit was conducted as part of the qualification process. Null if no audit was performed.

attributes.name: audit_score

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Critical for triggering renewal workflows and procurement gating decisions.

attributes.name: gated_commodity_categories
attributes.description: A comma-separated list of commodity categories or material groups for which this certification is mandatory. Procurement of these commodities from this supplier is blocked if the certification is not active and valid.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic regions, countries, or markets where this certification is recognized and valid. Examples include USA, EU, China, or Global. Uses 3-letter ISO country codes where applicable.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued by the certifying body. Represents the start of the certification validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: The name of the certification body, registrar, or regulatory authority that issued the certification. Examples include TUV, BSI, DNV, SGS, UL, Intertek, Bureau Veritas, LRQA, or government agencies.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent surveillance audit or recertification audit conducted by the certifying body to verify ongoing compliance with the certification standard.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that most recently modified this certification record. Audit trail field for accountability and data lineage.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was most recently modified. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: major_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: The number of major non-conformances identified during the most recent audit. Major non-conformances are serious violations that can lead to certification suspension or revocation.

attributes.name: minor_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: The number of minor non-conformances identified during the most recent audit. Minor non-conformances are less serious violations that require corrective action but do not immediately threaten certification status.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next surveillance audit or recertification audit. Used for planning and ensuring continuous compliance.

attributes.name: nonconformance_count
attributes.description: The total number of non-conformances (major and minor) identified during the most recent audit. Used to assess the supplier's compliance maturity and risk level.

attributes.name: procurement_gate_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is used to gate procurement decisions. True if suppliers without valid certification in this standard cannot be selected for certain commodity categories. False if the certification is informational only.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the certification renewal process must be completed to avoid expiration. Typically occurs before the expiry date to allow for processing time.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: The current status of the certification renewal process. Not due indicates renewal is not yet required. Renewal initiated indicates the renewal process has started. Renewal in progress indicates active renewal activities. Renewal completed indicates successful renewal. Renewal overdue indicates the renewal deadline has passed.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The risk level associated with this certification based on its status, expiry proximity, audit findings, and business criticality. Low indicates minimal risk. Medium indicates moderate risk requiring monitoring. High indicates significant risk requiring action. Critical indicates immediate risk requiring urgent intervention.

attributes.name: scope_of_certification
attributes.description: A detailed description of the scope, activities, products, services, or processes covered by this certification. Defines the boundaries and applicability of the certification within the supplier's operations.

attributes.name: standard
attributes.description: The regulatory, quality, or industry standard that this certification represents. Examples include ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 50001 (Energy Management), IEC 62443 (Industrial Cybersecurity), IATF 16949 (Automotive Quality), AS9100 (Aerospace Quality), UL (Product Safety), CE Marking (European Conformity), RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances), and REACH (Chemical Safety). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISO 9001|ISO 14001|ISO 45001|ISO 50001|IEC 62443|IATF 16949|AS9100|UL|CE Marking|RoHS|REACH|ISO 27001|ISO 13485|OHSAS 18001 — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified by internal quality assurance or procurement teams. Verification includes confirming the certificate is authentic, current, and matches the supplier's claims.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the certification. Document review indicates verification by examining the certificate document. Certifying body confirmation indicates direct verification with the issuing body. On-site inspection indicates physical verification during a supplier visit. Third-party verification indicates verification by an external auditor. Supplier declaration indicates acceptance of supplier-provided documentation without independent verification.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the internal employee or quality assurance team member who verified the authenticity and validity of this certification with the issuing body.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this certification record. Audit trail field for accountability and data lineage.

products.name: risk_rating
products.description: Periodic supplier risk assessment record capturing multi-dimensional risk exposure for a vendor across financial (D&B rating, credit score, liquidity), geopolitical (country risk, sanctions, trade restrictions), operational (single-source dependency, capacity utilization, lead time volatility), quality (PPM trends, audit history, certification gaps), cybersecurity (IEC 62443 maturity, incident history), and ESG (environmental compliance, labor practices, conflict minerals) dimensions. Stores overall risk tier (critical, high, medium, low), individual dimension scores, risk assessment date, assessment methodology (quantitative model, qualitative review, third-party feed), data sources (Dun & Bradstreet, RapidRatings, EcoVadis, internal), key risk drivers, mitigation actions in place, residual risk level, and next review date. Feeds supply chain risk management, business continuity planning, and dual-sourcing trigger decisions.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Risk Management, ISO 31000 Risk Management

products.name: approved_vendor_list
products.description: The Approved Vendor List (AVL) entry linking a qualified vendor to a specific commodity category, material group, or part family for which they are authorized to supply. Captures AVL status (active, suspended, phased-out), commodity code, material group, preferred/backup designation, MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity), lead time, geographic supply region, and approval date. products.name: development_plan
products.description: Formal supplier improvement action record serving as the single source of truth for ALL supplier-facing improvement interventions — both proactive development plans and reactive Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs/8D). Captures action type (performance improvement plan, capability development, quality remediation, SCAR, preventive action, cost reduction initiative), severity/priority, plan start/end dates, target KPIs, root cause analysis method (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa, fault tree), containment action, permanent corrective action, preventive action, SCAR reference number, issue type (quality escape, delivery failure, audit finding, process non-conformance), assigned development engineer, milestone schedule, verification method, current status (open, in-progress, verification pending, closed effective, closed ineffective), and closure outcome. Linked to scorecard deficiencies, audit findings, and quality escapes that triggered the action. Provides unified tracking replacing separate SCAR and development plan workflows — all supplier-facing corrective actions are managed here.
products.reference: Supplier Development Program, AIAG Supplier Development

products.name: supplier_onboarding

attributes.description: Maximum monetary value covered by the agreement, expressed in the specified currency.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the agreement record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version of the agreement document (incremented on each amendment).

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Purchasing and sourcing domain managing purchase requisitions, RFQs, RFPs, purchase orders, vendor selection, contract management, supplier performance evaluation, sourcing strategy, spend analysis, and procurement compliance for direct materials, indirect materials, MRO supplies, and capital equipment via SAP Ariba.

products.name: purchase_requisition
products.description: Master record for internal purchase requisition (PR) initiated by a department or MRP run. Captures the request for direct materials, indirect materials, MRO supplies, or capital equipment before a purchase order is raised. Tracks requestor, cost center, required delivery date, material/service description, estimated value, approval status, and sourcing assignment. Serves as the originating document in the procure-to-pay cycle.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Primary key for purchase_requisition

attributes.name: account_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account_site. Business justification: REQUIRED: Internal requisitions are raised for a specific plant/site; linking enables site‑wise spend analysis.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the approval workflow instance assigned to this requisition. Tracks the multi-level approval process based on value thresholds and organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Engineering Change Request triggers a purchase requisition for the affected component; linking enables traceability of component‑driven procurement.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Requisition budgeting and approval allocate planned spend to a cost center, essential for budget control.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.demand_forecast. Business justification: Demand forecasts drive requisitions; the relationship is needed for the 'Forecast‑Driven Requisition' analysis.

attributes.name: eco_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.eco. Business justification: Procurement requisitions are generated from Engineering Change Orders; linking provides audit of ECO‑driven spend.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: CAPITAL ACQUISITION: Requisition must reference the equipment record for traceability of requested capital assets.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Requisition may be tied to a GL account for expense planning and forecast alignment.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material or item being requested. Links to the material master data in SAP MM or inventory management system. Null for service or non-stock requisitions.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.mrp_run. Business justification: MRP run creates purchase requisitions; the MRP run ID is required for the 'MRP Run to Requisition' traceability report.

attributes.name: planned_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.planned_order. Business justification: Planned orders are converted to purchase requisitions; linking them enables the 'Planned Order Conversion' audit.

attributes.name: primary_purchase_requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who initiated the purchase requisition. Links to the workforce or employee master data.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the existing contract or blanket purchase order against which this requisition should be fulfilled. Null for non-contract purchases.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Project budgeting & cost tracking require each requisition to be tied to its project header; the project_code field is denormalized and replaced by a proper FK.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Requisition approval checks material compliance against applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., hazardous substance rules).

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.request. Business justification: Service Management 'Parts Requisition' process records the originating service request ID on each purchase requisition for traceability.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Required for the 'Component Procurement Planning' report linking requisitions to the final product SKU they support, enabling traceability from requisition to product.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: REQUIRED: Requisition planning specifies target storage location for incoming material; needed for inbound logistics allocation and warehouse capacity reports.

attributes.name: supplier_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_contact. Business justification: Needed for Supplier Relationship Management process: requisition records the primary supplier contact for communication and escalation.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred or suggested supplier for this requisition. Links to the supplier master data. Null if no preference specified.

attributes.name: tertiary_purchase_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the purchase requisition. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: approval_level_required
attributes.description: Number of approval levels required for this requisition based on value thresholds and organizational policy. Higher values require more senior approvals.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition received final approval and became ready for sourcing. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition requires special compliance review (e.g., environmental, safety, export control). True if compliance review is required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase requisition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency procurement and financial reporting.

attributes.name: estimated_total_value
attributes.description: Total estimated value of the purchase requisition (quantity × estimated unit price). Used for budget control and approval routing.

attributes.name: estimated_unit_price
attributes.description: Estimated price per unit of the requested material or service. Used for budget estimation and approval thresholds. Actual price is determined during sourcing and PO creation.

attributes.name: justification_notes
attributes.description: Business justification or rationale provided by the requestor for the purchase. Required for high-value or non-standard requisitions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase requisition record was last updated. Tracks changes throughout the approval and sourcing lifecycle.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: MRP controller responsible for material planning and requisition generation for production materials. Used for MRP-driven procurement.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility where the material or service is required. Used for delivery planning and inventory allocation in SAP PP.

attributes.name: po_created_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase order was created from this requisition. Marks the transition from requisition to order in the procure-to-pay cycle.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number generated from this requisition after sourcing and supplier selection. Null if PO not yet created.

attributes.name: pr_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was created or submitted. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the requisition initiation.

attributes.name: pr_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchase requisition, externally visible and used in procurement workflows. Typically system-generated in SAP Ariba or SAP MM.

attributes.name: pr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase requisition in the procure-to-pay workflow. Tracks progression from draft through approval, sourcing, and conversion to purchase order. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|pending_approval|approved|rejected|sourcing_assigned|po_created|cancelled|closed — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pr_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase requisition based on the nature of the procurement: direct materials for production, indirect materials for operations, MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) supplies, capital equipment (CapEx), services, or subcontracting work.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority level of the purchase requisition. Urgent and emergency priorities expedite approval and sourcing processes.

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing group or buyer responsible for sourcing this requisition. Used for workload distribution and supplier relationship management.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing organization responsible for procurement activities. Defines the organizational unit for supplier contracts and purchase orders.

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Quantity of the material or service being requested. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in the UOM field.

attributes.name: rejected_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was rejected by an approver. Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the approver for rejecting the purchase requisition. Used for audit trail and process improvement.

attributes.name: requestor_department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit of the requestor. Used for spend analysis and budget allocation tracking.

attributes.name: requestor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who created the purchase requisition. Captured for audit trail and approval workflow visibility.

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested materials, supplies, or services must be delivered to meet operational or production requirements. Used for MRP (Material Requirements Planning) scheduling and supplier lead time calculation.

attributes.name: source_determination_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates how the supplier source should be determined: automatic sourcing via system rules, manual buyer selection, contract-based assignment, or preferred supplier list.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the requested quantity. Standard units include EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter), HR (hour), etc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|HR|SET|BOX|ROLL|SHEET — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Core transactional document representing a legally binding purchase order (PO) issued to a supplier. Captures PO number, supplier, plant/delivery location, payment terms, incoterms, total PO value, currency, PO type (standard, blanket, framework, subcontracting), approval status, and confirmation status. Central document in the procure-to-pay process linking requisitions to goods receipts and supplier invoices.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the purchase order record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account_site. Business justification: REQUIRED: PO delivery planning tracks which customer site receives purchased goods; used in site‑level inventory and cost reports.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: REQUIRED: Drop‑ship to customer needs PO delivery address for logistics and billing reports.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.bom. Business justification: Purchase orders are raised against a specific BOM for a production run; linking supports BOM‑to‑PO cost tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: PO posting requires cost center for internal accounting; mandatory for cost allocation reports.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each PO expense is posted to a GL account for financial statements; required by accounting standards.

attributes.name: material_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_requirement. Business justification: Purchase orders are issued to satisfy material requirements; the link supports the 'Material Requirement Fulfilment' KPI.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Required for Make‑to‑Order production planning; links each purchase order to the sales order it fulfills, enabling the Order‑to‑Procure fulfillment report.

attributes.name: primary_purchase_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who created and is responsible for this purchase order.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project or capital investment program to which this purchase order is allocated.

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who originated the purchase requisition leading to this purchase order.

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase requisition that triggered this purchase order.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RFQ or RFP that preceded this purchase order in the sourcing process.

attributes.name: sales_order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Each purchase order fulfills a specific sales order intake; linking enables end‑to‑end order‑to‑procurement tracking.

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_contract. Business justification: Purchase orders for service work are issued under a specific service contract, enabling contract‑based billing and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Needed for 'Order‑Driven Procurement' process where purchase orders are tied to the specific product SKU being manufactured, supporting make‑to‑order execution.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific delivery address or warehouse location for goods receipt.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor to whom this purchase order is issued.

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.plan. Business justification: Supply plans dictate purchase order creation; linking PO to supply_plan enables the 'Supply Plan Execution' report.

attributes.name: vendor_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_site. Business justification: Required for Logistics Planning Report: PO must reference the exact supplier site delivering goods, enabling site‑specific lead‑time and cost calculations.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier acknowledged the purchase order.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the supplier has acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the purchase order.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase order received final approval.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for the purchase order.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase order was administratively closed after all goods were received and invoices processed.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Financial accounting organizational unit representing the legal entity for this purchase order.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the purchase order meets all applicable procurement compliance policies and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date confirmed by the supplier for delivery of goods or completion of services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the purchase order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this purchase order.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_status
attributes.description: Status indicating the extent to which ordered goods have been received against this purchase order.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, insurance, and risk transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms agreement where risk and cost transfer occurs.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_status
attributes.description: Status indicating the extent to which supplier invoices have been received and matched against this purchase order.

attributes.name: material_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the type of materials or services being procured. Direct materials are used in production, indirect materials support operations, MRO is maintenance/repair/operations supplies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the purchase order record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_po_value
attributes.description: Net total value of the purchase order after taxes and all adjustments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special requirements, or comments related to the purchase order.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Code representing the agreed payment terms with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase order was created and issued to the supplier. Principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the purchase order. Used in supplier communications and invoice matching.

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order in the procure-to-pay workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|issued|acknowledged|in_progress|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order type. Standard for one-time orders, blanket for recurring orders with release schedules, framework for long-term agreements, subcontracting for external processing, consignment for supplier-owned inventory.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the purchase order affecting processing and delivery urgency.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the buyer or procurement team responsible for this purchase order.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Represents the legal entity negotiating with suppliers.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the buyer requests delivery of goods or completion of services.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Mode of transportation specified for delivery of goods.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to this purchase order.

attributes.name: total_po_value
attributes.description: Total gross value of the purchase order including all line items before taxes and charges.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work breakdown structure element for project-based purchase orders, enabling cost tracking at the project task level.

products.name: po_line_item
products.description: Individual line item within a purchase order representing a specific material, service, or SKU being procured. Captures line number, material number, short text, quantity ordered, unit of measure, net price, delivery date, storage location, account assignment (cost center, WBS element, asset), and goods receipt indicator. Enables granular spend tracking, partial delivery management, and three-way match at the item level.

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for the po_line_item product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Line‑item expense allocation to cost center enables detailed cost reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: device_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.device_registry. Business justification: EQUIPMENT LINE ITEM: Each PO line for a device (PLC, sensor) maps to a specific device registry entry for configuration management.

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.bom_line. Business justification: Order line items are derived from BOM lines during material planning; linking enables line‑level reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Line‑item posting to GL account is required for accurate expense classification in the general ledger.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Ensures traceability of each PO line to the specific sales order line it supplies, essential for the Order‑to‑Purchase line reconciliation process.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record being procured. Links to the specific product, component, or service being ordered.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order header. Links this line item to its containing purchase order document.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: REQUIRED: Line item defines where received material will be stored; required for put‑away execution and inventory valuation per location.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: Line‑item costs must be allocated to a WBS element for earned‑value and cost‑control reporting; the existing wbs_element string is replaced by a FK.

attributes.name: account_assignment_category
attributes.description: Classification determining how procurement costs are allocated in financial accounting (e.g., to cost center, asset, WBS element, or sales order).

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement professional responsible for sourcing and managing this purchase order line item.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line item record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the net price and line item value (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating this line item has been marked for deletion or cancellation. Prevents further goods receipt and invoice posting.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Requested or committed delivery date for this line item. Used for MRP planning, production scheduling, and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: final_invoice_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the final invoice has been received and no further invoices are expected for this line item.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether goods receipt is required for this line item. Determines three-way match requirements for invoice verification.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standardized trade terms defining responsibilities for shipping, insurance, and risk transfer (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP).

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause where risk and cost transfer occurs.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice verification is required for this line item. Controls accounts payable processing workflow.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement item type. Determines procurement processing rules, inventory treatment, and account assignment requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line item record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order line item. Tracks progression from open through receipt to closure.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer part number for the material. Used for quality assurance and technical specification verification.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material being procured. The externally-known SKU or part number used in procurement documents and supplier communication.

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Total value of this line item calculated as (quantity_ordered / price_unit) * net_price. Excludes taxes and freight charges.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: The negotiated price per unit of measure before taxes and additional charges. Used to calculate line item total value.

attributes.name: open_quantity
attributes.description: Outstanding quantity still to be delivered, calculated as quantity_ordered minus quantity_received. Used for supplier follow-up and expediting.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage by which the supplier may over-deliver beyond the ordered quantity without requiring approval.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or facility where the material will be received and consumed. Determines receiving location and inventory posting.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: The quantity for which the net price is valid (e.g., price per 1, per 100, per 1000 units). Used in unit price calculation.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether incoming quality inspection is mandatory before goods receipt posting for this line item.

attributes.name: quantity_invoiced
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity invoiced by the supplier against this line item to date. Used for invoice verification and payment processing.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: The quantity of material or service units being procured on this line item. Used for goods receipt matching and invoice verification.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of goods received against this line item to date. Used for partial delivery tracking and open quantity calculation.

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or department that originated the purchase requisition leading to this line item.

attributes.name: shipping_instruction
attributes.description: Special instructions for packaging, labeling, or delivery requirements specific to this line item.

attributes.name: short_text
attributes.description: Brief description of the material or service being procured on this line. Provides human-readable context for the line item.

attributes.name: source_of_supply
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement source type. Determines procurement processing logic and inventory valuation method.

attributes.name: supplier_material_number
attributes.description: The suppliers own part number or SKU for the material being procured. Used for supplier communication and catalog matching.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount calculated for this line item based on tax code and net order value.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining applicable tax rates and tax jurisdiction for this procurement line item.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage by which the supplier may under-deliver below the ordered quantity without penalty or rejection.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the ordered quantity is expressed (e.g., EA, KG, M, L, HR). Must align with material master and supplier agreement.

products.name: rfq
products.description: Request for Quotation document issued to one or more suppliers to solicit competitive pricing for materials, services, or capital equipment. Captures RFQ number, sourcing event type, commodity category, submission deadline, evaluation criteria, invited supplier list, bid bond requirements, and status. Supports competitive sourcing and strategic procurement decisions for direct and indirect categories.
products.reference: SAP Ariba RFQ / SAP MM Request for Quotation (EKKO type AN)

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the request for quotation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: buyer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: RFQ process assigns a buyer employee responsible for the event; tracking this employee is required for RFQ ownership reports and compliance.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal business unit, plant, or legal entity issuing the RFQ. Links to organizational hierarchy for spend analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: RFQs are often issued for specific projects; linking to project_header enables RFQ‑to‑project reporting and compliance checks.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the RFQ was approved for issuance by the authorized approver. Part of procurement governance audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of internal approval workflow for issuing this RFQ. Ensures procurement governance and authorization controls are met before publication.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager or procurement authority who approved the issuance of this RFQ. Supports audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the RFQ was awarded to one or more suppliers and purchase orders or contracts were issued. Null if not yet awarded.

attributes.name: bid_bond_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the bid bond or financial guarantee required from suppliers, if applicable. Null if no bid bond is required.

attributes.name: bid_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers are required to submit a bid bond or financial guarantee as part of their quotation. Common for high-value capital equipment or construction projects.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the RFQ was cancelled, if applicable. Supports root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Standardized commodity or material group code identifying the category of goods or services being sourced. May align with UNSPSC or internal taxonomy.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the commodity or material group associated with this RFQ.

attributes.name: confidentiality_agreement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers must sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) or confidentiality agreement before accessing RFQ details.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this RFQ record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated value and supplier quotations. Ensures consistent financial reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Destination site, plant, warehouse, or facility where materials or equipment are to be delivered. May reference a specific location code or address.

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) specifying delivery responsibilities, risk transfer, and cost allocation between buyer and supplier.

attributes.name: estimated_total_value
attributes.description: Estimated total monetary value of the procurement covered by this RFQ. Used for spend analysis and sourcing strategy planning.

attributes.name: evaluation_criteria
attributes.description: Documented criteria and weighting factors used to evaluate and score supplier responses. May include price, quality, delivery, technical capability, and sustainability factors.

attributes.name: invited_supplier_count
attributes.description: Number of suppliers invited to participate in this RFQ. Supports competitive sourcing analysis and supplier engagement metrics.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the RFQ was officially issued and published to invited suppliers. Marks the start of the supplier response period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this RFQ record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or internal notes related to this RFQ. Not typically shared with suppliers.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms communicated to suppliers in the RFQ, such as Net 30, Net 60, or early payment discount terms.

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the procurement spend category. Aligns with organizational spend taxonomy and sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing group or procurement team responsible for managing this RFQ. Aligns with SAP MM purchasing organization structure.

attributes.name: quality_certification_required
attributes.description: List of quality certifications or standards that suppliers must hold or materials must meet, such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, UL, CE marking, or industry-specific certifications.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the buyer requires delivery of the materials or completion of services. Used to assess supplier lead time capability.

attributes.name: response_opening_date
attributes.description: Date and time when submitted supplier responses will be opened and made available for evaluation. Used in sealed-bid scenarios.

attributes.name: response_received_count
attributes.description: Number of valid quotations received from suppliers by the submission deadline. Used to assess competitive response rate.

attributes.name: rfq_description

products.name: sourcing_event
