attributes.description: Reference to the primary cost center for labor cost allocation. Used for financial reporting and production cost tracking.

attributes.name: device_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.device_registry. Business justification: Equipment assignment records which employee is assigned to maintain or operate a device, supporting maintenance planning.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job profile defining the role, responsibilities, and competencies for this assignment.

attributes.name: reporting_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit for financial and operational reporting. Links to the enterprise business unit hierarchy.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position master record. Identifies the specific position to which the employee is assigned.

attributes.name: primary_assignment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee master record. Links this assignment to the worker in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary physical work location for this assignment. Links to facility or site master data.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the assignment. Used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assignment. Indicates whether the assignment is currently active, inactive, suspended, terminated, or pending activation.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment nature. Distinguishes between permanent roles, temporary assignments, acting positions, secondments, contract work, and internships.

attributes.name: base_pay_rate
attributes.description: Base compensation rate for the assignment. Amount is in the currency specified by pay_currency_code.

attributes.name: bonus_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target bonus as a percentage of base pay. Represents the expected variable compensation opportunity for this assignment.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code for financial reporting and compliance. Aligns with ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) financial structure.

attributes.name: cost_center_split_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of labor cost allocated to the primary cost center. Used when an employee's time is split across multiple cost centers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the assignment ends or is scheduled to end. Nullable for open-ended assignments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the assignment becomes effective. Marks the beginning of the assignment period.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement. Distinguishes between full-time, part-time, casual, and seasonal employment.

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of full-time equivalent hours for this assignment. 100.00 represents full-time, values below 100 represent part-time.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad categorization of the job role. Groups similar positions for workforce planning and talent management.

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the position within the organization. Used for career progression tracking and compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assignment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or comments about the assignment. Used for documenting special circumstances or conditions.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assignment is eligible for overtime compensation. True if eligible for overtime pay under labor regulations.

attributes.name: pay_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for compensation amounts. Specifies the currency in which base pay and other compensation are denominated.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the base pay rate is applied. Indicates whether compensation is calculated hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, or annually.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade or band assigned to this position. Used for pay equity analysis and compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: primary_assignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the employees primary assignment. True for primary assignment, false for secondary or concurrent assignments.

attributes.name: probation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the probationary period for this assignment ends. Null if no probation period applies.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business reason or trigger for creating or modifying this assignment. Examples include new hire, promotion, transfer, reorganization, or contract renewal.

attributes.name: rehire_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for rehire after assignment termination. True if eligible, false if not eligible. Null for active assignments.

attributes.name: scheduled_weekly_hours
attributes.description: Standard number of hours the employee is scheduled to work per week under this assignment.

attributes.name: shift_premium_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assignment is eligible for shift premium pay. True if eligible for additional compensation for non-standard shifts.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this assignment record originated. Used for data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the assignment was terminated. Null for active assignments. Used for historical tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for assignment termination. Examples include resignation, retirement, layoff, dismissal, end of contract, or transfer. Null for active assignments.

attributes.name: time_type
attributes.description: Classification of time tracking method for this assignment. Examples include salaried exempt, salaried non-exempt, hourly, or piece-rate.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining unit covering this assignment. Null if not unionized.

attributes.name: union_membership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assignment is covered by a collective bargaining agreement. True if the position is unionized.

attributes.name: work_shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard work shift pattern for this assignment. Examples include day shift, night shift, rotating shift, or flexible schedule.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created the assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: workforce_certification
products.description: Master catalog of regulatory, safety, and professional certification types relevant to industrial manufacturing, combined with transactional attainment records for individual employees. Defines certification types (ISO 45001, OSHA 10/30, forklift operator, electrical safety, AWS/ASME welding qualifications, quality auditor) with issuing body, validity period, and renewal requirements. Tracks individual employee attainment including issue date, expiry date, certificate number, issuing authority, current status (active/expired/suspended), and automated renewal workflow triggers. Serves as the SSOT for all certification compliance — ensuring only certified workers are assigned to regulated tasks per ISO 45001 occupational health requirements.

attributes.name: workforce_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workforce certification record. Primary key for the workforce certification entity.

attributes.name: primary_certification_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the certification type from the master catalog. Defines the regulatory, safety, or professional certification standard (e.g., ISO 45001, OSHA 10/30, forklift operator, electrical safety, AWS/ASME welding qualifications, quality auditor).

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee who holds or is pursuing this certification. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Required for tracking which regulatory requirement each certification satisfies, essential for compliance audit reports.

attributes.name: attachment_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the certification document, certificate, or credential stored in the document management system. Null if no digital copy is available.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number issued by the certifying authority. Used for verification and audit purposes.

attributes.name: certification_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the certification domain: safety (OSHA, ISO 45001), quality (ISO 9001, Six Sigma), technical (welding, electrical), regulatory (EPA, FDA), professional (PMP, CPA), or operational (forklift, crane operator).

attributes.name: certification_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or abbreviation for the certification type used for internal classification and reporting (e.g., 'OSHA-30', 'AWS-CWI', 'ISO9001-LA').

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Proficiency or qualification level of the certification (e.g., 'Basic', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced', 'Lead Auditor', 'Master Craftsman'). Null if the certification does not have levels.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Full name of the certification as recognized by the issuing authority (e.g., 'OSHA 30-Hour General Industry', 'AWS Certified Welder', 'ISO 9001 Lead Auditor').

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is mandated by regulatory or company policy for the employees role (True) or is optional/voluntary (False). Used to enforce ISO 45001 occupational health compliance.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to obtain or renew this certification, including training fees, examination fees, and certification fees. Used for labor cost allocation and training budget tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO cost center code to which the certification cost is allocated. Used for departmental budget tracking and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'CNY').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the certification is valid and the employee is authorized to perform certified tasks. May differ from issue date if there is a waiting period.

attributes.name: equipment_authorization
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of equipment types or asset classes the employee is authorized to operate or work on with this certification (e.g., 'Overhead Crane, Gantry Crane', 'MIG Welder, TIG Welder', 'High Voltage Switchgear').

attributes.name: examination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee took the certification examination or assessment. Null if no examination is required.

attributes.name: examination_score
attributes.description: Numerical score or percentage achieved by the employee on the certification examination. Null if no examination is required or score is not recorded.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null for certifications with no expiration (lifetime certifications).

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was originally issued to the employee by the certifying authority.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organization or regulatory body that issued the certification (e.g., 'OSHA', 'American Welding Society', 'International Register of Certificated Auditors').

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the certification was issued (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'CHN').

attributes.name: job_role_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job roles or job families for which this certification is required or recommended (e.g., 'Welder, Fabricator', 'Quality Inspector, Auditor', 'Forklift Operator, Material Handler').

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renewal or recertification event. Null if the certification has never been renewed.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the HR administrator or system user who last modified this certification record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or administrative notes related to this certification record (e.g., 'Renewal pending manager approval', 'Certification suspended due to incident investigation').

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Result of the certification examination or assessment: pass (met requirements), fail (did not meet requirements), pending (awaiting results), or not_applicable (no examination required).

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory standard or framework that mandates this certification (e.g., 'ISO 45001', 'OSHA 1910.147', 'IEC 61131', 'EPA 40 CFR 112'). Null for non-regulatory certifications.

attributes.name: renewal_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this certification has been renewed for this employee. Zero for initial certifications that have not yet been renewed.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the certification must be renewed to maintain continuous validity. Typically set before the expiry date to allow processing time. Null if renewal is not required.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification requires periodic renewal (True) or is a one-time/lifetime certification (False).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this certification record in the source operational system. Used for reconciliation and data lineage.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee completed the required training or coursework for this certification. Null if training is not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: training_hours_completed
attributes.description: Number of training or continuing education hours the employee has completed toward this certification. Used to track progress for in-progress certifications.

attributes.name: training_hours_required
attributes.description: Total number of training or continuing education hours required to obtain or maintain this certification. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or institution that provided the training or preparation for this certification (e.g., 'Internal Training Center', 'American Welding Society', 'TUV Rheinland'). May differ from the issuing authority.

attributes.name: validity_period_months
attributes.description: Standard validity period of the certification in months from the issue date (e.g., 12, 24, 36). Null for lifetime certifications.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was last verified with the issuing authority. Null if never verified.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of third-party verification of the certification with the issuing authority: verified (confirmed authentic), pending_verification (awaiting confirmation), failed_verification (could not be confirmed), or not_verified (not yet checked).

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the HR administrator or system that performed the most recent verification. Null if never verified.

attributes.name: work_location_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic or facility-level restrictions on where this certification is valid (e.g., 'USA only', 'EU member states', 'Plant 101 only'). Null if valid globally.

attributes.name: workforce_certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification: active (valid and in effect), expired (past expiry date), suspended (temporarily invalid), revoked (permanently invalidated), pending (awaiting approval), or in_progress (training/testing underway).

products.name: shift_schedule
products.description: Operational schedule assigning employees to specific shifts, work centers, and production lines over a defined scheduling horizon. Captures scheduled start/end datetime, assigned work center, production line, shift pattern, schedule status (draft, published, confirmed), and any schedule exceptions. Integrates with Opcenter MES for shop floor labor availability and capacity planning.
products.reference: Workday HCM Time Tracking / Opcenter MES Scheduling

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shift schedule record. Primary key for the shift schedule entity.

attributes.name: primary_shift_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee assigned to this shift. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the production line to which the employee is assigned during this shift. Links to production line master data.

attributes.name: shift_pattern_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the shift pattern template applied to this schedule (e.g., 3-shift rotation, 4-on-4-off). Links to shift pattern reference data.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the work center where the employee is scheduled to work. Links to the work center master in SAP S/4HANA PP.

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total planned break time in minutes during the shift (e.g., lunch break, rest breaks). Used to calculate net productive hours and ensure compliance with labor regulations.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for shift cancellation (e.g., production order cancelled, employee absence, equipment failure). Populated only when schedule_status is cancelled.

attributes.name: cancelled_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the shift schedule was cancelled. Populated only when schedule_status is cancelled. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: confirmed_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee acknowledged or confirmed the shift assignment. Used for tracking employee acceptance and attendance planning. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this shift schedule record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any schedule exception (e.g., production surge, equipment breakdown, employee request). Populated only when schedule_exception_flag is true.

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shift occurs on a recognized company or statutory holiday. Used for premium pay calculation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: is_night_shift
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shift occurs during night hours (typically 10 PM to 6 AM). Used for shift differential pay and occupational health compliance.

attributes.name: is_overtime
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shift qualifies as overtime under labor regulations. True if the shift exceeds standard working hours or occurs outside regular schedule.

attributes.name: is_weekend
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shift occurs on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday). Used for premium pay calculation and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: labor_cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code to which labor hours and costs for this shift are allocated. Used for financial reporting and cost accounting in SAP S/4HANA CO.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this shift schedule record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift schedule record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: net_productive_hours
attributes.description: Net available labor hours after deducting break time from scheduled duration. Used for capacity planning and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the shift schedule. Used for special instructions, safety reminders, or coordination information.

attributes.name: published_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the shift schedule was published and communicated to the employee. Used for compliance with advance notice requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: schedule_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the shift occurs. Used for day-level aggregation and reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: schedule_exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shift has any exceptions or deviations from the standard shift pattern (e.g., early start, late end, split shift).

attributes.name: schedule_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) of the scheduled shift. Used for monthly labor cost allocation and workforce planning.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the shift schedule, typically generated by Opcenter MES or Workday HCM. Format: SCH-YYYYMMDD.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift schedule. Draft schedules are under planning; published schedules are communicated to employees; confirmed schedules are acknowledged; cancelled schedules are voided; completed schedules have ended.

attributes.name: schedule_week
attributes.description: ISO week number of the year for the scheduled shift. Used for weekly labor planning and reporting.

attributes.name: schedule_year
attributes.description: Calendar year of the scheduled shift. Used for annual labor reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: scheduled_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the shift in hours, calculated as the difference between scheduled end and start datetime. Used for labor capacity planning and payroll calculation.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: Planned end date and time of the shift. Represents the clock-out time for the employee at the assigned work center. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: Planned start date and time of the shift. Represents the clock-in time for the employee at the assigned work center. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: scheduling_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: Number of weeks in advance that this shift was scheduled. Used for workforce planning analytics and compliance with advance notice regulations.

attributes.name: shift_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the shift (e.g., Morning Shift, Night Shift, Swing Shift, Weekend Crew). Used for human-readable identification and communication.

attributes.name: shift_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level of the shift assignment. Critical shifts support high-priority production orders; high-priority shifts support key customer deliveries; normal shifts are standard operations; low-priority shifts are for non-urgent tasks.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift assignment. Regular shifts are standard production hours; overtime shifts exceed standard hours; on-call and standby shifts are for emergency coverage; training shifts are for skill development; maintenance shifts are for equipment servicing.

attributes.name: skill_requirement
attributes.description: Required skill or certification for the employee to perform this shift (e.g., CNC Operator, Forklift Certified, Quality Inspector). Used for skill-based scheduling and compliance.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this shift schedule record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Granular transactional record of employee time worked, capturing clock-in/clock-out events, work order or cost center charged, labor type (regular, overtime, double-time), shift premium eligibility, and approval status. Sourced from Workday HCM Time Tracking and MES shop floor terminals. Feeds payroll processing, labor cost allocation to production work orders, and OEE labor efficiency calculations.

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the time entry record. Primary key for the time entry transaction.

attributes.name: asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the production work order or maintenance job that this labor time is charged to. Used for labor cost allocation to manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Time‑entry records must allocate labor hours to a cost center for accurate financial statements.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the machine, equipment, or asset operated or maintained during this time entry. Used for equipment utilization and maintenance labor tracking.

attributes.name: payroll_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the payroll period to which this time entry is assigned for payment processing.

attributes.name: primary_time_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee who recorded this time entry. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: tertiary_time_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user or employee who last modified this time entry record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: absence_type
attributes.description: Type of paid or unpaid absence if this time entry represents non-working time. Set to 'none' for regular working time entries. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|sick_leave|vacation|personal|bereavement|jury_duty|training|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: activity_code
attributes.description: The specific work activity or operation code performed during this time entry (e.g., ASSEMBLY, WELDING, INSPECTION, SETUP, MAINTENANCE). Used for detailed labor tracking and OEE analysis.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the time entry in the workflow. Time entries must be approved before being released to payroll processing.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time entry was approved by the supervisor. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of unpaid breaks taken during this time entry, expressed in minutes. Deducted from total hours for payroll calculation.

attributes.name: clock_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the employee clocked in or started work for this time entry. Captured from MES shop floor terminals or Workday HCM time tracking.

attributes.name: clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the employee clocked out or ended work for this time entry. Used to calculate total hours worked.

attributes.name: compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has been verified for compliance with labor regulations, union agreements, and ISO 45001 occupational health and safety requirements (e.g., maximum consecutive hours, mandatory rest periods).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for labor rate, premium, and cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any time entry exception or anomaly requiring review (e.g., LATE_CLOCK_IN, MISSING_CLOCK_OUT, OVERTIME_THRESHOLD). Empty if no exception.

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments explaining any time entry exception, correction, or special circumstance. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked during this time entry, calculated from clock-in and clock-out timestamps. Expressed in decimal hours (e.g., 8.50 for 8 hours 30 minutes).

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: The job classification or position code of the employee at the time this work was performed. Used for labor mix analysis and skill-based costing.

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: Total labor cost for this time entry, calculated as hours worked multiplied by labor rate plus any shift premiums. Used for work order costing and variance analysis.

attributes.name: labor_rate
attributes.description: The hourly labor rate applied to this time entry for cost calculation purposes. May differ from actual employee pay rate for standard costing purposes.

attributes.name: labor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the labor time for payroll and costing purposes. Determines the pay rate multiplier and labor cost calculation method.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The plant, facility, or work center location code where this time was worked. Used for multi-site labor reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time entry record was last modified or updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: oee_productive_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) Productive Time Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry represents productive manufacturing time that should be included in OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) labor efficiency calculations. False for indirect labor, breaks, or non-productive activities.

tag_set.value: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) Productive Time Flag

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: The sequence number of the manufacturing operation or routing step being performed during this time entry. Used to track labor against specific production process steps.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for overtime pay for this time entry based on employment classification and labor regulations.

attributes.name: payroll_processed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has been processed and included in a payroll run. Once true, the time entry is locked from further edits.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: The project or capital expenditure (CapEx) project code to which this labor time is charged. Used for project accounting and capital asset construction tracking.

attributes.name: quantity_produced
attributes.description: The number of units or pieces produced or processed during this time entry. Used for productivity analysis and labor efficiency calculations (units per hour).

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The shift identifier or code during which this time was worked (e.g., DAY, NIGHT, SWING). Used for shift premium calculation and production scheduling analysis.

attributes.name: shift_premium_amount
attributes.description: The additional premium amount paid for this time entry due to shift differential, expressed in the payroll currency. Null if no premium applies.

attributes.name: shift_premium_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry qualifies for shift differential or premium pay based on the shift worked and labor agreement terms.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The system or method through which this time entry was captured (e.g., MES shop floor terminal, Workday mobile app, manual supervisor entry).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity produced (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters). Aligns with material master UOM definitions.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work was performed. Used for payroll period assignment and labor reporting.

products.name: absence_record
products.description: Transactional record of employee absences including planned leave (vacation, personal, parental), unplanned absences (sick leave, FMLA), and approved time-off requests. Captures absence type, start/end dates, duration in hours/days, approval status, and reason code. Supports production capacity planning by surfacing labor availability gaps and feeds payroll deduction or accrual calculations.

attributes.name: absence_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the absence record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order or production order that was impacted by this absence. Used to track production capacity gaps and schedule adjustments.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Absence cost impact is charged to the employee's cost center for variance analysis.

attributes.name: payroll_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll period in which this absence is processed for payroll deduction or accrual adjustment.

attributes.name: primary_absence_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who is absent. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the scheduled shift from which the employee was absent. Supports shift-level labor availability tracking.

attributes.name: tertiary_absence_replacement_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the replacement worker assigned to cover the absent employee's shift or responsibilities.

attributes.name: absence_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the absence, including special circumstances, accommodation requests, or manager observations.

attributes.name: absence_reason_code
attributes.description: Detailed reason code for the absence. May include specific illness codes, family emergency types, or other granular classifications as defined by HR policy.

attributes.name: absence_type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the category of absence: VACATION (planned vacation leave), SICK (unplanned sick leave), PERSONAL (personal time off), PARENTAL (maternity/paternity leave), FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act protected leave), BEREAVEMENT (compassionate leave), JURY_DUTY (civic duty leave), MILITARY (military service leave), UNPAID (unpaid leave of absence). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VACATION|SICK|PERSONAL|PARENTAL|FMLA|BEREAVEMENT|JURY_DUTY|MILITARY|UNPAID — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: accrual_balance_deducted
attributes.description: Number of hours deducted from the employee's leave accrual balance (vacation bank, sick leave bank, etc.) for this absence.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the absence request: PENDING (awaiting manager review), APPROVED (authorized by manager), REJECTED (denied by manager), CANCELLED (approved but subsequently cancelled), WITHDRAWN (employee withdrew request before approval).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the absence request was approved or rejected by the manager.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this absence record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total duration of the absence measured in calendar days. Supports fractional days for partial-day absences.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the absence measured in hours. Used for hourly payroll deduction and accrual calculations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the absence period. Nullable for open-ended absences pending return-to-work confirmation.

attributes.name: is_fmla_protected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Protected Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence is protected under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) regulations, providing job protection and continuation of benefits.

tag_set.value: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Protected Indicator

attributes.name: is_intermittent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence is part of an intermittent leave pattern (true) such as recurring FMLA leave, or a continuous block of absence (false).

attributes.name: is_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the absence is paid (true) or unpaid (false). Determines whether payroll deduction or accrual balance adjustment is required.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this absence record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: medical_certification_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certification documentation has been received and validated by HR.

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical certification documentation is required for this absence per company policy or regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee originally submitted the absence request in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: return_to_work_certification_received
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return to Work Certification Received Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical clearance or return-to-work certification was received before the employee resumed duties, as required by occupational health policy per ISO 45001.

tag_set.value: Return to Work Certification Received Indicator

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Actual date the employee returned to work following the absence. May differ from the planned end_date if the absence was extended or shortened.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this absence record originated (e.g., WORKDAY_HCM, SAP_HR, MANUAL_ENTRY).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this absence record in the source system (e.g., Workday HCM absence event ID). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the absence period. Used for production capacity planning and labor availability forecasting.

products.name: payroll_result
products.description: Transactional record of payroll calculation outcomes per employee per pay period. Captures gross pay, net pay, earnings components (base, overtime, shift premium, bonus), deduction components (tax withholding, benefits, garnishments), pay period dates, payroll run identifier, and payment method. Sourced from Workday HCM Payroll. Supports labor cost allocation to cost centers and CapEx/OpEx reporting.

attributes.name: payroll_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payroll calculation result record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Payroll expenses are allocated to cost centers to support financial reporting and budgeting.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll processing batch or run that generated this result. Used for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: primary_payroll_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee for whom this payroll result was calculated. Links to employee master data in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Total allowances paid to the employee (housing, transportation, meal allowances, etc.).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll result was approved for payment.

attributes.name: bank_account_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number used for direct deposit payment. Stored for verification purposes only.

attributes.name: base_pay_amount
attributes.description: The base salary or hourly wage earnings for the pay period before any additional earnings or deductions.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: One-time or periodic bonus payments included in this payroll result (performance bonus, retention bonus, etc.).

attributes.name: capex_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total labor cost allocated to capital expenditure projects for this pay period. Used for financial capitalization of labor costs.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Sales commission or incentive earnings included in this payroll result.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll result (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The department code of the employee at the time of payroll calculation.

attributes.name: employer_benefits_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total employer-paid benefits costs (employer contribution to health insurance, retirement matching, etc.) for this payroll result. Used for total labor cost calculation.

attributes.name: employer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total employer-paid payroll taxes (employer portion of Social Security, Medicare, unemployment insurance, etc.) for this payroll result. Used for CapEx/OpEx labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: federal_tax_amount
attributes.description: Federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period.

attributes.name: garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Court-ordered wage garnishments deducted from gross pay (child support, tax levies, creditor garnishments).

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total earnings before any deductions. Sum of base pay, overtime, bonuses, commissions, allowances, and other earnings.

attributes.name: health_insurance_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Employee contribution to health insurance premiums deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: local_tax_amount
attributes.description: Local or municipal tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period.

attributes.name: medicare_tax_amount
attributes.description: Medicare tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: The final take-home pay amount after all deductions. This is the amount paid to the employee.

attributes.name: opex_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total labor cost allocated to operational expenditure for this pay period. Used for financial expense reporting.

attributes.name: other_benefits_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total deductions for other employee benefits (dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, etc.).

attributes.name: other_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total of all other miscellaneous deductions not categorized above (loan repayments, charitable contributions, etc.).

attributes.name: overtime_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period.

attributes.name: overtime_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime earnings for the pay period, calculated based on hours worked beyond standard schedule.

attributes.name: paid_time_off_hours
attributes.description: Total paid time off hours (vacation, sick leave, personal days) used during the pay period.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly).

attributes.name: pay_group
attributes.description: The pay group to which the employee belongs, determining pay schedule and processing rules.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the pay period covered by this payroll result.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the pay period covered by this payroll result.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee will receive or received payment for this payroll result.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the employee receives payment (direct deposit, physical check, cash, wire transfer).

attributes.name: payroll_calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll result was calculated by the payroll system.

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payroll result indicating its processing stage.

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total regular hours worked by the employee during the pay period, excluding overtime.

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee contribution to retirement savings plan (401k, pension) deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: shift_premium_amount
attributes.description: Additional compensation for working non-standard shifts (night shift, weekend shift) as per labor agreements.

attributes.name: social_security_tax_amount
attributes.description: Social Security (FICA) tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period.

attributes.name: state_tax_amount
attributes.description: State income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period.

attributes.name: total_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions (taxes, benefits, garnishments, etc.) subtracted from gross pay.

attributes.name: total_labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total fully-loaded labor cost including gross pay, employer taxes, and employer benefits. Used for CapEx/OpEx allocation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: union_dues_amount
attributes.description: Union membership dues deducted from gross pay as per collective bargaining agreement.

products.name: benefit_plan
products.description: Reference master of employee benefit plans offered by the manufacturing enterprise — including health, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k)/pension, HSA/FSA, and EAP — combined with transactional enrollment records per employee per plan year. Plan definitions capture plan type, carrier/provider, coverage tiers, enrollment periods, contribution rates, and eligibility rules by employee class. Enrollment records track individual elections: coverage level selected, effective dates, dependent coverage, and life event changes. Sourced from Workday HCM Benefits. Serves as the SSOT for both benefit plan configuration and employee enrollment status.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan. Primary key.

attributes.name: offering_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Benefit plans are offered by a specific organizational unit; adding offering_org_unit_id provides clear ownership and enables joins to org_unit for cost center and location context.

attributes.name: aca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this health benefit plan meets ACA minimum essential coverage and minimum value standards. Required for employer mandate reporting.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or third-party administrator providing the benefit plan (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield', 'Aetna', 'Fidelity').

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or contract number assigned by the insurance carrier to this benefit plan. Used for claims processing and carrier communications.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan is subject to COBRA continuation coverage requirements, allowing terminated employees to continue coverage at their own expense.

tag_set.value: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of covered service costs the employee pays after meeting the deductible (e.g., 20% coinsurance means employee pays 20%, plan pays 80%).

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are collected (e.g., biweekly aligns with payroll cycles).

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the employee pays for a covered service (e.g., $25 for a doctor visit). Applies to health and dental plans.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum benefit amount or coverage limit provided by the plan (e.g., $500,000 life insurance coverage, $50,000 annual disability benefit). Null for unlimited coverage plans.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage offered by the plan, determining who is covered (employee only, employee plus dependents, family coverage). Affects premium rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was first created in the HR system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for contribution amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multinational benefit administration.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount the employee must pay out-of-pocket before insurance coverage begins. Applies to health, dental, and vision plans.

attributes.name: dependent_coverage_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan allows employees to enroll eligible dependents (spouse, children, domestic partner).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit plan is no longer available for new enrollments or when coverage terminates. Null for open-ended plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit plan becomes available for enrollment and coverage begins. Typically aligns with plan year start or new hire eligibility.

attributes.name: eligibility_rule
attributes.description: Business rule defining which employee classes or employment types are eligible for this benefit plan (e.g., 'Full-time employees with 90 days of service', 'Salaried employees only').

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount the employee pays per pay period for this benefit plan coverage tier. Deducted from payroll pre-tax or post-tax depending on plan type.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount the employer pays per pay period toward this benefit plan coverage tier. Represents labor cost allocation for financial reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_close_date
attributes.description: Last date employees can enroll in or make changes to this benefit plan during the annual open enrollment period.

attributes.name: enrollment_open_date
attributes.description: First date employees can enroll in or make changes to this benefit plan during the annual open enrollment period.

attributes.name: erisa_plan_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Number
attributes.description: Three-digit plan number assigned to this benefit plan for ERISA Form 5500 reporting. Required for all ERISA-covered plans.

tag_set.value: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Number

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan complies with HIPAA privacy and security requirements for protected health information (PHI).

tag_set.value: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: max_dependents
attributes.description: Maximum number of dependents an employee can enroll under this benefit plan. Null if no limit applies.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the HR administrator who last modified this benefit plan record. Supports audit and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was last updated. Tracks changes to plan configuration, rates, or terms.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max
attributes.description: Maximum amount an employee will pay out-of-pocket for covered services in a plan year. After this limit, the plan pays 100% of covered expenses.

attributes.name: plan_administrator_email
attributes.description: Email address for the plan administrator. Used for employee benefit inquiries and regulatory communications.

attributes.name: plan_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or entity responsible for administering the benefit plan and handling employee inquiries, claims, and appeals.

attributes.name: plan_administrator_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the plan administrator. Provided to employees for benefit support and claims assistance.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the benefit plan in HR systems and employee communications. Used on enrollment forms and benefit statements.

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official Summary Plan Description (SPD) document required under ERISA. Provides employees with detailed plan terms and conditions.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the benefit plan as presented to employees (e.g., 'Premium Health PPO Plan', 'Basic Dental Coverage', 'Employee Stock Purchase Plan').

attributes.name: plan_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or administrative comments about this benefit plan. Used for internal HR reference.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit plan. Active plans are available for enrollment; inactive plans are closed to new enrollments but may have existing participants.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan offered. Determines regulatory compliance requirements and enrollment rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health|dental|vision|life|disability|retirement|hsa|fsa|eap|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this benefit plan configuration is effective. Benefit plans are typically versioned annually with new rates and terms.

attributes.name: section_125_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan is eligible for pre-tax payroll deductions under an IRC Section 125 cafeteria plan.

tag_set.value: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Eligible Flag

attributes.name: tax_treatment
attributes.description: Tax treatment of employee contributions to this benefit plan. Pre-tax contributions reduce taxable income; post-tax contributions do not.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days a new hire must wait before becoming eligible to enroll in this benefit plan. Regulatory limits apply under ACA.

products.name: training_course
products.description: Master catalog of training courses and learning programs combined with transactional enrollment and completion records for manufacturing employees. Course definitions include code, title, delivery method (classroom/e-learning/OJT), duration, passing criteria, mandatory/elective classification, and recurrence requirements. Enrollment records capture individual employee participation: enrollment date, scheduled session, completion date, assessment score, pass/fail status, instructor, and any linked certification earned upon completion. Covers safety training (ISO 45001, OSHA), technical skills (CNC, PLC, SCADA, welding), quality methods (SPC, FMEA, PPAP), and leadership development. Serves as the SSOT for ISO 45001 competence management and mandatory training compliance tracking.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training course. Primary key for the training course master catalog.

attributes.name: instructor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Training management tracks internal instructors delivering courses to ensure qualification and cost allocation.

attributes.name: owner_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Each training course is owned by a department; linking to org_unit provides hierarchy and removes redundant owner_department string.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Ensures each training course is linked to the specific regulation it fulfills, used in compliance training matrices.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the external training vendor in the procurement system. Null for internal training.

attributes.name: accreditation_number
attributes.description: Official accreditation or approval number issued by the regulatory body or industry association for the training course. Used for compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal assessment (test, exam, practical demonstration) is required to complete the course. True if assessment is mandatory; false if completion is based on attendance only.

attributes.name: certification_awarded
attributes.description: Indicates whether successful completion of the course results in a formal certification or credential being awarded to the employee.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Name of the certification or credential awarded upon successful course completion. Null if no certification is awarded.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or industry standard that the training course addresses. Examples include ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety), OSHA (workplace safety), ISO 9001 (quality management), IEC 62443 (industrial cybersecurity), EPA (environmental), or internal compliance policies. Multiple frameworks may be listed separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Standard cost per employee for delivering the training course, including instructor fees, materials, facility costs, and external vendor charges. Used for training budget planning and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the training course by subject area. Safety includes ISO 45001 and OSHA training; technical covers CNC, PLC, SCADA, welding; quality includes SPC, FMEA, PPAP; leadership covers management development; compliance covers regulatory requirements; operational covers MES, ERP, and process training.

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the training course in the learning management system. Used for course catalog reference and enrollment processing.

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the training course content, learning objectives, target audience, and prerequisites.

attributes.name: course_materials_url
attributes.description: Web address or document management system link to access course materials, handouts, presentations, and reference documents.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training course. Active courses are available for enrollment; inactive courses are temporarily unavailable; draft courses are under development; retired courses are no longer offered; under review courses are being updated or audited.

attributes.name: course_title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the training course as displayed in the learning catalog and on certificates.

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the course is mandatory for specific roles, elective for employee development, or recommended for career progression.

attributes.name: course_version
attributes.description: Version number of the training course content. Incremented when course materials, objectives, or assessments are updated. Used for version control and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the training course record was first created in the learning management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per participant. Standard currency for training cost reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training course is delivered. Classroom is in-person instructor-led; e-learning is online self-paced; OJT (On-the-Job Training) is hands-on workplace training; blended combines multiple methods; virtual instructor-led is live online; self-paced is asynchronous learning.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Standard duration of the training course in business days. Used for multi-day courses and scheduling planning.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Standard duration of the training course in hours. Used for scheduling, capacity planning, and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course is retired or no longer available for new enrollments. Null for active courses with no planned retirement date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course becomes available for enrollment and delivery. Used for course catalog management and scheduling.

attributes.name: instructor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course requires a qualified instructor to deliver the training. True for classroom, OJT, and virtual instructor-led courses; false for self-paced e-learning.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the primary language in which the course is delivered. Used for multi-language workforce training planning.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course content was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and compliance. Used to track course maintenance and ensure content currency.

attributes.name: max_participants
attributes.description: Maximum number of employees that can be enrolled in a single course session. Used for capacity planning and session scheduling. Null for unlimited enrollment courses such as self-paced e-learning.

attributes.name: min_participants
attributes.description: Minimum number of enrolled employees required to run a scheduled course session. Sessions below this threshold may be cancelled or rescheduled. Null for self-paced courses.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who last modified the training course record. Used for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the training course record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the training course content. Used for course maintenance planning and compliance with ISO 9001 training program requirements.

attributes.name: passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum score required to successfully complete the course, expressed as a percentage (0-100). Used to determine pass/fail status and certification eligibility.

attributes.name: prerequisite_courses
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of course codes that must be completed before enrolling in this course. Null if no prerequisites exist.

attributes.name: recurrence_interval_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required course repetitions for recurrent training. Null if recurrence is not required. Common values include 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), or 36 (triennial) for safety and compliance training.

attributes.name: recurrence_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training course must be repeated periodically to maintain competence or compliance. True for courses with expiration requirements such as safety training, regulatory compliance, or equipment certifications.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory or governing body that mandates or recognizes the training. Examples include OSHA, EPA, ISO, IEC, ANSI, UL, NIST. Null for non-regulatory training.

attributes.name: subject_matter_expert
attributes.description: Name of the subject matter expert responsible for course content accuracy and technical review. Used for course maintenance and update coordination.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the intended audience for the training course, including job roles, departments, or skill levels. Used for course recommendation and enrollment planning.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who created the training course record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Transactional record of formal employee performance evaluations conducted on a periodic basis (annual, mid-year, probationary). Captures review period, overall rating, individual goal ratings, competency ratings, manager comments, employee self-assessment, calibration status, and review completion date. Sourced from Workday HCM Performance. Feeds merit increase decisions and talent development planning.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance review record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee being reviewed. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the manager or supervisor conducting the performance review.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance rating was calibrated through organizational review and alignment process.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the performance rating has been through organizational calibration process to ensure consistency (not calibrated, pending calibration, calibrated, calibration waived).

attributes.name: competency_rating
attributes.description: Rating reflecting the employees demonstration of core competencies and behavioral skills (expert, proficient, developing, basic, not demonstrated).

attributes.name: competency_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing competency assessment, typically on a scale (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0).

attributes.name: compliance_training_completed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the employee completed all required compliance training during the review period, relevant for ISO 45001 occupational health and safety compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: department_at_review
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit of the employee at the time the review was conducted.

attributes.name: development_plan
attributes.description: Documented plan outlining specific development actions, training, and growth opportunities for the employee going forward.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee acknowledged receipt and review of their performance evaluation.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the employee has acknowledged the review (pending, acknowledged, disputed).

attributes.name: employee_rebuttal_comments
attributes.description: Optional comments provided by the employee if they disagree with or wish to provide additional context to the performance review.

attributes.name: employee_self_assessment
attributes.description: Employees self-evaluation narrative describing their own performance, accomplishments, and development needs during the review period.

attributes.name: goal_achievement_rating
attributes.description: Rating reflecting the employees achievement of individual goals and objectives set for the review period.

attributes.name: goal_achievement_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing goal achievement performance, typically on a scale (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0).

attributes.name: job_profile_at_review
attributes.description: Job profile or position title of the employee at the time the review was conducted.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: location_at_review
attributes.description: Work location or site of the employee at the time the review was conducted.

attributes.name: manager_comments
attributes.description: Detailed narrative comments and feedback provided by the reviewing manager regarding employee performance, strengths, and development areas.

attributes.name: merit_increase_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the employee is eligible for merit-based salary increase based on this performance review outcome.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Overall performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period (exceeds expectations, meets expectations, needs improvement, unsatisfactory, outstanding).

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the overall performance rating, typically on a scale (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0).

attributes.name: performance_improvement_plan_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan is required due to unsatisfactory performance.

attributes.name: promotion_recommended
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the reviewing manager recommends the employee for promotion based on performance.

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review was finalized and marked as complete.

attributes.name: review_cycle_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the performance review cycle occurred.

attributes.name: review_due_date

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core transactional record capturing all general ledger postings at both document header and line item level, serving as the single source of truth for the complete financial audit trail. Header attributes include document number, document type, posting date, fiscal year, period, company code, currency, exchange rate, reference document, reversal indicator, and IFRS/GAAP compliance flags. Line item attributes include line number, GL account, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction and local currencies, cost center, profit center, WBS element reference, internal order, tax code, assignment field, and posting text. Invoice attributes include document number, vendor, company code, invoice date, posting date, baseline date, payment terms, gross amount, tax amount, net amount, three-way match status (PO/GR/IR verification), payment block reason, and approval workflow status. Payment attributes include payment method (ACH, wire, check, direct debit), house bank account, value date, payment amount, discount taken, cash discount percentage, clearing document reference, payment run identifier, and bank statement reconciliation status. Covers the complete payables cycle from invoice receipt through three-way matching, approval, payment proposal, payment execution, and bank clearing. Serves as the SSOT for all vendor obligations, payment commitments, and outgoing cash flows.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset register and complete transaction history serving as the lifecycle record for all capitalized assets of the manufacturing enterprise including production machinery, CNC equipment, robotics, automation systems, buildings, vehicles, tooling, and IT infrastructure. Master data captures asset number, asset class, description, serial number, acquisition date and value, useful life, depreciation method/key, salvage value, location/plant assignment, and cost center assignment. Transaction history captures all asset movements: acquisitions, retirements, transfers, revaluations, impairments, and periodic depreciation postings with transaction type, posting date, amount, document reference, and depreciation area (book/tax/IFRS). Provides accumulated depreciation, net book value, replacement value, and insurance value. The SSOT for asset valuation, depreciation scheduling, capital base reporting, and insurance declarations.

products.name: regulatory_requirement
products.description: Master catalog of all applicable laws, regulations, standards, and compliance obligations governing Manufacturing operations across all jurisdictions. Encompasses ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, IEC 62443, OSHA, EPA, CE Marking, UL, ANSI, REACH, RoHS, and jurisdiction-specific requirements. Each record defines the regulation source, issuing authority, jurisdiction (federal, state, local, EU, international), applicability scope (plant, product line, geography), effective date, mandatory compliance deadline, review frequency, and current adoption status. Serves as the single authoritative legal register and compliance universe from which all specific obligations, permits, and filings are derived.

products.name: audit_event

products.name: device_registry
products.description: Master record for all industrial automation devices including PLCs, HMIs, SCADA servers, edge gateways, sensors, actuators, drives, and IIoT endpoints deployed across manufacturing facilities. Serves as the SSOT for device identity, firmware version, hardware model, communication protocol, network address, installation location, operational status, and lifecycle state. Each device is uniquely identified and linked to a plant, production line, or work center. Captures device type classification (PLC, HMI, RTU, DCS, edge node), vendor, model number, serial number, firmware version, IP address, MAC address, communication protocol (OPC-UA, Modbus, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP), commissioning date, decommission date, and current operational status.

products.name: control_system
products.description: Master record representing a discrete industrial control system instance — a named, configured automation system such as a DCS (Distributed Control System), SCADA system, PLC-based control panel, or safety instrumented system (SIS). products.name: device_config_snapshot

products.name: setpoint_change
products.description: Transactional record capturing every operator or system-initiated setpoint change event on a controlled process variable.
